text.title: 坎瑞薩德的任務
text.objectives: 與坎瑞薩德交談，回復你的天賦、武器、與坐騎。
text.description: 歡迎你從死亡的世界歸來。$B$B在過去的時代你驕傲地挺立，是你族人之中的英雄。而現在你既墮落又破碎 - 不過是個過去的遺物。站到我面前吧，我將喚醒你過去的榮光。$B$B  我會回復你失去的力量，讓你再次完整歸一。
text.completed: Return to Kanrethad.

english.title: Kanrethad's Quest
english.objectives: Speak to Kanrethad to restore your talents, weapon and mount.
english.description: Welcome back from the world of death. $B$BIn an age long past you stood proud, a hero among your brethren. Now you stand fallen and broken - a relic of the past. Stand before me, as I awaken the legend that you once were. $B$B I shall restore the weapons and powers you have lost, making you whole once again.
english.completed: Return to Kanrethad.

text.title: 尖爪的爪子
text.objectives: 将尖爪的爪子交给银风避难所的塞娜尼·雷心。
text.description: 强大的角鹰兽尖爪已经被你杀死了，它的爪子将成为你胜利的象征。$b$b银风避难所的塞娜尼·雷心一定会对你的战利品感兴趣的。
text.progress: Yes, mighty $C, I sensed your arrival. I trust you have more news to report to me about your hunt?
text.completion: Most impressive, $N... the claw of Sharptalon could not have been easy to get! The Ashenvale Hunt goes well for you!$B$BSharptalon had long terrorized the peons from the lumber camps near its path as they tried to travel here to Splintertree Post. No doubt once the word gets out that it was you who put down the beast, many rousing songs of your bravery will be heard at campfires and lumber mills across Ashenvale!

english.title: Sharptalon's Claw
english.objectives: Bring Sharptalon's Claw to Senani Thunderheart at Silverwind Refuge.
english.description: The mighty hippogryph Sharptalon has been slain, with the claw of the felled beast serving as a testament to your victory.$b$bSenani Thunderheart at the Silverwind Refuge will no doubt be interested in seeing this trophy as proof of your deeds.
english.progress: Yes, mighty $C, I sensed your arrival. I trust you have more news to report to me about your hunt?
english.completion: Most impressive, $N... the claw of Sharptalon could not have been easy to get! The Ashenvale Hunt goes well for you!$B$BSharptalon had long terrorized the peons from the lumber camps near its path as they tried to travel here to Splintertree Post. No doubt once the word gets out that it was you who put down the beast, many rousing songs of your bravery will be heard at campfires and lumber mills across Ashenvale!

text.title: Jitters' Growling Gut
text.objectives: Speak with Chef Grual.
text.description: I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds!  I need some decent food, and I'm willing to trade well for it.$B$BBring me a feast and I'll pay you handsomely.$B$BI heard Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire makes very good Dusky Crab Cakes...
text.progress: Oh, a shipment from my brother? Splendid! Fortune truly shines on me today!
text.completion: You need some Crab Cakes, do you? Well I might be able to cook some up for you...

text.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot
text.objectives: Kill Garrick Padfoot and bring his head to Deputy Willem at Northshire Abbey.
text.description: Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge.  Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!$B$BBut be wary, $n.  Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him.  He will not be an easy man to reach.
text.progress: Did you find Garrick's shack? Are we finally free of that villain?
text.completion: Hah - you caught him! You've done Elwynn a great service, and earned a nice bounty!
text.completed: Return to Deputy Willem at Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] Kobold Camp Cleanup
text.objectives: Kill 6 Kobold Vermin, then return to Marshal McBride.
text.description: Your first task is one of cleansing, $n.  A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north.  Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find.  Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from Northshire.
text.progress: How goes the hunting, $N? Have you found and defeated those vermin?
text.completion: Well done, citizen. Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us. And the humans of Stormwind do not need another threat.$B$BFor defeating them, you have my gratitude.
text.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: A Rogue's Deal
text.objectives: Deliver the Nondescript Letter to Innkeeper Renee in Tirisfal Glades.
text.description: Hey, mate! Do a favor for a young man who's been fighting more than his fair share of mindless zombies and spiders?$B$BI got this here letter that needs to go to Brill... to an innkeeper named Renee something-or-other. Don't really matter none what her last name is.$B$BAnyway, it's a nice cozy little place full of victims of the plague trying to make their way in the world. And it be a great spot for you to rest too if the need arises. You should check it out... you do and I'll pay you well.
text.progress: Yes? Yes? What is it?$B$BThe forsaken; they certainly do have huge appetites. Make yourself at home... yes, rest those weary bones. My name's Renee if you need anything at all.
text.completion: Oh? A letter? Wonderful news! I've been waiting on word from my dear old mother in Deathknell. Such a saint, she is. I wonder how she's holding up.$B$BWhat? Too cheery? Not buying it, are you?$B$BWell, get lost then... it's really no business who the letter's from anyway. Go on! Get lost!$B$BCome back when you've got some coin to spend... loafer.$B$BNext thing you know, you'll be coming back to rest after a long days adventure or some stupid thing like that.

text.title: The Killing Fields
text.objectives: Farmer Saldean wants you to kill 20 Harvest Watchers.
text.description: Look at what has happened to this place!  These lands were once occupied by good farm folk.  But the damned thieves have driven them all off.  Not me, though!  But it seems some Harvest Watchers have taken over the fields.$b$bIf you're up for the work, I'd like you to go out and kill twenty of them.  Come back when you're done for your pay.  If you finish up with the ones in my field, clear them from the neighboring fields as well.
text.progress: Ah, I see you're back! I hope you've been hard at work clearing those fields of those Harvest Watchers. Have you killed twenty yet?
text.completion: Good work, friend. You have earned your pay well. Who knows, perhaps Westfall will prosper once again.
text.completed: Return to Farmer Saldean at Saldean's Farm in Westfall.

text.title: The Scrimshank Redemption
text.objectives: Discover the fate of Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, and bring either him or his surveying equipment to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.
text.description: Oh, this is just terrible!  I sent out my top assistant, Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, into the desert southeast of here.  That's an area we call the Gaping Chasm.  Well, he's gone missing, and his last report had more of those weird bugs where he was.  Could it be that they've infested two major regions of the desert now?$B$BI need you to head into the Gaping Chasm and look for Scrimshank, please!  That... or at least find his surveying equipment.  I fear that may be all that is left of the poor sod.
text.progress: Well, what news do you have?  You look like you've been in quite the fight... is Scrimshank alive?
text.completion: He was a good goblin, young Scrimshank.  Let's hope that his demise was not in vain by what he was able to record with his surveying equipment.$B$BIt seems as though we have quite the situation on our hands here with these bugs.  They're way too cunning for their own good, and the research we've done so far is shaping up to indicate that they might even be under the controlling influence of a third party!  If this is the case, then it bodes ill for not only Gadgetzan, but the whole desert!
text.completed: Return to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: 悬赏河爪豺狼人
text.objectives: 给兵营的瑞尼尔副队长带去8个彩色豺狼人臂章。
text.description: 有人在艾尔文森林的边界处看见了豺狼人，这些野蛮的动物在这儿肯定不会干什么好事。在了望塔南边的树林里有一大群豺狼人到处游荡，凭我们自己的兵力很难应付他们。$B$B任何帮忙清除这些豺狼人的勇士都会受到暴风城军方的嘉奖。把他们的彩色豺狼人臂章带给我以证明你杀了他们。
text.progress: Hail, $N. Have you been killing Gnolls...?
text.completion: I see you've been busy! You have our thanks, $N.
text.completed: Return to Deputy Rainer at Forest's Edge in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty
english.objectives: Bring 8 Painted Gnoll Armbands to Deputy Rainer at the Barracks.
english.description: Gnolls, brutish creatures with no decent business in these lands, have been seen along the borders of Elwynn Forest.  A large pack of them, many more than we can handle alone, have infested the woods south of the guard tower yonder.  Another group has infested the areas near Stone Cairn Lake to the east.$B$BThe Stormwind Army will commend whomever helps kill them.  Bring me their painted gnoll armbands as proof of your deed.
english.progress: Hail, $N. Have you been killing Gnolls...?
english.completion: I see you've been busy! You have our thanks, $N.
english.completed: Return to Deputy Rainer at Forest's Edge in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: The People's Militia
text.objectives: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to him on Sentinel Hill.
text.description: The People's Militia has but one goal:  To defend the lands of Westfall and return peace to our surroundings.  Unfortunately, the price of peace is often blood. $b$bOne of my scouts has brought word of a band of Defias Trappers wreaking havoc nearby.  I have reports of Defias Trapper sightings near the Jangolode Mine to the Northwest as well as at the Molsen Farm and Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm. If you seek to join our ranks, slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me.
text.progress: Perhaps I did not make myself clear, pledge. In order to prove your worth as a servant to The People's Militia and to the Light you need to slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me when the deed is done.
text.completion: Well done, $N. My scout witnessed your valiant acts. You are proving yourself quite well so far.
text.completed: Return to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

text.title: The People's Militia
text.objectives: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters and return to him on Sentinel Hill.
text.description: A band of vicious Defias Pillagers has been seen plundering the Gold Coast Quarry, Moonbrook and the Alexston Farmstead.  The People's Militia will not stand for such behavior.  Dispatch immediately, $n, and make the Light's presence known in Westfall.$b$bThe Gold Coast Quarry is near the shore, to the West of the tower.  As the next step of your training, I want you to kill 15 of those foul Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters.
text.progress: We have not time to talk, $N. The Defias Pillagers are denying the people of Westfall the peace and prosperity they deserve. Make sure at least 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters have been killed. That will send a clear message that corruption is not welcome here.
text.completion: Your worth to The People's Militia has been validated by your brave acts thus far.
text.completed: Return to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

text.title: The People's Militia
text.objectives: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Highwaymen, 5 Defias Pathstalkers and 5 Defias Knuckledusters then return to him on Sentinel Hill.
text.description: Some Defias have eluded us.  My most trusted scout reports that these Defias have been looting and pillaging the countryside, all the way into Southern Westfall.  We believe they are hiding out in the Dagger Hills, plotting their next move.   Slay the wretches in the name of The People's Militia.
text.progress: $N, now is no time for idle chatter. If you still wish to prove yourself to The People's Militia you need to slay the Defias I notified you about earlier. Return to me when you have completed your duty.
text.completion: When I left the tainted lands of Lordaeron I returned to a grim state of affairs here in my homeland. But there is hope for Westfall yet. As proven by your valor in battle, it is obvious to me that you serve our cause with honor. It is with great pride that I induct thee into The People's Militia. May the Light shine upon you.
text.completed: Return to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] Investigate Echo Ridge
text.objectives: Kill 8 Kobold Workers, then report back to Marshal McBride.
text.description: $n, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought.  A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.$B$BGo to the mine and remove them.  We know there are at least 8.  Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.
text.progress: Have you been to the mines? Are you ready to report?
text.completion: I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine. No good can come of this. Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again. I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...
text.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 葛拉德的饮料
text.progress: Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.$B$BIf you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.
text.completion: Thanks, $N! And come back if you want to trade again.

english.progress: Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.$B$BIf you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.
english.completion: Thanks, $N! And come back if you want to trade again.

text.title: Uldaman Reagent Run
text.objectives: Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to Ghak Healtouch in Thelsamar.
text.description: I've heard about a newly discovered plant called the magenta fungus caps.  They grow in clusters at the Uldaman dig site and can be found in the early tunnels and deep within the less-explored areas.  I want to study their potential use in alchemy, and that's where you come in.$B$BFind the magenta cap clusters and bring me a dozen caps.  Be warned, the clusters may spew out poison spores if jostled.$B$BDo this for me, and I'll whip up a batch of one of my famous restorative elixirs for you!
text.progress: Have you obtained the magenta fungus caps I need for my alchemical work? No caps - no reward!
text.completion: Well done $N, you've proven your worth once again! The caps will be an interesting study, yon verily!$B$BAnd now, as promised, enjoy a taste of one of my more potent restorative brews from my personal stock...$B$BIf you are a skilled alchemist, then perhaps we might have some additional business to conduct. Regardless, I thank you for your assistance!
text.completed: Return to Ghak Healtouch at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

text.title: Brotherhood of Thieves
text.objectives: Bring 8 Red Burlap Bandanas to Deputy Willem outside the Northshire Abbey.
text.description: Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around Northshire.  They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.$B$BI don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good!  Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.
text.progress: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
text.completion: Back with some bandanas, I see. The Stormwind Army appreciates your help.
text.completed: Return to Deputy Willem at Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: Tharil'zun
text.objectives: Bring Tharil'zun's Head to Marshal Marris in Redridge.
text.description: Blackrock Outrunners and Renegades are running ambushes between here and Stonewatch Keep.  The leader of the Outrunners is an orc named Tharil'zun--we want this orc.  Bring me the head of Tharil'zun!
text.progress: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense. But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?
text.completion: Tharil'zun was a vicious, crafty orc. Well done - I'm sure he didn't go down easy. Here is your reward, $N.
text.completed: Return to Marshal Marris at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: Blackrock Menace
text.objectives: Bring 10 Battleworn Axes to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
text.description: The Blackrock orcs have travelled from the Burning Steppes and claimed Stonewatch Keep to the north.  From there they maraud the areas north of Lakeshire and keep its citizens in town, penned like cattle.$B$BHelp rid Lakeshire of this menace.  Kill these Blackrock orcs and bring me ten of their Battleworn Axes as proof.$B$BAnd although Blackrocks threaten us from the north, we've received reports of more in the southeastern pocket of Redridge.  If you find any there, then they too should be hunted.
text.progress: Have you been slaying orcs, $N? If so, then show me...
text.completion: That makes for a lot fewer orcs to worry about, thanks.
text.completed: Return to Marshal Marris at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] Skirmish at Echo Ridge
text.objectives: Kill 8 Kobold Laborers, then return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey.
text.description: Your previous investigations are proof that the Echo Ridge Mine needs purging.  Return to the mine and help clear it of kobolds.$B$BWaste no time, $n.  The longer the kobolds are left unmolested in the mine, the deeper a foothold they gain in Northshire.
text.progress: I know it's bloody work, $N, but it's vital to the safety of Northshire. Are you ready to report?
text.completion: Once again, you have earned my respect, and the gratitude of the Stormwind Army. There may yet be kobolds in the mine, but I will marshal others against them. We have further tasks for you.
text.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: Goretusk Liver Pie
text.objectives: Salma Saldean needs 8 Goretusk livers to make a Goretusk Liver Pie.
text.description: The onions are peeled.  The garlic is minced.  The rosemary is crushed.  The crust has been baked.  The dill weed is chopped.  The gravy is simmering.  Now all I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
text.progress: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
text.completion: These are just perfect, $N! Thank you so much. Farmer Saldean and I are going to feast tonight. And here is a little something for you, for the hard work. You didn't think I was going to let a $C like you go hungry, did you?
text.completed: Return to Salma Saldean at Saldean's Farm in Westfall.

text.title: 乌萨苟斯的爪子
text.objectives: 将乌萨苟斯的爪子交给银风避难所的塔坎上尉。
text.description: 巨熊乌萨苟斯被你杀死了！$b$b它的爪上有一小块新月形的印记，这意味着它是由暗夜精灵训练来猎杀他们的敌人的。没人知道有多少部落同伴被它杀死了。$b$b你应该把这只爪子交给银风避难所的塔坎上尉，他会很高兴看到这头野兽已经不再是敌人可以运用的利器。
text.progress: Ah - $N - I was just thinking about you! How goes your hunting?
text.completion: Ah, the paw of Ursangous! Your skill is impressive, $C; he is credited with numerous kills. The crescent on his paw is no doubt a sign that he was trained by the night elves that skulk about Ashenvale. Ursangous is... was one of the mightiest bears you'd find in these parts. To have bested such a creature is a testament to your will and resolve.$b$bYour ancestors would be proud!

english.title: Ursangous' Paw
english.objectives: Bring Ursangous' Paw to Captain Tarkan at Silverwind Refuge.
english.description: The mighty bear Ursangous is no more!$b$bThe small quarter-crescent emblem on its paw indicates that this beast was trained by the night elves to prowl the forest in search of their enemies. There is no telling how many of your Horde allies fell to this creature.$B$BThe paw should be brought to Tarkan at Silverwind Refuge. He will be pleased that such a weapon has been removed from the enemy's arsenal.

text.title: 猎影的头
text.objectives: 将猎影的头交给地狱咆哮岗哨的塞娜尼·雷心。
text.description: 敏捷而强大的猎影静静地躺在地上，你取得了最后的胜利。$b$b这头传说中的野兽与暗夜精灵非常亲密。它的头颅是一件非常合适的战利品，也是联盟在灰谷全面溃败的象征。$b$b地狱咆哮岗哨的高戈斯上尉看到这只夜刃豹的头之后一定会很高兴的。
text.progress: Greetings once again, $N! Have you come to show me proof of your hunt?
text.completion: A victory for $N in the Ashenvale Hunt! Well done - the head of Shadumbra is a fitting trophy to claim for such an impressive fight, no doubt.$b$bShadumbra's savagery was well known throughout the post here. Any trip to the west, especially on foot trying to get out to the Zoram Strand, was wrought with danger because of this tiger. Thanks to you, this danger has abated.

english.title: Shadumbra's Head
english.objectives: Bring Shadumbra's Head to Captain Goggath at Hellscream's Watch.
english.description: The once swift Shadumbra now lies still as you claim victory over it.$b$bThis legenday creature is dear to the night elves. Its head should serve as an intimidating trophy, and as a sign of the end of the Alliance in Ashenvale.$b$bCaptain Goggath at Hellscream's Watch will no doubt be delighted to receive the head of the slain nightsaber.

text.title: 兔死狗烹
text.objectives: 银风避难所的塔坎上尉要你消灭密斯特拉湖的泰德雷斯以及12个污浊的水元素。
text.description: 你真该看看，$c！精灵们以为银风坚不可破。它固若金汤，还有一支水元素大军把守，似乎是很难攻下。$b$b但不是不可能攻下。$b$b我们的一个法师成功地召唤出了一只扭曲的元素，专门用来让其它的元素进入混乱的狂暴状态。$b$b啊，他们脸上的那表情！啧啧！$b$b<塔坎笑道。>$b$b可惜的是，召唤那只元素的法师在战场上阵亡了。现在我需要有人把我们的创造物消灭掉。
text.progress: You back already? What's the situation out there - all cleared up now, thanks to you?
text.completion: Yeah, I heard that someone tore up the lake out there like a dust devil through the Barrens. From the sound of it too, we might be able to set up a possible observation area out there to keep an eye on our Alliance friends. Well, that is if we can keep it on the down low...$B$BLooks like you ended up being quite useful after all; the transports between here and Stonetalon should have an easier time of it. Take this - you've earned it.

english.title: Simmer Down Now
english.objectives: Captain Tarkan at Silverwind Refuge wants you to defeat Tideress and 12 Befouled Water Elementals at Mystral Lake.
english.description: You should've seen it, $c!$b$bThe elves thought Silverwind to be impenetrable. With its heavy defenses and their army of water elementals, they were almost right.$b$bAlmost.$b$bOne of our mages was able to summon a twisted elemental designed to send the others into a chaotic rage.$b$bAhh, the looks on their faces!$b$b<Tarkan laughs.>$b$bUnfortunately, the mage who summoned it fell in battle. Now I need someone to bring down our creation.
english.progress: You back already? What's the situation out there - all cleared up now, thanks to you?
english.completion: Yeah, I heard that someone tore up the lake out there like a dust devil through the Barrens. From the sound of it too, we might be able to set up a possible observation area out there to keep an eye on our Alliance friends. Well, that is if we can keep it on the down low...$B$BLooks like you ended up being quite useful after all; the transports between here and Stonetalon should have an easier time of it. Take this - you've earned it.

text.title: A Lesson to Learn
text.objectives: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
text.description: $n, I have been following your progress with much delight.  You are most assuredly developing yourself into a valued protector of nature.$B$BThe time has come for you to learn more about one of the various animal aspects that Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to change into - one that affords you command and mastery of the water.  For this, you must travel to the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle there.  He will guide you further.
text.completion: Salutations, young $C; the time has come for you to know our aquatic form. It is one that lets you move freely and indefinitely through water. You will find this aspect a useful tool and a blessing... but it is one that must be earned before it is mastered.$B$BYou will face two trials to overcome. The first will test your ability to work in water under pressure. The second will test your resolve to understand the aspects of the form itself.$B$BStand ready, as the time of testing is now upon us.

text.title: Trial of the Lake
text.objectives: Find a Shrine Bauble in Lake Elune'ara, and take it to the Shrine of Remulos in northwestern Moonglade.  Once there, use the Shrine Bauble.$B$BYou must speak with Tajarri at the shrine afterwards in order to complete the trial.
text.description: For your first trial, search the depths of Lake Elune'ara to locate a Shrine Bauble.  It decays rapidly, so proceed with it to the Shrine of Remulos post haste.  Use the bauble at the shrine, and then speak with Tajarri there; she is one of Moonglade's most trusted wardens.$B$BYou only have a set amount of time to complete the task, and you may be competing against other druids searching for baubles themselves.  Mental and physical dexterity will be critical to your success.$B$BGood luck, $n.
text.completion: Well now. it looks like yet another druid has successfully completed the Trial of the Lake! Well done. my young friend - well done.$B$BAs I've said. my name is Tajarri. It is my duty and my privilege to serve as a warden for Moonglade. and specifically this shrine. Keeper Remulos guides the Cenarion Circle in preservation of nature and balance. and his shrine serves as a lasting tribute to such. By using the bauble here. it serves as a nod to the importance of this place within the Circle.
text.end: Complete the Trial of the Lake.
text.completed: Return to Tajarri at the Shrine of Remulos in Moonglade.

text.title: Trial of the Sea Lion
text.objectives: Find the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance.  Speak with the residents of Moonglade to learn clues as to where these items may be located.$B$BForm the Pendant of the Sea Lion from the two pendant halves.  You need to be in proximity of the Shrine of Remulos to do this.$B$BBring the joined pendant to Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
text.description: For the second trial, you'll need the two halves that make the Pendant of the Sea Lion.  One half draws power from the agility of the sea lion aspect, gliding through water; the other draws power from the incredible endurance of the sea lion aspect.  Druids draw on both these traits equally to embody the aspect of their aquatic form.$B$BSpeak with the locals of Moonglade to learn where the parts may lie, and bring both here to join them together.  Once formed, take the pendant to Dendrite Starblaze.
text.progress: Have you formed your pendant for me to inspect, $N? If you need help in locating the parts, try asking the local populace for information. Not only will you find what you seek, but it will give you a reason to explore this wondrous and sacred glade.
text.completion: You've completed the Trial of the Sea Lion, $N - congratulations.$B$BEach task in acquiring the pendant shows that both agility and endurance are necessary to act in harmony with what you desire to do underwater. Neither can exist without the other, and both cannot be done without you willingness to embrace the aspect of the sea lion.$B$BRemember these lessons well, and count on them once you have gained your aquatic form.
text.completed: Return to Dendrite Starblaze at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

text.title: Aquatic Form
text.objectives: Return to Thunder Bluff and show Turak Runetotem the Pendant of the Sea Lion.
text.description: You have completed the necessary lessons all young druids are taught before they can adopt an aquatic aspect.  Go now back to your trainer, Turak Runetotem, in Thunder Bluff.  Show him your pendant and prove to him you are ready to learn what he has to teach you.  He will complete your training, allowing you to become one with the water.$B$BGoodbye, young druid.  We shall speak again.
text.progress: Your return to Thunder Bluff is not without heralding, though I will need proof of your lessons learned in Moonglade before I will teach you your aquatic form.$B$BDo you have the Pendant of the Sea Lion?
text.completion: Very impressive, $N. Your ancestors would be pleased with your progress! You're ready to learn your aquatic form, and it is my pleasure to teach it to you.$B$BAlso, in recognition of your achievement during the two trials, I give you this item. I hope you'll find it to be a welcome addition to your gear as a protector of nature and a keeper of the balance.

text.title: Rise of the Silithid
text.objectives: Take the report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.
text.description: Here's your report.  I urge you to take it to someone who might have working knowledge in this kind of thing.$B$BI know this troll scholar named Zilzibin Drumlore.  He's spent a lot of time studying life forms that are unique to the ecology of Azeroth; he's a historian to boot!  If you want someone to help figure out what exactly this threat is and how to stop it, give this report to him.  We're going to need all the help we can get.$B$BZil lives in a house on the second tier of the Drag in Orgrimmar.

text.completion: This report... I've dealt with these beasts before. Fizzledowser was wise to send this. and you, to me.$b$bThese creatures will consume the Tanaris desert rapidly; they are nothing short of one of the greatest menaces we all will ever face. english.objectives: Take the report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.
english.description: Here's your report.  I urge you to take it to someone who might have working knowledge in this kind of thing.$B$BI know this troll scholar named Zilzibin Drumlore. text.title: [DEPRECATED] Wolves Across the Border
text.objectives: Bring 8 Diseased Wolf Pelts to Eagan Peltskinner outside Northshire Abbey.
text.description: Whatever is affecting these wolves isn't going away. Each day that passes brings forth more sick wolves. It pains me to ask anyone to kill nature's beasts, but we must destroy the diseased young wolves before this little outbreak turns into an epidemic.$B$BKill diseased young wolves in the valley and bring me their diseased wolf pelts as proof of your deed.
text.progress: Hey $N. How goes the hunt for diseased young wolves?
text.completion:
'Twas a grim task, friend, but you held up your part of the bargain.

I have some things here you might want - take your pick!
text.completed: Return to Eagan Peltskinner at Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: An Unwelcome Guest
text.objectives: Martie Jainrose of Lakeshire wants you to kill Bellygrub.  Bring her his tusk as proof.
text.description: Once again my garden was trampled and pillaged.  And I know the brute who is doing it.  It's that forsaken boar, the one Marshal Marris has taken to calling Bellygrub.$b$bI won't be able to re-plant the daffodils until next season now.  Ruined!  All ruined by that one menacing boar.  Put an end to that pest!  Show me his tusk and I'd be happy to reward you.  He seems to spend his time foraging in the field southwest of Lakeshire but occasionally he roams over here and into my garden.
text.progress: Is Bellygrub still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?
text.completion: Finally the menace is laid to rest! Thank you, $N, you have done me a great service. The garden shall be in full bloom this season!
text.completed: Return to Martie Jainrose at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: 卫兵托马斯
text.objectives: 治安官杜汉要你和卫兵托马斯谈一谈。
text.description: 如果你担心关于鱼人的传言可能属实的话，就去一趟艾尔文森林东部的桥边和卫兵托马斯谈谈吧。他最近一个星期都驻扎在那座桥边，应该很了解那个地区的情况。$B$B我有一匹暴风城军马，牠能够将你带到卫兵托马斯那里。如果你打算使用这匹马，就告诉我。
text.completion: Yes, murlocs have settled in and around the streams of eastern Elwynn. We don't know why they are here, but they are aggressive and at least semi-intelligent.

english.title: Further Concerns
english.objectives: Marshal Dughan wants you to speak with Guard Thomas.
english.description: If you are concerned that the rumors of murlocs are true, then do this -- travel to the eastern Elwynn bridge and speak with Guard Thomas.  He has been stationed at the bridge for the past week and will know the state of the area.$B$BI have here a Stormwind charger that will take you to Guard Thomas. Let me know if you wish to make use of the horse.
english.completion: Yes, murlocs have settled in and around the streams of eastern Elwynn. We don't know why they are here, but they are aggressive and at least semi-intelligent.

text.title: Westfall Stew
text.objectives: Verna Furlbrow wants you to deliver her recipe for Westfall Stew to Salma Saldean.
text.description: I never thought the day would come when I'd leave the farm.  But the fields are overrun with thieves and it's far too dangerous for us here now.  As soon as Farmer Furlbrow gets the wagon fixed, we'll be on our way.  $b $bMaybe you could do me a favor?  Let me scribble down my recipe for Westfall stew.  Please take it to Salma Saldean over on the farm yonder.  The Saldean's farm is just beyond the fork in the road.
text.progress: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much. I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
text.completion: That Verna was always such a sweet lass. We'll miss her here in Westfall but between you and me, she's a city girl at heart and Stormwind will suit her just fine. But enough gossip! Now we can make Westfall Stew!

text.title: 失踪的卫兵
text.objectives: 卫兵托马斯要你沿着河岸向北走，寻找两个失踪的卫兵罗尔夫和马拉凯。
text.description: 几天前，我派了卫兵罗尔夫和马拉凯沿着河岸去侦查这一代的情况，但他们到现在还没回来。我得先搞清楚这两个人发生什么事情才能完成报告。$B$B沿着河岸往北走，找到他们……或是他们的尸体。
text.completion: Although much has been stripped from the corpse, strewn nearby is a medallion with the words: "Footman Malakai Stone" etched upon it.

english.title: Find the Lost Guards
english.objectives: Guard Thomas wants you to travel north up the river and search for the two lost guards, Rolf and Malakai.
english.description: A few days ago we sent two Guards, Rolf and Malakai, to investigate along the river, and they have not yet returned.  To complete my report, I must know what happened to those men.$B$BTravel north along the river and find the guards... or their remains.
english.completion: Although much has been stripped from the corpse, strewn nearby is a medallion with the words: "Footman Malakai Stone" etched upon it.

text.title: Westfall Stew
text.objectives: Salma Saldean wants 3 Stringy Vulture Meat, 3 Goretusk Snouts, 3 Murloc Eyes, 3 Okra.
text.description: Help me make some Westfall Stew!  Come back with the following ingredients: $b $b 3 Stringy Vulture Meat $b 3 Goretusk Snouts $b 3 Murloc Eyes $b 3 Okra
text.progress: Come back with the following ingredients: $b $b 3 Stringy Vulture Meat $b 3 Goretusk Snouts $b 3 Murloc Eyes $b 3 Okra
text.completion: That Okra will thicken up this broth nicely! Now we just add the Stringy Vulture Meat, a few Murloc Eyes and those delicious Goretusk Snouts. And we're done! For all your help, $N, I want you to take today's first batch of Westfall Stew!
text.completed: Return to Salma Saldean at Saldean's Farm in Westfall.

text.title: Deliver Thomas' Report
text.objectives: Report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
text.description: Tell Marshal Dughan of Malakai and Rolf's deaths, and report to him that the Murlocs in eastern Elwynn cannot be contained by our current troop presence.$B$BI know we don't have many troops to spare, but hopefully Dughan can find someone.
text.completion: Hmm, this news is troubling. Already our defenses are stretched thin, and losing Rolf and Malakai to those murlocs put us in an even worse position.$B$BIf things don't improve, there will be fighting in Goldshire by the week's end!

text.title: 鱼人的威胁
text.objectives: 雷米要你去和闪金镇的治安官杜汉谈一谈。
text.description: $n，艾尔文森林又遇到新的威胁了！鱼人正陆续从艾尔文森林东部的河流里游过来，把鱼都给吓跑了，而且它们还攻击平民！$B$B我已经向治安官杜汉发出过警告，不过他显然更担心那些豺狼人和强盗，而且他不相信鱼人能对我们构成威胁。$B$B请你和杜汉谈谈吧，最好能说服他向东部派遣更多部队！
text.completion: Yes, I spoke with Remy. I respect him as a merchant, though all reports of Murlocs to the east have been sketchy at best.$B$BYour concerns are noted, but unless I receive a military report of a murloc threat, we can't afford to send more troops east.

english.title: A Fishy Peril
english.objectives: Remy "Two Times" wants you to speak with Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
english.description: $n, there's a new threat in Elwynn Forest!  Murlocs are swimming up the streams of eastern Elwynn, scaring away fish and attacking gentle folk!$B$BI warned Marshal Dughan, but he's more worried about the gnolls and the bandits.  He's not convinced that the murlocs are a danger.$B$BPlease, $n, speak to Dughan and persuade him to send more troops to the east!
english.completion: Yes, I spoke with Remy. I respect him as a merchant, though all reports of Murlocs to the east have been sketchy at best.$B$BYour concerns are noted, but unless I receive a military report of a murloc threat, we can't afford to send more troops east.

text.title: 罗尔夫的下落
text.objectives: 到鱼人村去寻找罗尔夫，或是他死亡的消息。
text.description: 进一步检查这个地区之后，你发现有蹼状的脚印沿着石碑湖岸一直向北延伸。在东边远处，你隐隐约约看见有一个鱼人的村落。$B$B也许罗尔夫就在那儿丧了命……
text.completion: You find around the neck of the corpse a metal medallion inscribed with the words "Footman Rolf Hartford."

english.title: Discover Rolf's Fate
english.objectives: Search the murloc village for Rolf, or signs of his death.
english.description: Upon further searching the area, you find webbed footprints leading east along the shore of Stone Cairn Lake.  In the distance to the east, you can just barely see a Murloc village.$B$BPerhaps Rolf's fate ended there...
english.completion: You find around the neck of the corpse a metal medallion inscribed with the words "Footman Rolf Hartford."

text.title: 悬赏鱼人
text.objectives: 给艾尔文森林东部的桥边的卫兵托马斯带去8个破损的鱼人鳞片。
text.description: 暴风城军队悬赏清除那些艾尔文森林内的鱼人潜伏者和鱼人强盗。杀了它们，把它们破损的鱼人鳞片给我带回来，暴风城军队会奖励你的。$B$B鱼人在北面的石碑湖附近建造了一座村庄，另外在南面的溪流分叉处还有一座村庄。
text.progress: How goes the hunting, $N?
text.completion: You have the fins? Great! Marshal Dughan is anxious about the Murloc situation in eastern Elwynn, and I'd like to tell him that it's becoming under control.$b$bYour actions have helped realize that.
text.completed: Return to Guard Thomas in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Bounty on Murlocs
english.objectives: Bring 8 Torn Murloc Fins to Guard Thomas at the east Elwynn bridge.
english.description: The Stormwind Army has placed a bounty on murloc lurkers and foragers in Elwynn.  Slaughter them and bring Guard Thomas their torn murloc fins, and the Stormwind Army will reward you well.$B$BThe murlocs have built a village at Stone Cairn Lake north of here, and another to the south where the stream forks.
english.progress: How goes the hunting, $N?
english.completion: You have the fins? Great! Marshal Dughan is anxious about the Murloc situation in eastern Elwynn, and I'd like to tell him that it's becoming under control.$b$bYour actions have helped realize that.
english.completed: Return to Guard Thomas in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 金砂交易
text.objectives: 为闪金镇的雷米收集10袋金砂，这种东西可以从艾尔文森林的狗头人身上找到。
text.description: 这一带的狗头人有时会带着金砂出来活动。我真的很需要这些金砂……给我找一些来，我会以镇子里最高的收购价格买下来——最高的价格！$B$B你可以在南边的法戈第矿洞里和东北方的玉石矿洞周围找到狗头人。
text.progress: Psst! You have that Gold Dust for me...for me?
text.completion: Thanks for the dust, $N. Here's your cash, and...here is a token from associates of mine. You might find it useful...useful.
text.completed: Return to Remy "Two Times" at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Gold Dust Exchange
english.objectives: Bring 10 Gold Dust to Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire.  Gold Dust is gathered from Kobolds in Elwynn Forest.
english.description: The kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them.  I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...best price in town!$B$BYou can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.
english.progress: Psst! You have that Gold Dust for me...for me?
english.completion: Thanks for the dust, $N. Here's your cash, and...here is a token from associates of mine. You might find it useful...useful.
english.completed: Return to Remy "Two Times" at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: Sweet Amber
text.objectives: Bring Holy Spring Water to Grimbooze Thunderbrew.
text.description: In the land to the south where vines twist and creep$bLies a hidden well where the water runs deep$bPure as the Light's sacred Daughter$bBring to me now some Holy Spring Water.
text.progress: Hiccup! Ho ho! You want an encore?$B$BIn the land to the south where vines twist and creep$BLies a hidden well where the water runs deep$BPure as the Light's sacred Daughter$BBring to me now some Holy Spring Water.
text.completion: Hiccup! Ho Ho!
text.completed: Return to Grimbooze Thunderbrew at the Dagger Hills in Westfall.

text.description: Amber is the hue of my life's longest love$bLike the last embers of dusk in the sky above$bRetrieve for me so that my love shall be born$bOne sack of each: barley, rye and corn.

text.objectives: Bring a Sycamore Branch to Grimbooze Thunderbrew.
text.description: Not yet filtered but freshly distilled$bLike unseeded land waiting there tilled.$bNext I will fashion our pile of charcoal$bDeliver a sycamore branch, that is your next goal.

text.title: 保卫边境
text.objectives: 杀掉8只觅食的灰狼或森林灰狼，以及5只森林熊幼崽，然后回到艾尔文森林东部的桥边去见卫兵托马斯。
text.description: 你好，$n。我们离开闪金镇越远，在森林里遇到的野生动物就越凶猛。东谷伐木场几乎每天都要受到狼和熊的攻击！$B$B我们需要你的帮助。
text.progress: Have you killed those wolves and bears?
text.completion: Thanks a lot for the help, $N. Something in the forest must be making these animals so bold.$B$BWhatever it is, I hope it stays there.
text.completed: Return to Guard Thomas in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Protect the Frontier
english.objectives: Kill 8 Prowlers or Gray Forest Wolves and 5 Young Forest Bears, and then return to Guard Thomas at the east Elwynn bridge.
english.description: Hail, $n.  Wild animals are growing more and more aggressive the farther we get from Goldshire, and the Eastvale Logging Camp suffers nearly constant attacks from wolves and bears!$B$BWe could use your help out here.
english.progress: Have you killed those wolves and bears?
english.completion: Thanks a lot for the help, $N. Something in the forest must be making these animals so bold.$B$BWhatever it is, I hope it stays there.
english.completed: Return to Guard Thomas in Elwynn Forest.

text.objectives: Bring Grimbooze Thunderbrew a bundle of Charred Oak.
text.description: Mellifluous liquid clear as a baby's tears$bTurns a lovely deep amber over the years$bBut before we proceed to get lit to the hilt$bA barrel of charred oak must be built.
text.progress: Sure, I'll sing it again for you, friend!$B$BMellifluous liquid clear as a baby's tears$BTurns a lovely deep amber over the years$BBut before we proceed to get lit to the hilt$BA barrel of charred oak must be built.

text.title: 去闪金镇报到
text.objectives: 将治安官玛克布莱德的文件带给艾尔文森林中闪金镇的治安官杜汉。
text.description: $n，如今你已经被证实是一位非常关心北郡的安全的$c了。现在我要派遣你去保卫艾尔文森林的周边地区。$B$B如果你接下了这个任务，就把这些文件送到闪金镇的治安官杜汉手里。沿着向南的大道走，穿过北郡的关卡就能看到闪金镇了。
text.progress: You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.$B$BHere, let me have his papers...
text.completion: Well, it says here that you've been awarded Acting Deputy Status with the Stormwind Marshals.  Congratulations.$B$BAnd good luck - keeping Elwynn safe is no picnic... what with most the army busy doing who knows what for who knows which noble!$B$BIt's hard to keep track of politics in these dark days...

english.title: Report to Goldshire
english.objectives: Take Marshal McBride's Documents to Marshal Dughan at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.
english.description: $n, you are a $c with proven interest in the security of Northshire.  You are now tasked with the protection of the surrounding Elwynn Forest.$B$BIf you accept this duty, then I have prepared papers that must be delivered to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.  Goldshire lies along the southern road, past the border gates.
english.progress: You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.$B$BHere, let me have his papers...
english.completion: Well, it says here that you've been awarded Acting Deputy Status with the Stormwind Marshals.  Congratulations.$B$BAnd good luck - keeping Elwynn safe is no picnic... what with most the army busy doing who knows what for who knows which noble!$B$BIt's hard to keep track of politics in these dark days...

text.title: Morbent Fel
text.objectives: Use Morbent's Bane on Morbent Fel, kill Morbent Fel, then return Morbent's Bane to Sven at his camp.
text.description: Morbent Fel hides in his lair, the house perched atop the hill to the east overlooking the Raven Hill cemetery.  His time in this land is drawing to an end...$B$BUse Morbent's Bane against him.  It will render his protective magics powerless.$B$BSlay him.  Slay him, and save us from his wickedness.  Be the instrument of my revenge, and a hero of Duskwood!
text.progress: Is Morbent Fel defeated?!
text.completion: Morbent Fel has been defeated. The dark riders are still at large, but a small piece of that which I had hoped beyond hope has come to pass.$b$bYou have done the impossible, and your deeds will forever live in the legends of Duskwood.$b$bGo, $N. And perhaps, one day, fate may bring you back to me...
text.completed: Return to Sven Yorgen at The Hushed Bank in Duskwood.

text.title: The Night Watch
text.objectives: Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages.
text.description: As Commander of The Night Watch it is my sworn duty to protect the citizens of Darkshire.  Stormwind has retracted their commissioned guards from their posts here, leaving us to our own devices.$b$bIf you feel worthy of the task, we need your help! Assist The Night Watch by venturing forth into Tranquil Gardens, just south of Darkshire, and slaying 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages.  The undead threat must be thwarted!
text.progress: Have you killed those warriors and mages?
text.completion: Splendid, $N. For your service to the people of Darkshire you shall be rewarded.
text.completed: Return to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: The Night Watch
text.objectives: Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 15 Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors.
text.description: $n, I'm getting reports of an undead infestation in the forest!  If you're up to the job, journey to the Raven Hill graveyard and slay 15 of those vile Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors.  There are also reports of skeletons just south of Darkshire, in and around Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.  The undead must be driven from Duskwood!
text.progress: Return to me once you have killed 15 Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors, $N.
text.completion: The people of Darkshire thank you, $N. You have proven yourself to be a great ally of The Night Watch.
text.completed: Return to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: The Night Watch
text.objectives: Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 20 Plague Spreaders in the eastern Raven Hill mausoleum.
text.description: The situation in Raven Hill is still grim.  The safety of Darkshire is in your hands, $n.  I don't have enough Watchers to keep the town safe.  We need you to dispatch for Raven Hill yet again and rid the eastern mausoleum of 20 Plague Spreaders!
text.progress: I need your assistance, $N. Travel to the cemetery to the northwest and rid the eastern mausoleum of 20 Plague Spreaders.$B$BReturn to me when your task is complete.
text.completion: On behalf of the people of Darkshire and as the Leader of the Night Watch, I thank you, $N, for your bravery and dedication. May the Light shine upon your ways.
text.completed: Return to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: 布甲和皮甲
text.objectives: 把暴风城护甲标记交给萨拉·迪博雷恩。
text.description: 为了表彰你的智慧和勇敢，我把这个标记给你，用在护甲上应该很不错。你把它交给东谷伐木场的萨拉·迪博雷恩，她会为你做件合适的护甲。这件护甲在你为保卫艾尔文森林作战时应该用得到，$n。$B$B东谷就在这个哨所的东边，桥对面。
text.progress: I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.$b$bIf you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
text.completion: Ah, thank you for the marker. Please feel free to pick your choice of armor.$b$bLuck to you, brave $C. And may this armor serve you well.

english.title: Cloth and Leather Armor
english.objectives: Give Sara Timberlain the Stormwind Armor Marker.
english.description: For your shrewdness and valor, I have a marker here that is good for one piece of armor.  I want you to take it to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp.  Give her the marker, and she will fashion the armor for you.  And after you receive it, $n, use it in the defense of Elwynn.$B$BEastvale is just east of this post across the bridge.
english.progress: I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.$b$bIf you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
english.completion: Ah, thank you for the marker. Please feel free to pick your choice of armor.$b$bLuck to you, brave $C. And may this armor serve you well.

text.title: 狗头人的蜡烛
text.objectives: 为闪金镇的威廉·匹斯特收集8支大蜡烛。
text.description: 你好，$g亲爱的先生:尊贵的女士;！你有时间吗？$B$B我和我兄弟在暴风城开了个药店，而我现在正要在这一带找些大蜡烛，以便提取其中的蜡。你能帮助我吗？$B$B你可以在狗头人身上找到大蜡烛，我听说在艾尔文森林的矿洞一带有很多狗头人……在南边的法戈第矿洞和东边的玉石矿洞里都有不少。我建议你到这两个地方中的一个去看看。
text.progress: Did you gather those candles yet?
text.completion: You were busy hunting kobolds, were you? Thanks for the candles, $N, and here's your reward...
text.completed: Return to William Pestle at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Kobold Candles
english.objectives: Bring 8 Large Candles to William Pestle in Goldshire.
english.description: Hello, $ggood sir:my lady;!  Do you have a moment?$B$BMy brother and I run an apothecary in Stormwind, and I'm here to gather large candles for their wax.  Can you help me?$B$BYou can get large candles from kobolds, and I hear rumors that kobolds are infesting the Elwynn mines... the Fargodeep Mine to the south and Jasperlode Mine to the east.  I suggest looking for candles in one of those places.
english.progress: Did you gather those candles yet?
english.completion: You were busy hunting kobolds, were you? Thanks for the candles, $N, and here's your reward...
english.completed: Return to William Pestle at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: Shipment to Stormwind
text.objectives: Bring William's Shipment to Morgan Pestle in the Stormwind Trade District.
text.description: My brother Morgan is waiting in Stormwind for my shipment of candles.  I don't have enough time to make the trip myself, but if you'd like to take him the shipment, he'll pay you well.$B$BI've packed up the candles, and you can find Morgan in our shop, Pestle's Apothecary, in the Stormwind Trade District.
text.progress: Oh, a shipment from my brother? Splendid! Fortune truly shines on me today!
text.completion: Here is your payment ... and while you're here, take a look around! I'm sure we have a potion or other trinket you'd find useful.

text.title: 法戈第矿洞
text.objectives: 调查法戈第矿洞，然后回到闪金镇去见治安官杜汉。
text.description: 出问题的还不止北郡的矿洞！我接到报告说艾尔文森林的法戈第矿洞已经成了狗头人的天堂。$B$B去那里查看一下这些报告是否属实，然后回来告诉我。法戈第矿洞就在闪金镇的正南方，斯通菲尔德农场和马科伦农场之间。
text.progress: What do you have to report, $N? Have you been to the Fargodeep Mine?
text.completion: This is bad news. What's next, dragons?!? We'll have to increase our patrols near that mine. Thanks for your efforts, $N. And hold a moment... I might have another task for you.
text.completed: Return to Marshal Dughan at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: The Fargodeep Mine
english.objectives: Explore the Fargodeep Mine, then return to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
english.description: The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems!  I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.$B$BExplore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me.  The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
english.progress: What do you have to report, $N? Have you been to the Fargodeep Mine?
english.completion: This is bad news. What's next, dragons?!? We'll have to increase our patrols near that mine. Thanks for your efforts, $N. And hold a moment... I might have another task for you.
english.completed: Return to Marshal Dughan at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: Call of Water
text.objectives: Defeat the Corrupt Manifestation of Water and place the Corrupted Manifestation's Bracers along with the Remaining Drops of Purest Water on the Brazier of Everfount in Silverpine Forest.
text.description: Along the coast of Silverpine, west of the Sepulcher, you will find a shrine that has become tainted by the plague. The spirits there no longer speak to our people and it will be up to you to defeat the manifestation and cleanse the pool.$B$BTake the elemental's bracers, along with the remaining drops of Brine's potion, and place them on the brazier. The ritual should be enough to summon a pure spirit for you to communicate with.$B$BBring me proof the task is done, and I will reward you with your totem.
text.progress: The brazier still reflects the ambient light from the are, and the flame shifts slightly as you move closer.$B$BThe corruption along the hills seems to have kept its distance, and besides the missing components, the brazier looks prepared for the ritual to summon a cleansed manifestation of water.
text.completion: You place the bracers atop the brazier and then pour the remaining drops of Brine's potion into the flame. The drops crackle as they hit the flame and you begin to incant the simple words Islen taught you....
text.completed: Seek out the Brazier of Everfount at North Tide's Run in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: The Forgotten Heirloom
text.objectives: Farmer Furlbrow wants you to retrieve his pocket watch from the wardrobe in his farmhouse at the pumpkin farm to the West.
text.description: It was horrible!  Verna woke me when she heard a ruckus in the fields.  The fields were full of hooligans.  We left in a rush and I forgot to pack my pocket watch.  Verna's pa gave me that watch on our wedding day and I feel just sick knowing those thieves have it.  I left the pocket watch in the wardrobe at the farmhouse.  Look for the field of pumpkins to the West -- you can't miss it.  If you bring it back to me, I'd sure be grateful!
text.progress: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
text.completion: My watch! Thank you so much, kind sir! $b$bWe are but poor farmers and we have lost our land but please accept this reward as a token of our appreciation.
text.completed: Return to Farmer Furlbrow at the Jansen Stead in Westfall.

text.title: The Defias Brotherhood
text.objectives: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to talk to Wiley in Lakeshire.
text.description: The band of wretches responsible for driving the good people of Westfall from the land call themselves The Defias Brotherhood.  I need you to infiltrate this clan of thugs.  We need to know who heads up the cartel and where they are hiding out.  In Lakeshire, in the inn, there is a rogue by the name of Wiley who owes me a favor.$b$bTravel to Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, east of Elwynn, and find out what you can.
text.completion: So, Stoutmantle sent you? Well, I owe him.

text.title: The Legend of Stalvan
text.objectives: Seek out the Clerk Daltry in the Darkshire Town Hall.
text.description: Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins.  I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger.  I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.$b$bAfter taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery.  A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.$b$bSeek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character.  I fear for us all.
text.completion: Ah so Madame Eva sent you....

text.title: [DEPRECATED]The Legend of Stalvan
text.objectives: Travel to the Moonbrook Schoolhouse and bring back any updated information about Stalvan to Clerk Daltry.
text.description: Stalvan, eh?  Let me check the town registry.$b$bStalvan. . .Stalvan. . .let's see.  Ah, here we go!  I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle.  The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse.  My, talk about outdated!$b$bDo me a favor will you, friend?  If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow.  I like to keep the records clean.
text.completion: The old footlocker creaks open. . . .

text.objectives: Take the Dusty Unsent Letter to Clerk Daltry.
text.description: You find a Dusty Unsent Letter in the old footlocker.
text.progress: Ah, I remember you. You're the one who was asking about that Stalvan fellow. Did you ever find what you were looking for?
text.completion: Interesting. So the chap did spend some time in Moonbrook after all. It is rather odd the letter never got delivered. Nonetheless, I shall update the registry.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]The Legend of Stalvan
text.objectives: Go to The Lion's Pride Inn to see if anyone there has heard of the name Stalvan.
text.description: Oh my!  Must have missed this the first time.  In the registry, right beneath the first address for Stalvan there's another one listed, only partially scratched out.  Looks like he was headed to The Lion's Pride Inn over in Goldshire.  Might want to check there, $n.
text.completion: Stalvan? Sure sounds familiar.

text.title: The Legend of Stalvan
text.objectives: Retrieve Stalvan's Undelivered Letter from the chest and deliver it to the Canal District in Stormwind.
text.description: The name Stalvan rings a bell.  I remember now.$b$bMany years back, on a stormy night, a messenger came in, seeking refuge for the night.  Near the stroke of midnight, the man ran down the stairs screaming, his face pale with fear.  Still wearing his bedclothes, he disappeared into the downpour.$b$bIn his haste he forgot his letters in the chest upstairs.  He never returned for them. One remains from that Stalvan fellow, intended for the Canal District in Stormwind.  Help yourself to it.
text.progress: What have ya got there? Let me take a look at that. . .
text.completion: You've got some nerve bringing this here.
text.completed: Speak to Caretaker Folsom in Stormwind City.

text.title: 回复托马斯
text.objectives: 把罗尔夫和马拉凯的铭牌交给艾尔文森林东部桥边的卫兵托马斯。
text.description: 把你找到的两块铭牌交给桥边的卫兵托马斯，让他知道两个卫兵的死讯。
text.progress: Hello, $N. Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
text.completion: You have confirmed my fears, $N. The murlocs are a threat we cannot ignore.

english.title: Report to Thomas
english.objectives: Deliver Rolf and Malakai's Medallions to Guard Thomas at the eastern Elwynn bridge.
english.description: Now that you have both medallions, deliver them to Guard Thomas at the bridge so that he might know the fate of his murdered guards.
english.progress: Hello, $N. Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
english.completion: You have confirmed my fears, $N. The murlocs are a threat we cannot ignore.

text.title: The Legend of Stalvan
text.objectives: Search through the packed up possessions for a clue.
text.description: My father was the caretaker of the estate long before I was.  He had to mop the blood up after the massacre.  But that's neither here nor there.$b$bThe last funds of the Flintridge trust have dried up.  Now the last of the family possessions are headed for auction.  Blame the tax vultures.  I guess if you're really itching to learn more you're free to look through this junk.  Who knows what you might find.
text.completion: You slowly slide the lid of the crate off. . . .

text.title: The Legend of Stalvan
text.objectives: The Torn Journal page you discovered provides your next clue.
text.description: Inside the crate you find various objects: musty heirlooms, a family portrait, a few hunting trophies and some old books.  Near the bottom, underneath a ceramic vase, you uncover A Torn Journal Page.
text.progress: What have you got there? I cannot see. My eyesight is very bad. Put it in my hands.
text.completion: I can barely make out those letters. But that writing style reminds me of something I once saw before my vision became so poor.

text.title: The Legend of Stalvan
text.objectives: Marshal Haggard wants you to check the chest upstairs for the Faded Journal Page.
text.description: There was a bundle of parchments in the chest upstairs when I moved into this place.  I looked at them once when I first arrived but I gave up once the fog hazed over my peepers. $b$bDo an old, nearly-blind man a favor and check the chest upstairs for anything that might help you in your quest to discover more about this Stalvan character.  I'm pretty sure there's a faded journal page that might be of interest to you.  Bring it to me and I'll help in anyway I can.
text.progress: Did you find that page I mentioned, $N?
text.completion: You found it!
text.completed: Return to Marshal Haggard at Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 玉石矿洞
text.objectives: 查看玉石矿洞，然后回到闪金镇去向治安官杜汉报告。
text.description: 多亏了你，我们才知道法戈第矿洞里出现了很多狗头人。现在我们还需要一个人去更远处的玉石矿洞侦察。$B$B去查看一下玉石矿洞，确定那里是否有狗头人。向东沿着大路走，一直走到阿祖拉之塔，然后往北走就会看到山脚下的矿洞。
text.progress: Hail, $N. What do you have to report? Have you scouted the Jasperlode Mine?
text.completion: Kobolds at the Jasperlode Mine, you say? Curses! The situation is worsening by the minute!$B$BThank you for the report, $N. But I wish that the news you brought was good news.
text.completed: Return to Marshal Dughan at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: The Jasperlode Mine
english.objectives: Explore the Jasperlode Mine, then report back to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
english.description: Thanks to you we know the Fargodeep Mine is infested with kobolds.  Now we need a scout to investigate the more distant Jasperlode Mine.$B$BExplore Jasperlode and confirm any kobold presence.  To reach the mine, travel east along the road until you reach the Tower of Azora.  From the tower, head north and you'll find the mine in the foothills.

text.title: A Sticky Situation
text.objectives: Recover 10 bottles of Hinterlands Honey Ripple from the crates located around the abandoned Horde base in Skulk Rock.
text.description: I possess original packaging materials for the ripple Dran Droffers seeks.  I will assist you in packaging the ripple for Malton's abrasive father... for a fee of two additional bottles of said ripple.  They are located in crates found in the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock.$B$BIt will be an arduous task, to wit; foul slimes and oozes will be found sticking to the ruins; rumor has it they are led by some sort of master ooze.  Regardless, procure the ripple and return to me here for packaging.
text.progress: I trust that your arrival here at our camp is to deliver the bottles of ripple that are integral to the task at hand, yes?
text.completion: Finely executed, $N. I am glad you had enough foresight not to bruise the delicacy of the ripple. There is nothing worse than the bouquet of ripple that has been jostled about needlessly.$b$bIt will take a moment for the magic to be wrought over this precious cargo. Actually, no magic is involved; I merely have some empty packaging for Hinterlands Honey Ripple. Our chicanery shall turn these bottles into an alcoholic treasure of the ages.$b$bOnward - for great booze!
text.completed: Return to Gilveradin Sunchaser at Shindigger's Camp in the Hinterlands.

text.title: The Legend of Stalvan
text.objectives: Take the Faded Journal Page to Tavernkeep Smitts at Darkshire in Duskwood.
text.description: I know of someone who might be able to assist you.  Back when I was leading the Stormwind Guard, we used to get drinks at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire.  The Innkeeper there, Smitts, was quite an expert on the local lore.  Show him this page and see what he has to say about it.
text.progress: Marshal Haggard sent you? Why didn't you say so?$B$BAh, good ol' Haggard. Poor chap is going to be completely blind before long. Anyway, let me see what you've got there.
text.completion: By the Light! You bet I recognize that handwriting.

text.title: The Legend of Stalvan
text.objectives: Take the muddy page to Commander Ebonlocke.
text.description: I followed the legend of that Stalvan character for years.  When those visiting nobles were slaughtered a few years back I went with Haggard to investigate.  I found these muddy pages but we were never able to link the handwriting to that crazy man in the woods.  Your trail of evidence proves his guilt.  Take this to Commander Ebonlocke immediately and fill her in on what you've discovered!
text.progress: This better be good, $C. Let me see what you have and tell me your tale. But by the Light, be quick about it. Darkshire's defense is my number one priority. I have not the time to squander on dead-end leads.
text.completion: My, you have proved yourself to be quite a detective, $C.

enders.name: 指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

text.title: The Legend of Stalvan
text.objectives: Show Clerk Daltry the Bloodstained Journal Page.
text.description: I have had my eye on that creep, Stalvan, for quite sometime.  But if this page was written by the same hand it proves his guilt beyond a shadow of a doubt.$b$bIn all his days keeping the Town Registry, Clerk Daltry has become an expert at identifying handwriting.  Show him this page and see if the writing matches that of the registry signature.
text.progress: Back again, $N? What do you have this time?
text.completion: Why yes! The writing on this page does in fact match that of the registry signatures.

text.title: Ripple Delivery
text.objectives: Deliver the barrel to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.
text.description: I have taken the extra step of securing not only Dran's packaged ripple in the barrel, but also the extra bottles of ripple he is purloining.  While I may not hold Dran very highly, there is nothing worse than jostled ripple.  You're welcome.$B$BNow, deliver yon barrel to Dran Droffers in his salvage emporium in Orgrimmar.  Pray tell, please extend my warmest greetings to Malton; let him know that should he ever thirst for fine drink and finer drinking companions, we would be honored with his visit.
text.progress: If you're not here to buy anything, and you're not here to deliver anything, then you're wasting my time! You better have that ripple!
text.completion: Well, let's see what's in this barrel!$b$bYes, yes, it looks as though it is all here. Here's your fee for the package, good job on that. I stand to make five times that fee when I sell it to the tavern! Har har!$b$bThese extra bottles of Hinterlands Honey Ripple are going to be set for a special occasion. I think I'll drink some with champagne. I'll call it... champipple.

text.title: Noxious Lair Investigation
text.objectives: Bring five Centipaar insect parts from the Noxious Lair to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
text.description: All right now, these reports about the bugs... what we know is that they are draining the water pools that used to be where the Noxious Lair is. What we DON'T know is, well, everything else.$B$BLet's figure out who our enemy is first! I want you to head into the Noxious Lair and get some parts off of those critters. Get five from the Centipaar there and bring them to Alchemist Pestlezugg for him to dink with. With him on the case, we'll figure out what they are!
text.progress: You're Junior Surveyor $N, yes? Quickly now, there is a dire situation at hand! Do you have the insect parts that Fizzledowser said you would?!
text.completion: Good work - I'll start my analysis on these now! I can tell you right from the start though... these are nothing like any insect form I have ever seen. It's almost as if these bugs are being controlled by an outside force or something.$b$bYou need to go talk to Fizzledowser right away; apparently there is an emergency that he needs your help with on the double! I'm not sure, but I think it involves more of the bugs in the Tanaris desert!
text.completed: Return to Alchemist Pestlezugg at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

text.title: 优质亚麻产品
text.objectives: 给东谷伐木场的萨拉·迪博雷恩带去6张亚麻布块。
text.description: 艾尔文森林的迪菲亚盗贼穿着亚麻面料的衣服，我可以用这些优质的亚麻布做些东西。$B$B给我找些亚麻布块来，我可以帮你做几件。$B$B艾尔文森林里有许多迪菲亚盗贼出没。
text.progress: I'm running low on linen, $N. Do you have any for me?
text.completion: Ah, these are nice bandanas, if a little rough...$b$bHere you are!
text.completed: Return to Sara Timberlain at Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Fine Linen Goods
english.objectives: Bring 6 Linen Scraps to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp.
english.description: The thugs in Elwynn wear linen which I can use to make fine linen goods.$B$BBring me linen scraps and I'll use them to fashion something for you.$B$BYou'll find those lawless criminals in pockets across Elwynn Forest.
english.progress: I'm running low on linen, $N. Do you have any for me?
english.completion: Ah, these are nice bandanas, if a little rough...$b$bHere you are!
english.completed: Return to Sara Timberlain at Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 比利的馅饼
text.objectives: 把猪肉馅饼带给马科伦农场的比利·马科伦。
text.description: 这是你要的馅饼。把这东西交给那个比利的时候，别忘了告诉他我希望他吃了噎死！
text.progress: Ugh... I'm starving! Do you have that pie for me, $N?
text.completion: Mm, yum! This pie is the best!$b$bI think my memory is coming back to me...

english.title: Back to Billy
english.objectives: Bring the Pork Belly Pie to Billy Maclure at the Maclure Vineyards.
english.description: Here you go.  And when you give this pie to that Billy, you tell him I hope he chokes on it!
english.progress: Ugh... I'm starving! Do you have that pie for me, $N?
english.completion: Mm, yum! This pie is the best!$b$bI think my memory is coming back to me...

starters.name: 波尼斯·斯通菲尔德姑妈

text.title: 丢失的项链
text.objectives: 和比利·马科伦谈一谈。
text.description: 我的项链丢了，一定是那个讨厌鬼比利·马科伦偷走的！他总是像只老鼠一样在东边的马科伦农场里窜来窜去。$B$B请把我的项链拿回来给我，让我这可怜的寡妇得到一些安慰吧。
text.completion: You lost a what? Well I didn't take no necklace, because I ain't no thief!$b$bI might know who did but...<grin>...I'm too hungry to remember.

english.title: Lost Necklace
english.objectives: Speak with Billy Maclure.
english.description: I lost my necklace and I think that guttersnipe Billy Maclure took it!  He's usually scuttling like a rat around the Maclure Vineyards east of here. $B$BGet my necklace back for me and you'll warm an old widow's heart.
english.completion: You lost a what? Well I didn't take no necklace, because I ain't no thief!$b$bI might know who did but...<grin>...I'm too hungry to remember.

starters.name: 波尼斯·斯通菲尔德姑妈

text.title: 比利的馅饼
text.objectives: 给斯通菲尔德农场的波尼斯·斯通菲尔德带去4块嫩野猪肉。
text.description: 给我吃点馅饼，也许我就能想起来是谁拿着项链了。我知道另一个农场里的波尼斯老太太做的猪肉馅饼很棒……$B$B我们的农场周围有野猪，如果你能给她找些鲜嫩的野猪肉，她就应该会给你烤一块馅饼。
text.progress: I don't think it's right feeding the boy who stole my necklace in the first place, but if that's what it takes to get back what's mine, then so be it!$b$bDo you have that boar meat?
text.completion: Though this wild boar meat is tough, simmer it enough and it sure does make for some tasty pie!
text.completed: Return to "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Pie for Billy
english.objectives: Bring 4 Tender Boar Meat to Auntie Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield's Farm.
english.description: Maybe if I got a pie, I could tell you who has that necklace.  And you know, I think that old Bernice lady at that other farm makes great Pork Belly Pies... $B$BMaybe if you gave her some tender boar meat from the boars that hang around our farms, and told her what it was for, she'd bake up a pie for you.
english.progress: I don't think it's right feeding the boy who stole my necklace in the first place, but if that's what it takes to get back what's mine, then so be it!$b$bDo you have that boar meat?
english.completion: Though this wild boar meat is tough, simmer it enough and it sure does make for some tasty pie!
english.completed: Return to "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest.

enders.name: 波尼斯·斯通菲尔德姑妈

text.title: 金牙
text.objectives: 把波尼斯的项链带给斯通菲尔德农场的波尼斯·斯通菲尔德。
text.description: 我在法戈第矿洞旁边玩的时候，不小心丢了那串，呃……我是说我看见了那个老太太的项链。别问我它怎么会在那儿……和我没关系！$B$B不管怎样，我看到一个很壮实的镶着金牙的狗头人……他把项链捡起来跑到矿洞上方的巢穴里了。你去找那个狗头人吧，我发誓，你肯定能在他身上找到项链的！
text.progress: Hello, $N. Have you found my necklace?
text.completion: Oh, you found it! Thank you, thank you dear!$B$BHere, take this. It was my husband's and he always said it was lucky. If only he didn't forget it on his last campaign! *sniff*
text.completed: Return to "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Goldtooth
english.objectives: Bring Bernice's Necklace to "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.
english.description: I was playing near the Fargodeep Mine, and I think I dropped, er...I mean I saw, the old lady's necklace.  Don't ask me how it got there...it wasn't me!$B$BWell anyway, I saw this big, gold-toothed kobold pick up the necklace and run back to his den above the mine.  Go find that kobold and you'll find the necklace, I swear!
english.progress: Hello, $N. Have you found my necklace?
english.completion: Oh, you found it! Thank you, thank you dear!$B$BHere, take this. It was my husband's and he always said it was lucky. If only he didn't forget it on his last campaign! *sniff*
english.completed: Return to "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest.

enders.name: 波尼斯·斯通菲尔德姑妈

text.title: 公主必须死！
text.objectives: 杀掉公主，把它的项圈带给斯通菲尔德农场的斯通菲尔德妈妈。
text.description: 布拉克威尔一家有一头得过奖的猪，它名叫“公主”。这头母猪巨大无比，还经常偷偷溜到我的农场里偷吃我的蔬菜！$B$B它现在刚巧就在这里！必须把它给宰了！把它的项圈带回来证明你杀了它，我会给你一些奖赏的！$B$B你会发现公主正在我们的瓜田中大嚼特嚼。赶快去猎杀她！
text.progress: Did you see her yet? Did you get her?
text.completion: Thank goodness! That pig was getting so big she'd have eaten our whole crop! Thank you, $N.$b$bNow, do either of these suit you?
text.completed: Return to Ma Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Princess Must Die!
english.objectives: Kill Princess, grab her collar, then bring it back to Ma Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.
english.description: The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, Princess. The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!$B$BIt just so happens that she's here now! Princess must die! Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!$B$BYou'll find Princess smack dab in the middle of our watermelon patch. Get her!
english.progress: Did you see her yet? Did you get her?
english.completion: Thank goodness! That pig was getting so big she'd have eaten our whole crop! Thank you, $N.$b$bNow, do either of these suit you?
english.completed: Return to Ma Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: The Everstill Bridge
text.objectives: Bring 5 Iron Pikes and 5 Iron Rivets to Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire.
text.description: During the last orc invasion we were forced to smelt our iron down to make bullets, swords and armor.  We sent word to Stormwind for a new shipment of materials but a band of Redridge gnolls hijacked the caravan and ran off into the hills behind Lakeshire.$b$bNow we're coming up short on supplies to get this bridge rebuilt.  If you can bring me 5 iron pikes and 5 iron rivets, $n, I'll make sure you're rewarded. $b$bNow let's get to work!
text.progress: This bridge isn't going to build itself! Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
text.completion: Great work, $N. These supplies will help the bridge effort immensely. We'll get this beauty shored up in no time.
text.completed: Return to Foreman Oslow at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs
text.objectives: Gather 10 Lean Wolf Flanks and Stormwind Seasoning Herbs and return to Chef Grual in Darkshire.
text.description: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs are a house favorite!  Sure, I can make you some.  But first I'll need the supplies.  Bring me 10 Lean Wolf Flanks as well as some Stormwind Seasoning Herbs.  There are so many wolves here in the forest, I am sure finding the Flanks will be no problem.  For the herbs, seek out Felicia Gump in her canal district flower shop in Stormwind.
text.progress: Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet? How about the herbs from Felicia in Stormwind?
text.completion: Very nice work, $N! Enjoy the delicacy known as Seasoned Wolf Kabob!
text.completed: Return to Chef Grual at Darkshire in Duskwood.
