text.title: 所罗门的律法
text.objectives: 给湖畔镇大厅的拜里弗·科纳彻尔带回10个暗皮坠饰。
text.description: 暴风城的一群死敌在赤脊山的东侧的山脚下建立起一片营地，这些邪恶的暴徒一直在我们的小镇中传播着恐惧。莫甘斯是这群恶徒的头领。$b$b他已经控制了暗皮豺狼人氏族，让那些邪恶的野兽为他卖力。根据湖畔镇的法律规定，协犯最高可以被判处死刑。$b$b这些肮脏的豺狼人一定要被处死！$b$b给我带回10个暗皮坠饰来，你就可以得到我们的奖励。
text.progress: Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
text.completion: The Court of Lakeshire recognizes your commitment to justice, $N. By enforcing the laws of the Kingdom you have helped uphold the justice of the land.
text.completed: Return to Bailiff Conacher at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

english.title: Solomon's Law
english.objectives: Bring 10 Shadowhide Pendants to Bailiff Conacher in the Lakeshire Town Hall.
english.description: An enemy of Stormwind has taken up residence in the eastern foothills of Redridge. This wicked villain uses the Arcane to spread terror and misery upon our town and our people. Under the name, Morganth, he conducts his evil business.$b$bMorganth now controls the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan to perform his biddings. As stated by the Law of Lakeshire, aiding a criminal of the Kingdom is punishable by death.$b$bThese vile gnolls must be killed!$b$bTurn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
english.progress: Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
english.completion: The Court of Lakeshire recognizes your commitment to justice, $N. By enforcing the laws of the Kingdom you have helped uphold the justice of the land.
english.completed: Return to Bailiff Conacher at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: 赤脊山炖肉
text.objectives: 湖畔镇的厨师布雷纳想要5块硬秃鹫肉，5个巨型血牙野猪头和5份香脆蜘蛛肉。
text.description: 没什么能比烹制赤脊山炖肉更让我高兴的事了，但是现在有个小问题。自从兽人们出现之后，我就得没日没夜地忙着给暴风城军队的整整一个旅供应食物，我的食品柜早已是空空如也了。如果你能给我找来一些材料的话，我很乐意给你做点好吃的。$b$b只要给我带来5块硬秃鹫肉，5个巨型血牙野猪头和5份香脆蜘蛛肉就行了。
text.progress: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
text.completion: Well done, $N. Such fine specimens too! And here is your delicious delicacy known as Redridge Goulash!
text.completed: Return to Chef Breanna at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

english.title: Redridge Goulash
english.objectives: Chef Breanna of Lakeshire wants five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
english.description: Nothing would please me more than to make you some Redridge Goulash. But there's a slight problem. During the recent orc uprising I fed the entire brigade of Stormwind troops. My cupboard is now bare. But if you can provide me with the ingredients, I'd be happy to oblige.$b$bJust bring me five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
english.progress: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
english.completion: Well done, $N. Such fine specimens too! And here is your delicious delicacy known as Redridge Goulash!
english.completed: Return to Chef Breanna at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: Dusky Crab Cakes
text.objectives: Gather 6 Gooey Spider Legs and bring them to Chef Grual in Darkshire.
text.description: I'll let you in on a little secret - Dusky "Crab" Cakes are really made from spider legs!  I know it's a bit disgusting, but the cakes have a nice, tangy flavor and make great snacks!  Bring me Gooey Spider Legs and I'll whip you up a few of them.$B$BI hear Venom Web Spiders are a good source - they nest to the north, between the foothills and the river.
text.progress: Hail, $N. Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
text.completion: Ah yes, a nice clutch of legs you have there! Let me just get these seasoned with my secret spices (no looking!) and get them to skittering on a skillet for a while...$B$BAnd, although Dusky Crab Cakes are my specialty and I won't give out the recipe, here's the recipe for a dish that's almost as good.
text.completed: Return to Chef Grual at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: A Watchful Eye
text.objectives: Take the Glyph of Azora to the Lion Statue near the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.
text.description: My rival, Morganth, is a vicious mage of great power who lives in the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.  I have developed a means of spying on him, the Eye of Azora, and can now view him from afar.$B$BBut to study his thoughts ... I require further aid.$B$BIf you are willing, then take my Glyph of Azora to the Tower of Ilgalar.  Place it upon the Lion Statue near the Tower.$B$BWhen this is done, the power of Azora will grant visions of Morganth's future plans.
text.progress: This Lion Statue has sat here for decades, and keeps a lonely watch over the infamous Tower of Ilgalar.$B$BThere is a depression at the base of the statue, where a gem or glyph might be set...
text.completion: You place the Glyph of Azora on the stone. It adheres itself... and you hear from it Theocritus' disembodied voice:$B$BYou have my gratitude, young $N. You may now speak with me through this Glyph, and I might have future tasks for you... after I have probed the thoughts of my rival.

text.title: Sven's Revenge
text.objectives: Go to Sven's Farm and find what was buried behind the old stump.
text.description: I used to work one of the farms to the southeast...until Dark Riders from Deadwind Pass descended upon my farm and slaughtered my family when I was away!$B$BWhen I returned I saw a shadowy figure skulking near my barn, burying something.  He fled before I could catch him, and I couldn't linger for I was hot on the heels of the Dark Riders.  So I never discovered what was hidden.$B$BIf you can find what that shadowy figure buried, I would be grateful.  The hiding spot is behind the old stump near my barn.
text.completion: A mound of dirt is here, hastily piled up as if someone had need of hiding something...without much time to do it.

text.title: Call of Water
text.objectives: Bring the Shard of Water to Islen Waterseer at the Tidus Stair in the Barrens.
text.description: Take shard. Take shard and give life.$B$BGive life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.$B$BYou protect and give life with water's power.
text.progress: You've returned. Splendid!$B$BHow went your journey to Silverpine? Did it take you long?$B$BIt is hard for me to tell if you were successful there because so much of the land has become corrupt. Its stench overwhelms any good that you might have done. But small successes are sometimes as important as large ones. Purifying the water there was instrumental for you, and for all shamans.
text.completion: This is the proof I asked for. You've done well, $N.$B$BI am pleased to be the first to congratulate you and give you this... your water totem.$B$BUse it well, and good luck.$B$BYour next test will not be for some time, so learn your lessons well. Pure water will not only give life back to those who are injured, but can have many other effects. I suggest you seek out a shaman trainer when you have the time. They might have other spells for you to learn.

enders.name: 指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

text.title: The Legend of Stalvan
text.objectives: Kill Stalvan Mistmantle and show Madame Eva his family ring.
text.description: Stalvan Mistmantle led a life of depravity.  Innocent victims died by his hand.  Undoubtedly he is guilty of countless crimes.  Now the lunatic threatens Darkshire.  The Light only knows what sordid acts he is plotting.  Travel to his cottage just north of town, $C, and execute Stalvan, once and for all.$b$bWhen the deed is done, travel to Madame Eva's and show her his family ring.  After all, it was her premonition that led to this gruesome discovery.  But Darkshire is safer because of her.
text.progress: Yes, $N?
text.completion: I know, $N: Stalvan is dead. I sensed a wave of hope ripple through the tainted forest. Once and for all, Duskwood is free from his blood thirst. My joy is hampered by thoughts of those who fell prey to the horrible beast. Nonetheless, you are a brave and cunning $c.
text.completed: Return to Madame Eva at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: Arugal's Folly
text.objectives: Bring 6 Pyrewood Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
text.description: As my understanding of Arugal's magic grows so does my disdain for the hapless fool.  I am close to completing my research on his so called remedy.$b$bMy knowledge will be complete when I learn what enchantment is causing the strange behavior going on in Pyrewood Village.  By day, the peasants appear to be Human.  But when the sun goes down the townsfolk turn into Moonrage Worgen.$b$bI need to draw energy from the enchanted shackles Arugal cast on them.  Bring to me six enchanted Pyrewood Shackles, $n.
text.progress: Have you secured the Pyrewood Shackles yet, $N?
text.completion: Your persistence is commendable. With the knowledge you helped me gather, Arugal will fall and his reckless magic shall be undone. Cheers to you, $N.
text.completed: Return to Dalar Dawnweaver at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: Call of Water
text.objectives: Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water at North Tide's Run in Silverpine Forest.
text.description: Light explodes as you finish the incantation. The sounds of the water drops hitting the flame have died down and your senses are overcome as the corrupt spirits around you are destroyed.
text.completion: Thanks to you. Thanks to the shamans.$B$BCorruption ebbs but life continues to wane. Up to shamans to protect life.

text.title: The Totem of Infliction
text.objectives: Bring 10 Ghoul Fangs, 10 Skeleton Fingers and 5 Vials of Spider Venom to Madame Eva in Darkshire.
text.description: As the mystical taint creeps through the forest, the need for self-protection is undeniable, $n.  The winds whisper to me and they speak of a great danger which waits patiently for you in the near future.$b$bIf you wish to protect yourself, noble $c, bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
text.progress: Bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom. For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
text.completion: Very wise of you, $N. This Totem of Infliction will help to protect you against the evil which lurks throughout Azeroth and beyond. When you feel threatened, hold this totem and take comfort in its magical aura. Be brave, fair $C. You will need all the courage you can muster for I see much bloodshed in your future.
text.completed: Return to Madame Eva at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: Patrolling Westfall
text.objectives: Bring 8 Gnoll Paws to Captain Danuvin on Sentinel Hill.
text.description: Stormwind has abandoned us.  A foul wind of depravity rustles through the plains of Westfall.  This was my homeland and I will not turn my back on the citizens who choose to remain here.  We, the former farmers, shall make our stand.$b$bYour task, should you choose to accept, is to patrol the grasslands of Westfall.  Track down and slay the vile Gnolls that seem to be working in conjunction with the Deadmines thieves. Bring me eight Gnoll Paws and I will reward your bravery.
text.progress: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
text.completion: Well done, $N. With valiant adventurers such as yourself fighting alongside The People's Militia, Westfall just might return to the prosperous breadbasket it once was. Please accept this in recognition of your tireless efforts.
text.completed: Return to Captain Danuvin at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

text.title: Keeper of the Flame
text.objectives: Bring 5 Flasks of Oil to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
text.description: The night the Lighthouse Keeper's family died was horrible.  I watched, helpless, as Old Murk-Eye led the attack.  But what's done is done and now my concern is for the lives of the sailors on The Great Sea whose ships come close to the perilous rocks of the coastline.  With no one to keep watch on the flame the responsibility has fallen upon me.$b$bHelp me keep the torch lit by bringing me 5 flasks of oil from the Harvest Monsters.
text.progress: The flame will not burn for long without oil, $N.
text.completion: Praise you, brave $C. The rocks of the Westfall Coast shall be lit thanks to your hard work. Many lives will be spared so long as the torch is kept lit.$B$BI died needlessly on this very shore. My afterlife plight is to see that no others follow my destiny.
text.completed: Return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.

text.title: The Coastal Menace
text.objectives: Bring a scale of Old Murk-Eye to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
text.description: When my life was ended upon the rocks, I had no clue what the afterlife held for me.  The Lighthouse was black that night because Old Murk-Eye had scared the keeper's family off.  They returned and re-lit the flame but Old Murk-Eye coerced the weaker minded murlocs to raid the Lighthouse with him once again.  The second time the family was not so lucky and before my eyes they perished helplessly.$b$bSlay Old Murk-Eye if you see him along the shore and bring me one of his scales and I shall reward you.
text.progress: Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet? He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.$B$BReturn to me when the foul beast is dead.
text.completion: So the foul heathen, Murk-Eye is dead. Well done, $N. By your hands one life was laid to rest but perhaps many more were saved. The Great Sea, wrought with danger as it is, shall be a wee bit safer this night thanks to your heroics.
text.completed: Return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.

english.progress: Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet? He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.$B$BReturn to me when the foul beast is dead.
english.completion: So the foul heathen, Murk-Eye is dead. Well done, $N. By your hands one life was laid to rest but perhaps many more were saved. The Great Sea, wrought with danger as it is, shall be a wee bit safer this night thanks to your heroics.
english.completed: Return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.

text.title: Alas, Andorhal
text.objectives: Bring Araj's Phylactery Shard to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
text.description: Alas, the time to attack Andorhal and drive out the lich that controls it is upon us!$B$BInside the ruins of the city is where the lich - Araj the Summoner - holds dominion.  He is guarded by numerous Scourge surrounding the remains of city's center, and his personal retinue of guardians attached to him directly is formidable.  You will need numerous allies to even stand a chance of facing him successfully.$B$BDestroy Araj, $n, and bring me a shard from his phylactery as proof!
text.progress: Your task has been given to you, $N. Do you have a shard from the lich's phylactery as proof of the task being accomplished?
text.completion: You've done it! Araj... the lich is finally defeated!$B$BYou've done a tremendous service to the Horde on this day, $N. Your bravery and perseverance are a testament to what it means to be a true hero. Please - accept this as a token for all to see and know that you have delivered the Horde a victory for the ages!
text.completed: Return to High Executor Derrington at The Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 年轻的恋人
text.objectives: 把梅贝尔的情书带给托米·乔·斯通菲尔德。
text.description: 天哪，我太痛苦了！我爱上了托米·乔·斯通菲尔德，但我们两家却有着不共戴天的仇恨。所以我不能去见他，可我无时无刻不在怀念那张英俊的面庞啊！$B$B请你把这封信带给托米·乔，他一般会在斯通菲尔德农场西边的河流附近，他们的农场就在这里的正西方。
text.progress: You have what?? Maybell is the light of my dull life. Hurry, let me see her letter!
text.completion: Ah! I can't stand us being apart. I have to see her!!

english.title: Young Lovers
english.objectives: Give Maybell's Love Letter to Tommy Joe Stonefield.
english.description: Oh, I'm cursed!  My heart belongs to Tommy Joe Stonefield, but our families are bitter enemies.  So I can't see him, even though my eyes ache to gaze upon that handsome face!$B$BPlease, take this letter and give it to Tommy Joe.  He's usually at the river to the west of the Stonefield Farm, which is due west of here.
english.progress: You have what?? Maybell is the light of my dull life. Hurry, let me see her letter!
english.completion: Ah! I can't stand us being apart. I have to see her!!

text.title: 给威廉·匹斯特的信
text.objectives: 把斯通菲尔德老奶奶的便笺交给威廉·匹斯特。
text.description: 威廉·匹斯特肯定有能让这两个年轻人见面的办法！$B$B把这个便笺拿去交给威廉，他现在正住在闪金镇的狮王之傲旅店。
text.progress: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh? I haven't seen Mildred in years! I wonder what she has to say...
text.completion: My heart goes out to those two poor souls, Maybell and Tommy Joe. I remember being young and in love, once.$b$bThere must be something I can do to help them! Let me think...

english.title: Note to William
english.objectives: Take Gramma Stonefield's Note to William Pestle.
english.description: I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!$B$BHere, take this note to William.  He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
english.progress: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh? I haven't seen Mildred in years! I wonder what she has to say...
english.completion: My heart goes out to those two poor souls, Maybell and Tommy Joe. I remember being young and in love, once.$b$bThere must be something I can do to help them! Let me think...

text.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle
text.objectives: Talk to Gryan Stoutmantle.  He usually can be found in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road, in the middle of Westfall.
text.description: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, $c.  If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle.  He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall.  I bet he could use your help.  You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.
text.progress: An... Any luck??
text.completion: Ah, so my friend sent you here? How kind. $B$BWell the Stormwind Monarchy has abandoned our cause. Now it is up to the People's Militia to keep the land free from corruption. If our cause interests you, I can put your combat skills to use in the name of freedom.

text.title: Insect Part Analysis
text.objectives: Check in Gadgetzan for Alchemist Pestlezugg and his analysis of the insect parts.
text.description: I'm going to spend some time taking a look at Scrimshank's surveying gear... as well as putting his personal effects in order.  I get the sneaking feeling behind my ears that this isn't the last loss we'll be facing against these bugs.$B$BI'd like for you to check in with Alchemist Pestlezugg to see if he has had a chance to process the insect parts we sent him.  If they're ready, bring them to me.
text.completion: Yes, I have the results right here.  They are... unsettling, to say the least$B$BOur initial suspicion that the bugs are being controlled by an outside force, we believe, is correct.  If this is the case, then we are dealing with not only a very powerful unknown force, but also a malignant one.  These bugs have been changed to be pure ravagers.  I've never seen anything quite like it.

text.title: 托米的祖母
text.objectives: 和斯通菲尔德农场的米斯通菲尔德老奶奶谈一谈。
text.description: 求求你，$n，去和我的奶奶谈一谈吧。如果有人能想办法让我和梅贝尔在一起的话，那个人一定是奶奶。$B$B她就在我们家的屋子里。
text.progress: I can't wait to hear how my friends react!$B$BThey'll never expect it
text.completion: While our families are feuding, Tommy Joe and Maybell don't have much of a future, but... maybe we can get them together for just a little while.$B$BHm, what can we do...

english.title: Speak with Gramma
english.objectives: Speak with Gramma Stonefield.
english.description: Please, $n, talk with my Gramma.  If anyone can find a way to bring me together with Maybell, she can.$B$BShe's inside our house east of here.
english.progress: I can't wait to hear how my friends react!$B$BThey'll never expect it
english.completion: While our families are feuding, Tommy Joe and Maybell don't have much of a future, but... maybe we can get them together for just a little while.$B$BHm, what can we do...

text.title: 收集海藻
text.objectives: 收集4片水晶藻叶，把它们带给闪金镇的威廉·匹斯特。
text.description: 我可以为梅贝尔配制一种隐形水，这样她就可以悄悄溜出马科伦农场去见托米·乔。不过我需要一些水晶海藻来配制这种药水。$B$B水晶海藻一般生长在海里……不过有时候鱼人会收集它们。去看看水晶湖附近的鱼人身上有没有海藻，水晶湖就在闪金镇的东边。
text.progress: Do you have that crystal kelp? I'm sure Maybell is anxious to see her beau...
text.completion: You got them. Good show! Now, just one moment while I concoct the potion...
text.completed: Return to William Pestle at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Collecting Kelp
english.objectives: Bring 4 Crystal Kelp Fronds to William Pestle in Goldshire.
english.description: I can make an invisibility liquor for Maybell, so she can slip away from the Maclure Vineyards and go to Tommy Joe.  But to make the liquor, I need some crystal kelp.$B$BAlthough the kelp usually grows in the ocean... sometimes murlocs collect it.  See if the murlocs near Crystal Lake have any.  Crystal Lake is just east of Goldshire.
english.progress: Do you have that crystal kelp? I'm sure Maybell is anxious to see her beau...
english.completion: You got them. Good show! Now, just one moment while I concoct the potion...
english.completed: Return to William Pestle at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: Insect Part Analysis
text.objectives: Deliver the report to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.  Be sure he gives you a copy of the report, as Alchemist Pestlezugg has requested.
text.description: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser needs to see this report immediately.  Actually... everyone who can read needs to see this report.  We are facing a grave and serious threat to not only Tanaris and Gadgetzan, but if left unchecked, the entirety of southern Kalimdor.  Heck, even quite possible the whole of Azeroth; this thing has given no indication it will subside.$B$BHave Fizzledowser make a duplicate of the report for you to distribute freely to your allegiance. Everyone must know about this threat!
text.progress: Well Junior Surveyor $n, has ol' Pestlezugg got that report ready yet?
text.completion: Thank you for delivering the report, Junior Surveyor $n; here is your pay for your diligent service to the Gadgetzan Water Company.$B$BWhile I am usually not thrilled about handing out our valuable information carte blanche to those who would otherwise pay good coin for it, I've known Pestlezugg for a number of years now.  If he recommends letting everyone know about it, then so be it.  Give me a moment and I'll make you a copy.

text.title: 梅贝尔的隐形水
text.objectives: 把隐形水带给梅贝尔·马科伦。
text.description: 把隐形水带给梅贝尔·马科伦。它的隐形效果应该可以持续到她见到托米·乔的时候。
text.progress: Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe? What did he say??
text.completion: Oh...my! I feel guilty deceiving my family, but my feelings for Tommy Joe are too strong to ignore.$b$bThank you, $N. I'll drink this liquor as soon as I have the chance and sneak away to my love.$b$bAnd for you... please take this.

english.title: The Escape
english.objectives: Take the Invisibility Liquor to Maybell Maclure.
english.description: Take this invisibility liquor to young Maybell.  It should last long enough for her to visit Tommy Joe.
english.progress: Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe? What did he say??
english.completion: Oh...my! I feel guilty deceiving my family, but my feelings for Tommy Joe are too strong to ignore.$b$bThank you, $N. I'll drink this liquor as soon as I have the chance and sneak away to my love.$b$bAnd for you... please take this.

text.title: Shadow Magic
text.objectives: Bring 3 Midnight Orbs to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
text.description: The Blackrock orcs enlisted shadowcasters to aid their attacks in Redridge, and they have brought with them devices of dark power--midnight orbs.  These orbs have struck telling blows against Redridge's defenders, and it's imperative we remove the demon-tainted items from the conflict.$B$BFind and deliver to me midnight orbs from slain Blackrock shadowcasters.  I will then have them disposed of, for this world would be a better place without them!
text.progress: How goes your conflict with the shadowcasters? Did you find the midnight orbs?
text.completion: Thank you, $N. I'll send these to be destroyed immediately.
text.completed: Return to Marshal Marris at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: Dry Times
text.objectives: Barkeep Daniels of Lakeshire needs a keg of Thunderbrew Lager, a cask of Merlot, a bottle of Moonshine and a skin of Sweet Rum.
text.description: I find myself in quite a pinch here, $n.  The bottles are close to running dry.  The latest booze shipment is long overdue.  The orc invasion has been hell.$b$bPerhaps you can go to work for me?$b$bI need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
text.progress: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire. Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
text.completion: A job well done, $N! I know well the roads you had to journey to procure this fine array of liquor. But my patrons will be happy once again! $b$bMy wife is quite a seamstress. Please accept this cloak she made in return for your services.
text.completed: Return to Barkeep Daniels at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: Thunderbrew Lager
text.objectives: Bring Grimbooze Thunderbrew 5 hops to complete his special brew.
text.description: Hurry, my friend, move with haste $bIn order for our rich lager to taste $bMore like beer and less like stew, $bHops are needed to make the brew.
text.progress: Hurry, my friend, move with haste $bIn order for our rich lager to taste $bMore like beer and less like stew, $bHops are needed to make the brew.
text.completion: Hops and Barley, yeast and malt $bThe taste-buds feel a virtual assault, $bNo need to plead, no need to beg $bFor Thunderbrew Lager comes in a keg!
text.completed: Return to Grimbooze Thunderbrew at the Dagger Hills in Westfall.

text.title: 马掌
text.objectives: 把弗纳的便笺交给艾尔文森林中闪金镇的铁匠阿古斯。
text.description: 我把所有的铁都用来打造暴风城卫兵的装备，结果没有剩余的铁来打马掌了！$B$B把这封信带给闪金镇的铁匠阿古斯，信上说明了我现在的情况并要求他运一批马掌过来。
text.progress: What's that? Verner sent you, you say? Well give me his note. And SPEAK UP!
text.completion: Heh, so old Verner needs some shoes, does he!?!

english.title: The Price of Shoes
english.objectives: Take Verner's Note to Smith Argus at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.
english.description: I've been using so much iron keeping the Stormwind Guards outfitted, I don't have enough to supply the stable's horses with shoes!$B$BTake this note to Blacksmith Argus in Goldshire.  It explains to him my problem and requests a shipment of horseshoes.
english.progress: What's that? Verner sent you, you say? Well give me his note. And SPEAK UP!
english.completion: Heh, so old Verner needs some shoes, does he!?!

text.title: Return to Verner
text.objectives: Return to Verner Osgood at Lakeshire in Redridge.  Give him the Crate of Horseshoes.
text.description: Ok, I'll give him his 50 horseshoes...$B$BHere they are, all boxed up and ready to go!  Tell Verner it was a pleasure doing business, and be sure he reads the note attached to this crate!
text.progress: Great, you're back! Did you get the shoes?
text.completion: Thank you, this really helps me out.$b$bBut what's this? Argus sent a note with the crate...What?? Argus wants me to PAY him? Bah!$b$bWell, $N, thank you for your help.

text.title: Messenger to Stormwind
text.objectives: Magistrate Solomon has given you a report which must be delivered to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind.  The judge wants you to return to him as soon as the delivery has been made.
text.description: These are trying times, $c.  The township is under constant siege.  Without reinforcements, we will certainly face defeat.  The message I now entrust to you is of utmost importance.  Get this report to General Marcus Jonathan of Stormwind immediately.  Once your delivery is made, return to me at once with any news, be it good or bad. $b$bNow make haste!
text.progress: What have you there?
text.completion: At ease, $C.$b$bMagistrate Solomon is a noble leader. His words carry great weight with me. I shall seek the counsel of the King and make the situation clear to him. Assure the good judge that he has the Stormwind Army's support. Reinforcements will be sent as soon as word is given from His Majesty.

text.title: Messenger to Stormwind
text.objectives: Take General Marcus Jonathan's letter of response to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
text.description: While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon. $b$bDismissed, $c!
text.progress: Did the General send news? Are reinforcements on the way?
text.completion: Thank you for your time, $C. For your service to Lakeshire and Stormwind I reward you with these coins.$b$bNow if you'll excuse me, I find this correspondence somewhat of a mystery. Something is amiss in our Kingdom. I fear this is the beginning of conflict, not the end.

text.title: Underbelly Scales
text.objectives: Gather 6 Underbelly Whelp Scales from Black Dragon Whelps, and bring them to Verner Osgood in Redridge.
text.description: I need some underbelly scales from black dragon whelps to pay for the shoes Argus sent me from Goldshire.  If you can get 6 of them for me, then I can pay Argus with some... and have enough left to fashion something for you.$B$BBlack dragon whelps are often flying around south of Lakeshire, but they like to wander.  You might have to just keep an eye out and hunt them when you see them.
text.progress: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon. Have you found those scales yet?
text.completion: Thanks! These will get me out of debt to Argus...
text.completed: Return to Verner Osgood at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

english.completion: Thanks! These will get me out of debt to Argus...
english.completed: Return to Verner Osgood at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: 收货人
text.objectives: 在艾尔文森林的东谷伐木场找到治安官麦克格雷，把收货人的交易日程表交给他。
text.description: 这是一张日程表，记录了某个人被称作“收货人”的人在某天某时会收到从艾尔文森林的矿洞运来的一车黄金。$B$B根据日程表所述，这个收货人好像就住在艾尔文森林东部的布莱克威尔南瓜田附近。$B$B这件事非常重要，你必须向东谷伐木场的治安官麦克格雷报告。
text.progress: What?!? We haven't had our people working the Elwynn mines for months!$B$BLet me see that note you have...
text.completion: Hm... I have heard of this "Collector" but I don't know whom he's working for. Thank you for the schedule. It will help us solve this mystery.

english.title: The Collector
english.objectives: Go to Marshal McCree at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest and give him The Collector's Schedule.
english.description: This note is a schedule with a list of days and times when a person -- described only as "The Collector" -- will receive a shipment of gold from the mines in Elwynn Forest.$B$BFrom the schedule, it looks as if the Collector resides near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn.$B$BThis sounds important.  You should report it to Marshal McCree at Eastvale Logging Camp.
english.progress: What?!? We haven't had our people working the Elwynn mines for months!$B$BLet me see that note you have...
english.completion: Hm... I have heard of this "Collector" but I don't know whom he's working for. Thank you for the schedule. It will help us solve this mystery.

text.title: A Baying of Gnolls
text.objectives: Kill 10 Redridge Brutes and 8 Redridge Mystics, then return to Verner Osgood.
text.description: As if the attacking orcs weren't enough!  Now I have gnoll brutes and mystics prowling along the ridge north of my stable, taking my horses when they stray...$B$BIf you can get rid of those gnolls, my horses and I would be very grateful.
text.progress: Yes? Is there something I can do for you?
text.completion: Thank you for all your help, $N.
text.completed: Return to Verner Osgood at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

english.completed: Return to Verner Osgood at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: The Lost Tools
text.objectives: Foreman Oslow of Lakeshire wants you to retrieve his toolbox from the bottom of Lake Everstill.
text.description: I could really use a hand here, $n.  With the town under siege, it's been hard to get supplies.  My tools were being delivered from Goldshire by wagon but the bridge was blown out.  We put the tools in a boat but the orcs hit it with a catapult.  Just my luck, my toolbox sank right to the bottom of the lake.$b$bRetrieve my toolbox, $n, and I'll make it worth your while.
text.progress: Were you able to find my tools?
text.completion: Excellent recovery, $N! I never thought I'd see these tools again.
text.completed: Return to Foreman Oslow at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: Howling in the Hills
text.objectives: Bring Yowler's Paw to Verner Osgood in Lakeshire.
text.description: $n, the gnolls are still out there.  I can hear their baying as they hunt in the hills above Lakeshire.  And one cry is louder than the rest - Yowler,  their leader.$B$BKill Yowler and send his pack scattering!  Bring me his paw as proof.$B$BAnd be careful, this gnoll is their leader for a reason.  He is no Mongrel...
text.progress: Yowler is a dangerous creature, $N. If you're not ready for him, I understand.
text.completion: Again, thank you for your help. The Stormwind army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect Redridge from local threats like the gnolls.
text.completed: Return to Verner Osgood at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: Selling Fish
text.objectives: Bring 10 Spotted Sunfish to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.
text.description: Lake Everstill is famous for its spotted sunfish.  There's always demand for them...and I'm running low!$B$BBring me a batch of 10 and I'll barter well for them.  If you can't fish yourself, then...maybe you can get them off the murlocs!
text.progress: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
text.completion: Pleasure doin' business with you, matey!
text.completed: Return to Dockmaster Baren at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: 悬赏：黑石氏族
text.objectives: 杀死15名黑石勇士，并向湖畔镇的卫兵豪维复命。
text.description: 我们一定得清剿黑石氏族。这群强盗入侵了我们的国家，占据了本应属于暴风王国的群山。根据线报说，在他们的氏族中，每支分队的领袖都被称为“勇士”，你很容易就能找到他们。他们的营地大致在北方，就在通向燃烧平原的道路西边。$b$b所罗门镇长希望有人能把这群卑鄙邪恶的家伙都消灭光。如果你有意帮助我们的话，杀死15名黑石勇士，然后向我复命。
text.progress: Return once you have slain 15 Blackrock Champions.
text.completion: I see you have fought valiantly against the Blackrock Clan, $C. Your service to our township is great indeed.
text.completed: Return to Guard Howe at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

english.title: Blackrock Bounty
english.objectives: Kill 15 Blackrock Champions and Guard Howe in Lakeshire will reward you.
english.description: The Blackrock Clan must be destroyed. The Enemy has invaded our lands. These mountains fall under the sovereign right of the King of Stormwind. Our sources tell us that the leaders of each unit within the Clan are known as Champions. You'll find them in their encampment to the north, just west of the road to the Burning Steppes.$b$bMagistrate Solomon wants these foul brutes dead. Slay 15 Blackrock Champions and return to me.
english.progress: Return once you have slain 15 Blackrock Champions.
english.completion: I see you have fought valiantly against the Blackrock Clan, $C. Your service to our township is great indeed.
english.completed: Return to Guard Howe at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: A Free Lunch
text.objectives: Bring Parker's lunch to Guard Parker.  He patrols the road leading to Darkshire.
text.description: Can you do me a favor?  I've prepared a lunch for Guard Parker, but he's out on patrol...he's a big, strong Stormwind guard who can defend himself, but it's much too dangerous out there for a townsperson like me.$B$BSo if you deliver his lunch for me, then come back here and I'll give you a free lunch!  Parker patrols the stretch of road leading to Duskwood.
text.progress: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she? Such a kind heart she has. Well...let's have it!
text.completion: Thanks, I could really use the meal. Guarding Lakeshire from the orcs and gnolls is tough work!

text.title: Visit the Herbalist
text.objectives: Speak with the Redridge Herbalist, Martie Jainrose.
text.description: Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me?  You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.$B$BBut when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...
text.completion: You need a bouquet of flowers? You haven't been in town very long...have you already found for yourself a sweetheart here?$B$BI know I shouldn't pry, but it's nice to see that love is in the air... especially in dangerous times like these.

text.title: Delivering Daffodils
text.objectives: Give Darcy the Daffodil Bouquet.
text.description: Here is your bouquet.  I chose Daffodils for you.  They're my favorite!
text.progress: Hello again, $N. Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
text.completion: Oh, those are lovely! I can't wait to put them in some water!$b$bBut...these are Martie's favorite flowers. Parker didn't have you go to that jealous vixen for this bouquet, did he? You didn't tell her who they were for, did you? If you did, then it wouldn't surprise me if she poisoned them.$b$bOh, but it's not your fault. Thank you, and here's your meal.

text.title: 迪菲亚兄弟会
text.objectives: 将威利的便笺交给西部荒野的格里安·斯托曼。
text.description: 我现在可是冒着生命危险在和你说话。迪菲亚那帮人也是听命于某个神秘人士的，我上次听说他们与许多种族都有过合作，豺狼人，狗头人，甚至还有地精。$b$b把这张便笺交给斯托曼。上面写着我所知道的关于迪菲亚兄弟会的一切。
text.progress: Good to see you back, $N. What did Wiley have to say for himself?
text.completion: Bah! I should have let that scoundrel rot when I had the chance. But this information is crucial. Good work.

english.title: The Defias Brotherhood
english.objectives: Take Wiley's Note to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.
english.description: What I am about to tell you could cost me my life.  The Defias gang is up to something big.  Last I heard they were working in conjunction with various gnolls, kobolds and even goblins.$b$bTake this note to Stoutmantle.  It explains as much as I know on the subject.
english.progress: Good to see you back, $N. What did Wiley have to say for himself?
english.completion: Bah! I should have let that scoundrel rot when I had the chance. But this information is crucial. Good work.

text.title: Ghoulish Effigy
text.objectives: Gather 7 Ghoul Ribs and bring them to Abercrombie at his shack.
text.description: I live so far from the protection of town, it's a wonder the ghouls and the walking dead haven't eaten me!  In fact, just yesterday a pack of Bone Chewers was pounding on the walls of my house!$B$BI want to make an effigy - a kind of "scarecrow" for Ghouls.  To do that I need some Ghoul Ribs.  You can get them from Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders.$B$BGet the ribs for me, and I will repay you with some coin.
text.progress: I think I hear a pack of Ghouls scurrying around the back of the house - I better put that effigy up quick! Did you get those Ghoul Ribs for me?
text.completion: Ah, thanks. These will do just the trick!
text.completed: Return to Abercrombie at Raven Hill Cemetary in Duskwood.

text.title: Ogre Thieves
text.objectives: Return Abercrombie's Crate to Abercrombie.
text.description: A few weeks ago I was picking herbs far from my house, and a band of ogres attacked me!  I ran, and I was forced to leave behind a crate of precious tools and herbs.$B$BAfter they chased me off, the ogres swaggered back to the ogre mound in southern Duskwood.  I'm sure my crate is somewhere near the mound.$B$BPlease, $n, retrieve this crate for me for I miss it sorely.
text.progress: Do you have my crate? If so, then please...give it to me quickly!
text.completion: Thank the Nec-...well, thank YOU, $N! You have more than earned your reward.$B$BAha! Happy! Happy nights ahead!!
text.completed: Return to Abercrombie at Raven Hill Cemetary in Duskwood.

text.title: The Defias Brotherhood
text.objectives: Take Wiley's Note to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.
text.description: I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons.  Perhaps that was a slip of tongue.  Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons?  Only one man would know for sure:  Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Show him Wiley's Note and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in Old Town.
text.progress: What business do you have with me? I am a very busy man. . .
text.completion: This matter might be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.

text.title: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
text.objectives: Find Captain Sanders' footlocker and search it for the next clue.
text.description: If ye be readin' this, it means that Ol' Captain Sanders is in a watery grave.  So my treasure is yours now, ye jest need to follow the clues. $b$bFirst ye need to find me footlocker.  It's probably half-buried in sand by now, along the Western Coast of Westfall near the shipwreck.  There be lots of shipwrecks but only one rusty anchor on the coast.  Find that anchor and you'll find me locker!  Look in there for the next clue.
text.completion: The footlocker slowly creaks open. Sand and water seem to be its only contents. But wait! A small crab scurries out with a clue to the treasure in his claws!

text.title: <NYI> <TXT> Stormwind Commendation
text.objectives: General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind will accept a commendation from Elwynn Forest.  Bringing him such a document will reward you with a choice of armor.
text.description: If you earn a commendation from one of our Marshals, then bring it to me.  It will be good for one of our Lion Emblem gloves.
text.completed: Return to General Marcus Jonathan at Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City.

text.title: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
text.objectives: Find the old barrel near the ruined chimney and search it for your next clue.
text.description: The clue to the treasure reads: Good work, matey!  Now ye need to head due east.  East up the bluffs, east to the road.  Look for the ol' chimney ruins near the side of the road.  There you'll find an old barrel with your next clue.
text.completion: Good work, treasure hunter!

text.title: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
text.objectives: Search the empty jug next to the windmill for the next clue.
text.description: Searching through the barrel you discover another piece of parchment.  This one reads:  Now from this here barrel, face ye North.  Straight as the crow flies, keep ye walkin' till you see the empty jug next to the lone windmill on the sea bluffs.  If ye poke around that jug, ye just might find what you're lookin' for.
text.completion: You're on your way to the jackpot, treasure seeker!

text.title: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
text.objectives: Locate Captain Sanders' chest and open it for your reward.
text.description: Sure enough, deep within the Old Jug there is another clue to Sanders' treasure.  The ink has run in some places and the paper smells like whiskey but you can make out some of the text:  Now that ye found me ol' whiskey jug, you're almost to the treasure!  Just face West from the bottle and walk down to the shore.  Once ye get to the water, keep going!  Swim straight west till you find the island with me treasure chest!
text.completion: The hinges on the old chest are rusty but they still work. You force the chest open and take the booty.$B$BCongratulations!

text.title: The Defias Brotherhood
text.objectives: Take Shaw's report to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.
text.description: The Stonemasons' Guild was run by a man named Edwin VanCleef.  VanCleef was responsible for rebuilding Stormwind after the orcs razed it in the First War.  Apparently, VanCleef and his men were unhappy with their treatment by the King after the reconstruction was complete.  That just might explain a thing or two.$b$bI have written a more detailed account for your Master in Westfall.  Take this to him at once!
text.progress: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
text.completion: Edwin VanCleef. . .I know the name well. To think that a man so industrious and talented could turn into such a scoundrel unnerves me. I'll need further proof before I believe this.

text.title: The Defias Brotherhood
text.objectives: Track down the Defias Messenger in Westfall and bring his message to Stoutmantle.
text.description: We need to discover the location of the Defias hideout.  $n, my scout reports that a Defias Messenger has been seen on the roads between Moonbrook, the Gold Coast Quarry and the Jangolode Mine.  I want you to capture him.  If he resists, kill him and bring me whatever he is carrying.
text.progress: $N, were you able to gather any information? Did you locate the messenger?
text.completion: This is indeed firm proof that VanCleef is in charge. Now all we need to know is where the Defias gang is hiding out.$b$bWe've had a stroke of luck while you were gone. We captured a thief trying to steal Saldean's wagon. He has promised to lead us to the hideout in exchange for his life. I want you to defend the traitor so he can reveal the hideout. Return to me once you have uncovered the location.
text.completed: Return to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

text.title: Messenger to Westfall
text.objectives: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take his written plea to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.
text.description: Something odd is afoot with the Stormwind Army.  They should have been here in force by now.  Time is a luxury we don't have, however.  I will not stand by and watch the people of Lakeshire give their lives without trying to enlist more help.  I've heard word of a people's militia forming in Westfall.$b$bTake this plea to their leader, Gryan Stoutmantle.  Perhaps Stoutmantle's men can lend some support here until the King sends reserves.
text.progress: Hail, $C. What business do you have with The People's Militia?
text.completion: Good Messenger, you have served your master well.

text.title: Messenger to Westfall
text.objectives: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Gryan Stoutmantle's response.
text.description: Magistrate Solomon's note pains me to read.  But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in Westfall or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia.  If Stormwind had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.$b$bTake this response to your master in Redridge, $c.  And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.
text.progress: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon? Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?
text.completion: I do say, this is not good at all. I did not realize that Stoutmantle's situation was not unlike ours here in Lakeshire. What action is so important that it calls the Stormwind Army away from its people? Bah, I should not ponder aloud.$b$bHere, messenger. Accept these coins in exchange for your service to the Township. I might call upon you again.

text.title: Messenger to Darkshire
text.objectives: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take a letter to Lord Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
text.description: I require your assistance once again.  I have written to Lord Ebonlocke, requesting that he sends his trained guards, the Night Watch, to help with Lakeshire's defense.  It is imperative this message makes it to him swiftly.  You must exercise extreme caution.  Ebonlocke is the mayor of Darkshire, in the heart of Duskwood.  Do not stray from the roads.
text.progress: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C. What business do you have here in Darkshire?
text.completion: Thank you for making the long journey here. This is indeed important information.

text.title: Messenger to Darkshire
text.objectives: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Lord Ebonlocke's letter of response.
text.description: If I did not know Magistrate Solomon personally, I would say the man has gone mad.  Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because Stormwind refuses aid?  The Night Watch was formed because Stormwind left us when this foul magic seeped into the land.  If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.$b$bTake this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.
text.progress: Ah, good to see you back, messenger. Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
text.completion: By the Light! The Stormwind Army retreated from Westfall. And the Guard no longer protects Darkshire? There is some treachery abound. How could this be so? $b$bOh I forgot to reward your service, $C. Here are some coins. Now excuse me. Something is amiss in Stormwind and I must get to the bottom of it.

text.title: 猎杀收货人
text.objectives: 找到“收货人”并杀掉他，然后带着收货人的戒指回来见治安官麦克格雷。
text.description: 如果这个“收货人”是私自从我们的矿洞里开采黄金的话，那么他就是在偷窃王国的金库！把他就地正法，然后把他的交易日程表上提到的戒指给我带来。也许这枚戒指能告诉我们这个“收货人”是在为谁工作……$B$B那张交易日程表上说“收货人”就藏在布莱克威尔南瓜田里，你应该到那儿去找他。
text.progress: Did you find the Collector? Did you discover whom he's working for?
text.completion: You found him? Well done, $N. He won't be "collecting" from the Elwynn Mines again!$B$BAnd this ring you found is interesting... it's a membership ring for the old Stonemason's Guild in Stormwind. Why would a lowly thief have an artisan guild ring, and why are the Defias Thieves collecting money from our mines?$B$BDifficult questions. I hope one day we'll have answers.
text.completed: Return to Marshal McCree at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Manhunt
english.objectives: Find and kill "the Collector"  then return to Marshal McCree with The Collector's Ring.
english.description: If the "Collector" is taking gold from our mines then he's stealing from the kingdom!  Bring the Collector to justice, and bring me the ring mentioned in the pickup schedule you gave me.  It may tell us whom the Collector is working for...$B$BThat Pickup Schedule says the Collector is hiding out at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch.  You should search for him there.

english.completion: You found him? Well done, $N. Why would a lowly thief have an artisan guild ring, and why are the Defias Thieves collecting money from our mines?$B$BDifficult questions. I hope one day we'll have answers.
english.completed: Return to Marshal McCree at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: Supplies from Darkshire
text.objectives: Speak with Madame Eva.
text.description: Oh, what is a poor old man to do?  I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I am so old and feeble...I would never make the trip.$B$BCan you go to Darkshire and bring me back some Ghost Hair Thread?  You can get it from Madame Eva at her home on the Darkshire square.
text.completion: Ah, Ghost Hair Thread is what you need, is it? I'm afraid I have none in stock, but I can make some for you...if you can supply the ghost hair.

text.title: Ghost Hair Thread
text.objectives: Bring the Spectral Comb to Blind Mary.
text.description: There is a poor, sad spirit, Blind Mary, who haunts an old farm house in the hills south of Darkshire.$B$BHere, take this Spectral Comb and ask Blind Mary to comb her hair.  Then bring back the comb and I will glean from it the Ghost Hair I'll need for the thread.$B$BAnd take care, for dark things now lurk near that house...
text.progress: Oh please, don't look at me! I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!$B$BI'm hideous! Hideous! Please, look away!!
text.completion: What is this? A comb? It's lovely! And it glides through my hair as if it weren't the stiff, stringy horror that it is.$B$BOh, if only I had a mirror...

text.title: Murloc Poachers
text.objectives: Bring 8 Murloc Fins to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.
text.description: Murlocs are becoming a problem.  Larger groups of the fishmen are dropping anchor along the shores of Lake Everstill and fishing up a storm!  We need them gone before they eat all the fish in the lake!$B$BHunt murlocs!  Bring me eight of their fins and I might have something for you...
text.progress: Do you have those fins? Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
text.completion: Well done, $N. I hope you didn't have too much trouble with those murlocs.$B$BIt's strange seeing them so far from the sea. I wonder if they're here because they're running from something...
text.completed: Return to Dockmaster Baren at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: Poor Old Blanchy
text.objectives: Verna Furlbrow in Westfall wants you to bring her 8 Handfuls of Oats.
text.description: Poor Old Blanchy!  Such a tired beast after all the work we put her through. I fed her before we left the farm, but we weren't expecting the wagon to break on us. If you could bring her a few handfuls of oats from the fields, I'd be grateful.$B$BI bet you could find some around all of the farms in Westfall, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. There are several farms southwest of here.
text.progress: Old Blanchy is on her last leg. Did you happen to find any oats for her?
text.completion: Thank you so much, $N! Poor Old Blanchy will be so happy!
text.completed: Return to Verna Furlbrow at the Jansen Stead in Westfall.

text.title: The Coast Isn't Clear
text.objectives: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
text.description: You probably noticed all of the shipwrecks along the coast.  The Great Sea is treacherous indeed.  The coast of Westfall needs to be kept clear, so that if sailors find their way to our beaches, they are safe.  The Murlocs are trouble though.$b$bKill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
text.progress: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
text.completion: Well done, $N. You have quite a knack for combat. Thanks to you the Coast of Westfall is a safer place.
text.completed: Return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.

text.title: 红色皮质面罩
text.objectives: 给哨兵岭的哨兵加里安带回15条红色皮质面罩。
text.description: 我们与迪菲亚兄弟会的战局总是瞬息万变。最近我一直在监视着他们的活动，根据长期观察的结果，我发现他们的成员都戴着一种特殊的红色皮质面罩。$b$b给我带15条这种面罩回来吧，我会给你奖励的。
text.progress: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
text.completion: Nice work, $R. Please accept one of these items as payment for all your hard work.
text.completed: Return to Scout Galiaan at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

english.objectives: Bring 15 Red Leather Bandanas to Scout Galiaan at Sentinel Hill.
english.description: The Defias Front is constantly shifting.  I've been following their movements for quite some time now.  On a side note, I've ascertained that many members of the gang can be tracked by the Red Leather Bandanas they wear.$b$bBring me 15 of these Bandanas and I'll see to it you are rewarded.

english.completion: Nice work, $R. Please accept one of these items as payment for all your hard work.
english.completed: Return to Scout Galiaan at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

text.title: Return the Comb
text.objectives: Return the Ghost Hair Comb to Madame Eva in Darkshire.
text.description: NO!!!!!$B$BTake it, take this comb away from me!$B$BI'm a monster, and no one will ever think me lovely again!
text.progress: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary. You have my Comb...?
text.completion: I can make a spool of Ghost Hair Thread with this, and have a few strands to spare. Here are some coins for those extra strands.

text.title: The Defias Brotherhood
text.objectives: Escort the Defias Traitor to the secret hideout of the Defias Brotherhood.  Once the Defias Traitor shows you where VanCleef and his men are hiding out, return to Gryan Stoutmantle with the information.
text.description: So Stoutmantle sends a scrawny $r like you to protect me?  Guess you'll have to do.  Better bring some friends too. $b$bYou know the deal, right?  You watch my back and I'll take you to the Defias hideout.  But you better be close by my side.  The Defias gang wants my head now.  If they see me with you, they'll try to kill me.$b$bLet me know when you and any friends you can round up are ready to go.
text.progress: What business do you have with me? I am a very busy man...
text.completion: Most excellent, $N! VanCleef is as good as ours now that we know where he is hiding.
text.end: Escort The Defias Traitor to discover where VanCleef is hiding
text.completed: Return to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

text.title: Gather Rot Blossoms
text.objectives: Gather 8 Rot Blossoms and bring them to Tavernkeep Smitts in Darkshire.
text.description: If you bring me some rot blossoms then I can brew you up a batch of zombie juice.$B$BRot blossoms grow in strange places.  In particular, I hear you can find them inside the skulls of Skeletal Horrors and Skeletal Fiends... not that I've gotten close enough to look!$B$BThe Raven Hill Cemetery is lousy with those skeletons.  You may as well get rid of them while you're looking for rot blossoms.  The town of Darkshire would be grateful.
text.progress: Hi, $N. You have that rot blossoms for me yet?
text.completion: Good, you got the rot blossoms. And I'll tell Althea Ebonlocke of the Night Watch that you were killing skeletons.$B$BKeeping the people of Darkshire safe is a grim burden for the Night Watch, and news that others are helping stem the tide of fiends in Duskwood is welcome news indeed.
text.completed: Return to Tavernkeep Smitts at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.objectives: Bring the Ghost Hair Thread to Abercrombie, in his shack north of the Raven Hill Cemetery.
text.description: Here is your thread, $n.  It has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects.
text.progress: I need to string the Ghost Hair Thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits. Did you get it for me?
text.completion: Delightful! This will do splendidly...$b$bHere, good $N, take this as payment for your honorable deed.

text.completion: You need some Zombie Juice, do you? Hmm...that's some strong stuff - I don't usually get requests for it.

text.progress: I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights. Did you get it for me?
text.completion: A thousand thanks, $N. You warm an old man's heart with your foolish-...I mean...with your kindness!$b$bHere you are, friend. Take this as a token of my gratitude.

text.title: A Dark Threat Looms
text.objectives: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to take the strange smelling powder to Ashlan Stonesmirk, the explosives expert at the Mo'grosh Camp.
text.description: If my suspicions are correct, this is some type of explosive powder. This must be analyzed by an explosives expert so we know just what we're dealing with here.$B$BThere's only one man for the job. Ashlan Stonesmirk was assigned to monitoring the ogres at the Mo'grosh Stronghold to the east. Head that direction and locate him so that he can shed some light on what this substance is.
text.progress: You say somethin', sonny? Can't hear a bloody thing besides the ringin' in me ears. Say, what's that you got there?
text.completion: Ah, well Ol' Hinderweir is wise to be worried.

english.completion: Ah, well Ol' Hinderweir is wise to be worried.

text.title: Rise of the Silithid
text.objectives: Take the Insect Analysis Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.
text.description: I urge you to take this report to someone who has working knowledge in this kind of thing.$B$BI know this night elf scholar named Gracina Spiritmight.  She's spent a lot of time studying life forms that are unique to the ecology of Azeroth; she's a historian to boot!  If you want someone to help figure out what exactly this threat is, and more importantly how to stop it, give her the report.  We'll need the help.$B$BLast I heard, she was residing in the Temple of the Moon, located in Darnassus.
text.progress: Peace and tranquility be upon you, stranger.  Why have you sought me out this day?
text.completion: This report... we night elves know of the terror mentioned here.  Fizzledowser was wise to send this, and you, to me.$B$BThese creatures will consume the Tanaris desert rapidly; they are nothing short of one of the greatest menaces we all will ever face.  Familiarize yourself with this name, $n: silithid.  The insects mentioned here are the silithid, and they are the tools of one of the greatest threats that both the Horde and Alliance face.$B$BIf only we were smart enough to see that before.

text.title: Raven Hill
text.objectives: Find out what is haunting Raven Hill.
text.description: Something's amiss at Raven Hill, $n. Calor swears that someone--or something--is haunting the buildings there. Two nights running he's noticed the shadows moving, and the third before that he says he saw light in one of the windows.$b$bIf, as you say, you care about the safety of Duskwood, find out what monster haunts in Raven Hill.
text.progress: Ah, $N! Back so soon? No doubt you've been at the hunt again? Don't worry if you've had some setbacks, in the long run it will make you better!$B$B...You couldn't get much worse, anyway...
text.completion: No! Please don't kill me! It's just me... Jitters!! They're everywhere... I can't escape them! Monsters in Raven Hill? N-n-n-o... couldn't be. Only harmless Jitters.

text.title: Deliveries to Sven
text.objectives: Deliver the supplies to Sven.
text.description: Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.$b$bUnfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?
text.progress: You look a sturdy type, $C. Have you come to join our fight?
text.completion: These supplies will be most useful. The aid of the Carevin family is always appreciated. Here is a little something for your trouble.

text.title: The Hermit
text.objectives: Check on the old man in the shack near Raven Hill cemetery.
text.description: There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some time now. He lives out in a shack overlooking Raven Hill cemetery, if I remember correctly. Perhaps you should go see if something is amiss.
text.completion: Hehe, oh yes... of course, the Carevins.$B$BNo, nothing's wrong but it is hard for me to go into town now. The roads are dangerous and I'm not getting any younger. Maybe you can do an old man some favors?

text.title: The Defias Brotherhood
text.objectives: Kill Edwin VanCleef and bring his head to Gryan Stoutmantle.
text.description: There is but one task left for you to complete.  Edwin VanCleef must be assassinated.  While it saddens me to condemn any man to a death sentence, it is for the greater good of the people of Westfall that VanCleef is laid to rest once and for all.  Bring me the villain's head once the deed is done.
text.progress: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
text.completion: $N, your bravery is remarkable. The People's Militia thanks you for your service to the people of Westfall. With VanCleef dead, this marks the beginning of the end for the Defias Brotherhood. Hopefully some day soon peace will once again grace the plains of this fair land.$B$BI salute you, $gLord:Lady;!
text.completed: Return to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

text.title: Oh Brother. . .
text.objectives: Bring Foreman Thistlenettle's Explorers' League Badge to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
text.description: We were deep in a vast mine in Westfall, hidden beneath a barn in Moonbrook. No clue where these stinkin' thieving types came from. Anyway, the mine tunnel collapsed on us. I got out but the others... well... the others haven't been heard from.$b$bYou look like you might have better luck in there. If you could look for my brother, I'd be thankful.  He always carried his Explorers' League Badge. If you can't find him, that badge would at least give me some peace of mind.
text.progress: Did you find any sign of my brother? Is there any hope after all this time?
text.completion: My suspicions were correct. My poor brother.... Well, thank you for bringing some conclusion to this mystery, even if the conclusion was grim.
text.completed: Return to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind City.

text.title: Collecting Memories
text.objectives: Retrieve 4 Miners' Union Cards and return them to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
text.description: Many of my friends perished that horrible day when the mine tunnel caved in.  If your adventures happen to bring you into that wing of the mine in Moonbrook, please keep an eye out for any sign which might identify them.  If you come across any of their Miners' Union Cards, bring them back to me and I'll make sure their families get some resolution from this horrible accident.
text.progress: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
text.completion: Thank you for collecting these, $N. Your efforts will help bring peace to the dead in the wake of this tragedy. I will see to it that the families are notified.
text.completed: Return to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind City.

text.title: 通缉：加塞尔佐格
text.objectives: 杀死加塞尔佐格并取下他的徽记，向湖畔镇的所罗门镇长复命。
text.description: 悬赏！加塞尔佐格是黑石氏族袭击石堡和多次劫掠湖畔镇等行动的领导者。$b$b他是个十分危险的家伙。根据线报，他最近就躲藏在刚刚被他们攻陷的要塞中，谋划着黑石氏族的下一次劫掠行动。我们必须不惜一切代价把这些在我们的国土上横行的兽人镇压下去。如果谁能把加塞尔佐格的徽记带到所罗门镇长面前的话，他将会得到重赏。
text.progress: What do you have there, $R?
text.completion: Fantastic work, $N! Gath'Ilzogg led those brutes into battle, killing many innocent humans. Vindication is ours. This is the first step in reclaiming the keep for the kingdom of Stormwind!
text.completed: Return to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

english.title: Wanted: Gath'Ilzogg
english.objectives: Kill Gath'Ilzogg and bring his head to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire for the reward.
english.description: Wanted! Gath'Ilzogg, Leader of the Blackrock attacks on Stonewatch Keep and raids against the township of Lakeshire. $b$bGath'Ilzogg is extremely dangerous.  He is reportedly holed up in the recently conquered keep plotting the Blackrock clan's further crimes against humanity.  The orc infestation must be quelled at all costs.  A gracious reward will be given to whatever brave soul can deliver the head of Gath'Ilzogg to Magistrate Solomon.
english.progress: What do you have there, $R?
english.completion: Fantastic work, $N! Gath'Ilzogg led those brutes into battle, killing many innocent humans. Vindication is ours. This is the first step in reclaiming the keep for the kingdom of Stormwind!
english.completed: Return to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: A New Threat
text.objectives: Balir Frosthammer wants you to kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs.
text.description: I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.$b$bI hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.$b$bAnd that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west! $b$bWe're a bit shorthanded here, $g lad : lass;, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
text.progress: Tenacious little buggers, aren't they?
text.completion: If the problems we've had here are indicative of what is happening elsewhere in our lands, by Magni's beard, we have some troubles ahead of us! I can only hope that the king and Senate are taking steps to deal with the threat the troggs pose.
text.completed: Return to Balir Frosthammer at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

text.title: A Warden of the Alliance
text.objectives: Purchase a Foam Sword Rack from Craggle Wobbletop and then return your ward to the Stormwind orphanage by speaking to Orphan Matron Nightingale in the Cathedral District.
text.description: You have been so very kind to me, $n.  I never dreamed that I'd have so much fun during Children's Week.  Thank you.$B$BI wish all the orphans were lucky enough to get to do the stuff we did. Do you think we could find Craggle Wobbletop again and get a foam sword rack from him? I think he's still pushing that cart in the Canals outside the Trade District. That way, everyone else at the orphanage could do something fun too!$B$BAfter that, it'll be time for me to go home.
text.progress: It is a pleasure to see you again, $N. Have you attended to the duties you've volunteered for during Children's Week?
text.completion: May the heavens bless you, $N. You've done more for Randis than most would ever think of doing for him. Thank you - you're a shining star in the skies of the Alliance.$b$bPlease - if you can spare the time, come back and visit us. I know that Randis would like that, as would I.
text.completed: Return to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind City.

text.title: 儿童周
text.objectives: 使用兽人孤儿哨与你即将在儿童周期间照顾的孩子进行对话。
text.description: 你愿意帮助我们的孤儿院？太感谢你了，我的朋友。感谢你愿意在儿童周的这段时间内为我们提供帮助。$B$B拿着这只哨子，你只能在儿童周的这7天内使用它。当你使用它的时候，就可以和那些由你负责照看的孩子进行对话，再次使用就可以解散那个孩子。$B$B不管怎么样，$n——使用这个口哨，见一见你的小朋友！我相信孩子们一定很想见到你。
text.completion: Zug zug!  My name is Grunth, and I guess you're looking after me?  You're an adventurer, like my mom and dad were.  My matron says that they died with honor in battle.  I'm happy to meet you.$B$BI hope we'll do plenty of things together.  I have some things I'd like to do, and the matron says you'll be like a big $G brother : sister; to me during this week.  I'd like that a whole bunch.

english.title: Children's Week
english.objectives: Use the Orcish Orphan Whistle to talk with the child you will be looking after during Children's Week.
english.description: You're willing to help us here at the orphanage?  Bless you, friend; your aid during Children's Week will be invaluable.$B$BTake this whistle.  You will only be able to use it for a short amount of time - typically not longer than Children's Week itself.  When you use it, you will be able to talk with the child you've agreed to look after.  Using it again will dismiss the child.$B$BBy all means $n - use the whistle and meet your ward!  I'm sure the child will be most eager to meet you.
english.completion: Zug zug!  My name is Grunth, and I guess you're looking after me?  You're an adventurer, like my mom and dad were.  My matron says that they died with honor in battle.  I'm happy to meet you.$B$BI hope we'll do plenty of things together.  I have some things I'd like to do, and the matron says you'll be like a big $G brother : sister; to me during this week.  I'd like that a whole bunch.

text.title: Worgen in the Woods
text.objectives: Kill 6 Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen for Calor in Darkshire.
text.description: Darkness seems drawn inexorably to Duskwood. Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe.$b$bYou believe yourself worthy to join us?$b$bI once thought as you. Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words.$b$bTest your skills against the Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen in Brightwood Grove--bright, hah!--and the Rotting Orchard.
text.progress: $N, how fares the hunt?
text.completion: Impressive, $N. It would seem that you are capable enough to handle yourself. Perhaps a more suitable challenge could be found for one of your abilities.$b$bIt is curious though... The worgen seemed to just appear out of thin air. But then, with all the other strange creatures that have moved across our borders, I suppose it's only one of many concerns.
text.completed: Return to Calor at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Look To The Stars
text.objectives: Viktori Prism'Antras of Darkshire wants you to bring him a bronze tube.
text.description: My Gnomish friend, Cog, has promised to help me build a device which will let me peer towards the stars.  A truth exists, beyond magic, that can explain the strange transformation in the forest.$b$bBring to me a bronze tube made by a skilled engineer.  That is the first step, according to Cog's blueprint.
text.progress: Have you found a skilled engineer to create a bronze tube yet?
text.completion: This is perfect, $N. The first step is complete!
text.completed: Return to Viktori Prism'Antras at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Look To The Stars
text.objectives: Locate Mary and persuade her to give up a reflective surface for Viktori's project.
text.description: According to Cog's blueprint, what I need now is a way to reflect light.  I remember a woman by the name of Mary who became well known around these parts for always carrying a looking glass.  Perhaps you can track Mary down and see if she might lend us a reflective surface for this project?  I believe she once resided in southern Duskwood. . .
text.completion: Why yes, I used to own a looking glass.

text.title: 通缉：霍格
text.objectives: 杀死豺狼人霍格，然后去见治安官杜汉。
text.description: 通缉：霍格$B$B巨型豺狼人霍格，现正在艾尔文森林西南部的树林里游荡。他成功地对抗了目前为止所有追捕他的行动。$B$B暴风城已经为除去这只豺狼人设下了酬金，想得到酬金的猎手必须进入那片丛林，消灭那头怪兽。
text.progress: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men. You have something to report about the beast?
text.completion: Hah! Well done! I was starting to think no one would take down that monster!$B$BHere you are, $N. And thanks - that Gnoll was giving me a headache the size of Blackrock Spire!
text.completed: Return to Marshal Dughan at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Wanted:  "Hogger"
english.objectives: Deal with "The Hogger Situation" and return to Marshal Dughan.
english.description: Wanted: Hogger$B$BA huge gnoll, Hogger, is prowling the woods in southwestern Elwynn.  He has overpowered all attempts at his capture.$B$BThe Stormwind Army has placed a generous bounty on the Gnoll.  To earn the reward, bounty hunters should venture into the woods and deal with the beast.
english.progress: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men. You have something to report about the beast?
english.completion: Hah! Well done! I was starting to think no one would take down that monster!$B$BHere you are, $N. And thanks - that Gnoll was giving me a headache the size of Blackrock Spire!
english.completed: Return to Marshal Dughan at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Look To The Stars
text.objectives: Retrieve Blind Mary's Looking Glass from the Insane Ghoul and give it to Viktori in Darkshire.
text.description: The looking glass was one of my finest treasures until. . .the incident.  After that happened, I discarded it behind the barn.  There was an Insane Ghoul who used to roam back there.  Perhaps he picked it up.  Rumor has it the devilish beast resides in the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.
text.progress: I showed Cog the beginnings of our star-viewing machine. He was impressed. Did you happen to find a reflective device?
text.completion: Most superb! This will work perfectly. Many thanks!
text.completed: Return to Viktori Prism'Antras at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: Theocritus' Retrieval
text.objectives: Bring the Faded Shadowhide Pendant to Theocritus the Mage at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.
text.description: <You hear a disembodied voice...>$B$BDo not be alarmed.  I am Theocritus, High Mage of Tower Azora in Elwynn Forest.  The pendant you are holding is a method of communication between the Shadowhide Gnolls and their master, Morganth.$B$BThrough months of research, I believe I too can communicate through these pendants.  If you can hear this message, then my spell was a success.$B$BBring me this pendant and I will reward you for the service.
text.progress: I spoke to you through a pendant, you say? Hmm...give it to me, so that I might study it.
text.completion: You have my gratitude, $N. I sent that message to the Shadowhide Pendants weeks ago and had believed it a failure. But it seems the spell did reach at least some pendants, after a significant delay.$B$BIn time I hope to learn how to send an attack through the pendants, to immobilize any Shadowhide Gnolls who wear them.$B$BBut before that is possible, I'm afraid that much more research is required.

english.objectives: Bring the Faded Shadowhide Pendant to Theocritus the Mage at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: Dwarven Outfitters
text.objectives: Sten Stoutarm would like 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat.
text.description: What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?$b$bI'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.$b$bI need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?
text.progress: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
text.completion: Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. Oh, don't worry, $N, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. Here, one of these should fit you.
text.completed: Return to Sten Stoutarm at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.
