text.title: 通缉：范高雷中尉
text.objectives: 杀死范高雷并将他的手掌割下，向湖畔镇的所罗门镇长复命。
text.description: 悬赏：范高雷$b$b恶行累累的豺狼人头目范高雷在湖畔镇及王国的敌人莫甘斯的指使下，带着暗皮豺狼人氏族到处为非作歹。镇长所罗门下了命令，悬赏杀死这个万恶的东西。将他的手掌割下来拿给镇长，以此证明他的死亡。
text.progress: What news do you bring before the Court?
text.completion: So the evil Lieutenant Fangore is dead? Good riddance to that foul creature. You are very brave, $C. The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
text.completed: Return to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

english.title: Wanted: Lieutenant Fangore
english.objectives: Kill Lieutenant Fangore and return to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire with his paw.
english.description: Wanted: Lieutenant Fangore$b$bKnown leader of the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan, working under the enemy of the Township and Kingdom, Morganth.  By mandate of Magistrate Solomon, this vile betrayer of Stormwind is wanted dead.  Show his paw to the Magistrate as proof of his death.
english.progress: What news do you bring before the Court?
english.completion: So the evil Lieutenant Fangore is dead? Good riddance to that foul creature. You are very brave, $C. The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
english.completed: Return to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Look To The Stars
text.objectives: Locate Zzarc'Vul in the southern ogre mound in Duskwood and return his monocle to Viktori in Darkshire.
text.description: Now there is just one more item needed to complete this device.  Cog's blueprint calls for a lens of some sort.  The only lens I know of that would be large enough will be very difficult to acquire.$b$bThere is an ogre by the name of Zzarc'Vul who resides in the mound in southern Duskwood.  If you can, bring to me his monocle and I will use that as our lens!
text.progress: Were you able to convince Zzarc'Vul to lend us his monocle for our experiment?
text.completion: At last! The stargazing device is complete! Thank you, $N. Now I can continue my research. . .
text.completed: Return to Viktori Prism'Antras at Darkshire in Duskwood.

If you can, bring to me his monocle and I will use that as our lens!

english.completed: Return to Viktori Prism'Antras at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: 巨魔的威胁
text.objectives: 杀死10个霜鬃巨魔新兵。
text.description: 巨魔越来越活跃了。要我说的话，是比通常更活跃。我们也不是没见过他们成群结伙地出战，但这一次……不太一样。$b$b不过，最重要的是保证安威玛尔的安全。我可不能让这些巨魔趁着安威玛尔全力应付石腭怪的时候，对它造成什么伤害。去削减他们的数量，让他们知道，我们并不是毫无防御能力。
text.progress: From what I've learned, these trolls hail from the Frostmane clan. I'm afraid I don't know much else about them that would be of any use to you, $N.
text.completion: Hopefully that did the trick.  Anvilmar will be safe from trolls for the time being.  Now, to find out what it is that has the trolls so agitated.
text.completed: Return to Grelin Whitebeard in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Troll Menace
english.objectives: Kill 10 Frostmane Troll Whelps.
english.description: The trolls're acting up.  More than usual, I'd say.  We've seen them put together war parties before, but this time it's... different.$b$bWhat matters most, however, is the continued protection of Anvilmar.  I've no intention to let these trolls flank Anvilmar while its attention is turned towards troggs.  Go thin their ranks a bit.  They need to know that we're still not without defenses.
english.progress: From what I've learned, these trolls hail from the Frostmane clan. I'm afraid I don't know much else about them that would be of any use to you, $N.
english.completion: Hopefully that did the trick.  Anvilmar will be safe from trolls for the time being.  Now, to find out what it is that has the trolls so agitated.
english.completed: Return to Grelin Whitebeard in Dun Morogh.

text.title: The Boar Hunter
text.objectives: Talin Keeneye would like you to kill 12 Small Crag Boars.
text.description: Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?$b$bThough, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.$b$bLong story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.
text.progress: How goes the hunt?
text.completion: Excellent! I can go back to my... leisurely... hunting now. Thank you, $N.
text.completed: Return to Talin Keeneye at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

english.title: The Boar Hunter
english.objectives: Talin Keeneye would like you to kill 12 Small Crag Boars.

They're all angry and ready without any help. english.progress: How goes the hunt?
english.completion: Excellent! I can go back to my... leisurely... hunting now. Thank you, $N.
english.completed: Return to Talin Keeneye at Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 法布隆的地契
text.objectives: 把法布隆的地契带到西部荒野的贾森农场去。
text.description: 这是一张位于西部荒野的农田旧地契，由西奥多·法布隆和他的妻子弗娜·法布隆联名签署。地契背面还有潦草的字样：$B$B“我们到法布隆家里走了一遭，弄到了他的地契。我们觉得你可以很轻易地照着这张样本给自己也造出几份地契来。$B$B法布隆家的人不会找我们的麻烦，我最后一次看到他们的时候，他们的马车坏在了离开西部荒野的路上。”$B$B你觉得法布隆夫妻俩可能正在到处找这张地契……
text.progress: You have the deed to my farm?? That's good news! Some ruffians stole it days ago... I thought it was gone for good!$b$bPlease, let me have it. We're on our way out of Westfall and ain't coming back any time soon, but if we do then we'll need those papers...
text.completion: Loads of thanks, $N! As I was saying, these parts aren't fit for honest folk anymore, but if things get better, then this deed will let us reclaim our land.$b$bI don't have much to offer you, but here -- take this.

english.title: Furlbrow's Deed
english.objectives: Bring Furlbrow's Deed to the Jansen Stead in Westfall.
english.description: This is an old deed to an expanse of farmlands within Westfall.  It is signed by a Theodore Furlbrow and cosigned by his wife, Verna.  And on the back of the deed are hastily scrawled words:$B$B"We leaned on Furlbrow and got his deed.  Thought it might be handy if you wanted to forge one of these for your own place.$B$BThe Furlbrows won't give us trouble.  Last I saw them they were on their way out of Westfall, stuck with a broken wagon."$B$BYou think the Furlbrows might want their deed back...
english.progress: You have the deed to my farm?? That's good news! Some ruffians stole it days ago... I thought it was gone for good!$b$bPlease, let me have it. We're on our way out of Westfall and ain't coming back any time soon, but if we do then we'll need those papers...
english.completion: Loads of thanks, $N! As I was saying, these parts aren't fit for honest folk anymore, but if things get better, then this deed will let us reclaim our land.$b$bI don't have much to offer you, but here -- take this.

text.title: 捕杀猛虎
text.objectives: 猎杀10只荆棘谷猛虎幼崽。
text.description: 当我还只是个小女孩的时候，我的父亲就开始训练我捕猎老虎。$b$b一般来说，你会发现虎崽是非常容易追踪和猎杀的，在探险队的营地附近很容易就能找到虎崽。$b$b让我们来测试一下你的追踪技巧，看看你是否能猎杀这些野兽。到南边，靠近我们营地的地方去练练手吧。
text.progress: I don't feel confident in training you further, $n, until you have proven yourself skilled in slaying the youngest of the tigers first.
text.completion: Nicely done, $n.  You are ready to move on.
text.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Tiger Hunting
english.objectives: Hunt 10 Young Stranglethorn Tigers.
english.description: When I was but a young girl, my father trained me in the art of tiger hunting.$b$bYou'll find the young felines much easier to track and slay.  One can often find young tigers near the expedition camp.$b$bTest your tracking skills and see if you can hunt some of the beasts down.  Start your hunt near our camp, to the south.
english.progress: I don't feel confident in training you further, $n, until you have proven yourself skilled in slaying the youngest of the tigers first.
english.completion: Nicely done, $n.  You are ready to move on.
english.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 追踪猛虎
text.objectives: 猎杀10只荆棘谷猛虎。
text.description: 虎崽是一回事，成年的猛虎则是另一回事。在荆棘谷猎杀成年的猛虎就更有挑战性了。$b$b成年虎主要在河东边的库尔森的营地南边一带活动。
text.progress: If you strive for greater challenges you must first prove yourself with the task at hand. Return to me after you've killed 10 Stranglethorn Tigers.
text.completion: I am impressed, $c.  You are progressing quite well.
text.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Tiger Stalking
english.objectives: Hunt 10 Stranglethorn Tigers.
english.description: Young tigers are one thing.  Fully-grown cats are another.  Hunting the grown Stranglethorn tigers will prove an even greater challenge.$b$bThe adult cats normally spend their days south of Kurzen's Compound, east of the river.
english.progress: If you strive for greater challenges you must first prove yourself with the task at hand. Return to me after you've killed 10 Stranglethorn Tigers.
english.completion: I am impressed, $c.  You are progressing quite well.
english.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 勇斗猛虎
text.objectives: 猎杀5只老年荆棘谷猛虎。
text.description: 老年的荆棘谷猛虎是最强壮的老虎。不止一个$r$c丧命于这些尖牙利爪的猛兽。$B$B如果艾耶克得知你击败了这些猛虎，一定会非常兴奋的。大批的老年猛虎聚集在在南边的地陷裂口附近，就在与荆棘谷海角的交界处。
text.progress: You must kill 10 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers before I give you the final challenge that will determine if you are a true tiger hunting master.
text.completion: Most impressive.  I believe you are almost ready.
text.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Tiger Prowess
english.objectives: Hunt 5 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers.
english.description: Elder Stranglethorn tigers are the strongest of the bunch.  More than one $r $c has seen $g his: her; own demise at the tip of those razor-sharp teeth and heavy claws.$b$bAjeck will be thrilled to know that you have bested them.  The largest pack of these elders can be found to the south, near the Sundering, on the border of the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.progress: You must kill 10 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers before I give you the final challenge that will determine if you are a true tiger hunting master.
english.completion: Most impressive.  I believe you are almost ready.
english.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 制服猛虎
text.objectives: 猎杀辛达尔，并带回它的爪子。
text.description: 传说中，有一只神秘的母虎……它强大到足以令老年的雄虎相形见绌。奈辛瓦里远征队的猎人曾经尝试猎杀它，但总是无功而返。他们中有许多人死于它的利爪，尸首留在格罗姆高北边的山脚下。$B$B他们称它为辛达尔。$B$B你决定做一件从来没有$r做到过的事：猎杀辛达尔，将它的爪子作为战利品。
text.progress: How goes the hunt?
text.completion: Most impressive, I do say!  You are a true Master Tiger Hunter, $N!
text.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 它喜欢在自己的山头上俯视其它弱小的老虎。

english.title: Tiger Mastery
english.objectives: Hunt Sin'Dall and return with her paw.
english.description: Legends speak of an elusive tigress... a feline so powerful that she dwarfs even the elder males.  The hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition have hunted for her without success.  Many of them have fallen prey to her raking claws, their bodies now decaying at the foot of her hill, north of Grom'gol.$b$bThey call the beast Sin'Dall.$b$bYou resolve to do what no $r has done before: hunt, kill, and claim the paw of Sin'Dall.
english.progress: How goes the hunt?
english.completion: Most impressive, I do say!  You are a true Master Tiger Hunter, $N!
english.completed: Return to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: She prefers to look down upon the weaker tigers from atop her hill.

text.title: Bloodscalp Ears
text.objectives: Acquire 15 Bloodscalp Ears and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.
text.description: Damn trolls! They've been killing off our agents in the jungle! I've already lost a good number of my best guards to skirmishes with them. The costs are piling up! How will I explain this to Baron Revilgaz?$b$bDecisive action... Think, Kebok... you weren't assigned to the post you have today for sitting around... I've got it! You... $n, is it? You'll help me, won't you? There's money to be had!$b$bHere's the deal... you bring me the ears of fifteen Bloodscalp Trolls, and I'll compensate you well.
text.progress: You've had success I hope? All over the place, those trolls. Filthy devils.$b$bOh yes, that reminds me! Be sure to tell your friends, yes? We could use much assistance!
text.completion: Oh excellent, excellent. That'll help a little, for the present...$b$b<He trails off, grumbling about profit margins and costs...>$b$bWhat? You're still here? Reward? Oh, right... of course, here, take this... it should be more than enough.
text.completed: Return to Kebok at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.objectives: Acquire 15 Bloodscalp Ears and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.
english.description: Damn trolls! They've been killing off our agents in the jungle! I've already lost a good number of my best guards to skirmishes with them. The costs are piling up! How will I explain this to Baron Revilgaz?$b$bDecisive action... Think, Kebok... you weren't assigned to the post you have today for sitting around... I've got it! You... $n, is it? You'll help me, won't you? There's money to be had!$b$bHere's the deal... you bring me the ears of fifteen Bloodscalp Trolls, and I'll compensate you well.
english.progress: You've had success I hope? All over the place, those trolls. Filthy devils.$b$bOh yes, that reminds me! Be sure to tell your friends, yes? We could use much assistance!
english.completion: Oh excellent, excellent. That'll help a little, for the present...$b$b<He trails off, grumbling about profit margins and costs...>$b$bWhat? You're still here? Reward? Oh, right... of course, here, take this... it should be more than enough.
english.completed: Return to Kebok at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 捕杀猎豹
text.objectives: 猎杀10只猎豹幼崽。
text.description: 如果你也想加入这个由赫米特先生组建的最强狩猎队，就必须先证明自己是一个能干的猎豹高手。放心，一开始不会太难的，千万别轻言放弃。你先去猎杀一些猎豹幼崽热热身吧。当你有了一些狩猎经验之后，自然会遇到更加危险的猎物。$B$B从东边开始吧。等你成为捕杀猎豹的行家之后再回来找我吧。
text.progress: A true panther hunter would be out in the fields, trying to stalk his prey. Show some commitment to your goal, $c, and get back out there.
text.completion: Off to a good start, $N!
text.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Panther Hunting
english.objectives: Hunt 10 Young Panthers.
english.description: If you want to be a part of the hunt with this crack group under Hemet Jr.'s leadership, you're going to need to prove yourself an able panther hunter.  You should start out easy: just focus on the young panthers for now.  As you improve and gain experience as a hunter, you will undoubtedly find increasingly dangerous quarry.$b$bStart by heading east.  Return to me when you are a master panther hunter.
english.progress: A true panther hunter would be out in the fields, trying to stalk his prey. Show some commitment to your goal, $c, and get back out there.
english.completion: Off to a good start, $N!
english.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 追踪猎豹
text.objectives: 猎杀10只黑豹。
text.description: 猎豹的幼崽对你来说不成问题。然而成年的猎豹显然更加强壮迅捷，它们可不比之前的猎豹幼崽那么好杀。$B$B到西边去寻找它们吧。
text.progress: Bhag'thera can prove to be an elusive beast. How fairs the hunt?
text.completion: Perfectly executed, $N!
text.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Panther Stalking
english.objectives: Hunt 10 Panthers.
english.description: The youngest panthers fell easily before you.  Panthers that have come of age will naturally be stronger, and quicker, and more difficult to defeat.$b$bLarger panther tracks lead to the west.
english.progress: Bhag'thera can prove to be an elusive beast. How fairs the hunt?
english.completion: Perfectly executed, $N!
english.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 勇斗猎豹
text.objectives: 猎杀5只深喉猎豹。
text.description: 接下来的部分可就比较困难了。当猎豹生存得够久时，它们就会变得非常狡猾，会将自己隐匿在周边的环境中，很难发现。这些狡诈的猎豹就是“深喉猎豹”，它们会从暗处突然跳出来……张开血盆大口袭击你。$B$B如果你想证明自己的猎豹能力，就拿深喉猎豹来试试看吧。它们在东南方的河对岸游荡。
text.progress: Bhag'thera can prove to be an elusive beast. How fairs the hunt?
text.completion: The shadowmaw panthers proved no match for your skills as a hunter.  Only one task remains.
text.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Panther Prowess
english.objectives: Hunt 5 Shadowmaw Panthers.
english.description: Now the hard part.  As panthers grow older, they become more wily, blending in with their environment and becoming difficult to spot.  These cunning panthers are known by the name "shadowmaw", for their tendency to suddenly appear out of the darkness... with a waiting mouth full of teeth.$b$bIf you want to prove yourself as a true panther hunter, shadowmaws are the only way to do so.  They prowl to the southeast, across the river.
english.progress: Bhag'thera can prove to be an elusive beast. How fairs the hunt?
english.completion: The shadowmaw panthers proved no match for your skills as a hunter.  Only one task remains.
english.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 制服猎豹
text.objectives: 获得巴尔瑟拉的牙。
text.description: 你几乎已经证明自己是一位优秀的猎豹能手了。但是仍有一只强大的豹子没有被你征服。$B$B它叫巴尔瑟拉。使出你的浑身解数，去试试猎杀这头猛兽吧。$b$b将巴尔瑟拉的牙齿带回来交给埃尔加丁，以此证明你是一位出色的猎豹能手。
text.progress: You're still alive!  Excellent!  How fares the hunt?
text.completion: So the great Bhag'thera is dead!  Cheers to you, $N.  You are a mighty $c indeed!
text.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Panther Mastery
english.objectives: Obtain the Fang of Bhag'thera.
english.description: You've almost proven yourself to be a master hunter of panthers.  Yet there is one panther which has eluded your grasp.$b$bSongs are sung about a mighty panther by the name of Bhag'thera.  You will see if you can use your skills to kill the great beast.$b$bBringing the Fang of Bhag'thera to Erlgadin should be proof enough that you are a master panther hunter.
english.progress: You're still alive!  Excellent!  How fares the hunt?
english.completion: So the great Bhag'thera is dead!  Cheers to you, $N.  You are a mighty $c indeed!
english.completed: Return to Sir S. J. Erlgadin at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 捕杀迅猛龙
text.objectives: 猎杀10只荆棘谷迅猛龙。
text.description: 你觉得你的狩猎技术是最顶尖的？我马上就检验一下，看看你是不是在骗人。到丛林里去杀十只荆棘谷迅猛龙，这样一来我们就知道你是不是所谓的王牌猎人了。$b$b当然，我是绝对不会告诉你在哪里才能找到它们的！追踪野兽本身就是挑战的一部分。$B$B好了，去西边吧。
text.progress: I never met a hunter who got any kills by standing around the campfire - well, except for my father. Were you planning on killing those Stranglethorn Raptors or were you hoping they would die of old age?
text.completion: Nicely done, $g old chap : m'lady;!
text.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Raptor Hunting
english.objectives: Hunt 10 Stranglethorn Raptors.
english.description: So you think your hunting skills are in tip-top shape?  I can put them to the test in a jiffy.  Head out into that jungle and kill ten Stranglethorn raptors.  We'll see just how much of a big game hunter you are.$b$bAnd no, I won't tell you where you can find them!  Locating the beasts is half the challenge.$b$bOkay, go west.
english.progress: I never met a hunter who got any kills by standing around the campfire - well, except for my father. Were you planning on killing those Stranglethorn Raptors or were you hoping they would die of old age?
english.completion: Nicely done, $g old chap : m'lady;!
english.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 追踪迅猛龙
text.objectives: 猎杀10只鞭尾迅猛龙。
text.description: 现在让我们来看看你能不能应付更大的挑战吧。杀进丛林里去，干掉十只鞭尾迅猛龙。显然，它们比你之前干掉的那些迅猛龙更加强壮。$b$b鞭尾迅猛龙主要在这里的东南方，卡莱废墟附近。
text.progress: A true hunter sets his focus on his prey. You, my friend, seem more concerned with chit-chatting around the campfire. Now get out there and kill 10 Lashtails before I go and rid the entire bloody jungle of them in one hunt.
text.completion: Now that's how you get a trophy or two over the ol' hearth!  Nice killing, $N!
text.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Raptor Stalking
english.objectives: Hunt 10 Lashtail Raptors.
english.description: It is time to step up the challenge.  Venturing into the jungle and bagging 10 lashtail raptors should be sufficient.  They will certainly be stronger than the raptors you have already disposed of.$b$bThe lashtail raptors mainly stay southeast of here, near the Kal'ai Ruins.
english.progress: A true hunter sets his focus on his prey. You, my friend, seem more concerned with chit-chatting around the campfire. Now get out there and kill 10 Lashtails before I go and rid the entire bloody jungle of them in one hunt.
english.completion: Now that's how you get a trophy or two over the ol' hearth!  Nice killing, $N!
english.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 勇斗迅猛龙
text.objectives: 猎杀10只丛林捕猎者。
text.description: 这里的南边，跨过河水的地方，栖息着一种非常狡猾的迅猛龙，当地人叫它“丛林捕猎者”。它们远比你之前捕猎的目标更难追踪和猎杀。$B$B去干掉这些丛林捕猎者，你就可以成为营地里的话题人物了……
text.progress: Bah! What are you doing standing around, $N! A true big game hunter never gives up once his prey is in his sights. Those Jungle Stalkers aren't going to come running up to this campfire and throw themselves in it. Silly bloke.
text.completion: Ho ho!! We have ourselves a true raptor slayer!  Nicely done, $g old chap : fair lady;!
text.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Raptor Prowess
english.objectives: Hunt 10 Jungle Stalkers.
english.description: A particularly cagey brand of raptor, known by locals as the "Jungle Stalker", prowls the forests to the south, across the river.  They are far more difficult to track down and kill than the other breeds you've been trying your luck at.$b$bKilling these Jungle Stalkers will undoubtedly make for a good tale around the fire.
english.progress: Bah! What are you doing standing around, $N! A true big game hunter never gives up once his prey is in his sights. Those Jungle Stalkers aren't going to come running up to this campfire and throw themselves in it. Silly bloke.
english.completion: Ho ho!! We have ourselves a true raptor slayer!  Nicely done, $g old chap : fair lady;!
english.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 制服迅猛龙
text.objectives: 猎杀泰希斯。
text.description: 在返回奈辛瓦里远征队营地之前，你必须完成一项极其艰巨的任务：猎杀一头从来都没人抓住过的迅猛龙，它叫泰希斯，在北荆棘谷的东南角作威作福。$B$B把泰希斯的爪子交给那个矮人，应该足以证明你不是普通的$r了。
text.progress: Ah, so you're hunting Tethis?  Tracked her all the way back to camp, did you?
text.completion: $G Master : Mistress; $N, the raptor slayer!$b$bHas a nice ring to it, eh?
text.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 泰希斯只靠吃蓝莓和奈辛瓦里远征队的猎人就可以过活。

english.title: Raptor Mastery
english.objectives: Hunt Tethis.
english.description: Before returning to Nesingwary's Expedition, you will have to complete the impossible: hunt the raptor that no other hunter has been able to capture.  That beast goes by the name of Tethis, and he's been known to terrorize the southeastern corner of Northern Stranglethorn.$b$bBringing Tethis' talon back to that dwarf hunter should be proof that you are no ordinary $r.
english.progress: Ah, so you're hunting Tethis?  Tracked her all the way back to camp, did you?
english.completion: $G Master : Mistress; $N, the raptor slayer!$b$bHas a nice ring to it, eh?
english.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: Tethis survives solely on a diet of blueberries and Nesingwary hunters.

text.title: Supplies to Private Thorsen
text.objectives: Deliver the Miscellaneous Goblin Supplies to Private Thorsen.
text.description: Hmm. Yes, I do have something you could do, actually. Lieutenant Doren and his followers up in the north need their regular supplies from us.$b$bThey haven't been delivered, and with the trolls attacking, I'll need someone to do it. Doren's camp lies northwest of the road at the entrance to Stranglethorn from Duskwood. Give the supplies to Private Thorsen, if he's not in the camp, then he'll be patrolling south of it. He'll take care of them.$b$bMind you, if you fail, you'll owe me restitution.
text.progress: Yes? What do you want? Oh, supplies from the goblins. Strange seeing a $R delivering them, usually they send their own. No matter... you didn't touch them did you? Good good... we wouldn't want anything to happen to our mines, oh no.
text.completion: These land mines will help us defend ourselves from that animal Kurzen and his men. Thank you for bringing them. If you need further work, I can probably find something for you to do. And you won't have to deal with those goblins, hm?
text.completed: Report to Private Thorsen in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: A Dark Threat Looms
text.objectives: Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and show him the clue that you discovered.
text.description: You take a sample of the strange smelling powder.
text.progress: Did you happen to discover any clues, $N?
text.completion: This is an alarming discovery, to say the least!

english.completion: This is an alarming discovery, to say the least!

enders.name: 主工程师辛德维尔七世

text.title: Bookie Herod
text.objectives: Find Bookie Herod's Records.
text.description: If Kurzen knows Thorsen's secret, then we have a spy in our midst.  We must determine how the secret was leaked!$B$BThorsen's contact within Kurzen's camp was Bookie Herod.  Herod is Kurzen's logistics officer and knows everything about the running of Kurzen's Compound.  If you can get Herod's notes or records, maybe we can find out how Thorsen was discovered.$B$BWhen we were still with Kurzen, Bookie's office was on the top floor of the camp's only two-story house.  His records are probably still there.
text.completion: These are Bookie Herod's notes and records.$b$bAmong them are: a list of supplies within the camp, material requests from Colonel Kurzen, and various letters and correspondences.
text.completed: Find Bookie Herod's Records in Stranglethorn Vale.

His records are probably still there.
english.completion: These are Bookie Herod's notes and records.$b$bAmong them are: a list of supplies within the camp, material requests from Colonel Kurzen, and various letters and correspondences.
english.completed: Find Bookie Herod's Records in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: Investigate the Camp
text.objectives: Find the hunters' camp and report its location to Krazek in Booty Bay.
text.description: I've gotten reports of a group of hunters that have set up camp upriver of the Venture Company mining camp on Lake Nazferiti.  Now, normally I wouldn't care, but improbably, I heard that Hemet Nesingwary Jr. was one of the hunters there.  He's certainly well-connected, if you catch my meaning, and you never can be too safe.$b$bWhy don't you go check out the camp, $n, see what they're about?
text.progress: Well?  Did you have any luck in locating the camp?
text.completion: Hmmm, so my information was correct, as usual. Interesting. Well, I don't suppose they pose any sort of threat of interference with our operation, but perhaps they have a need for some of our excellent manufactured products. Hmmm...
text.completed: Return to Krazek at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: Colonel Kurzen
text.objectives: Kill 6 Kurzen Elite, 4 Kurzen Subchiefs, and bring Kurzen's Head to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.
text.description: You have proven yourself time and again, and your resourcefulness seems to rival even that of Kurzen himself.  You may be the salvation of our band of rebels...if you can pit yourself against Kurzen and prevail!$B$BHe commands his men from deep within the Stockpile.  You must enter that cave, brave through his defenders, and face Kurzen and his leaders.$B$BFarewell, $n.  My hope, and the fate of my men, go with you.
text.progress: Dare I hope that Kurzen and his defenders are dead, $N?
text.completion: I dared not believe the reports, but you bring us proof that... Kurzen and his leaders are defeated. You have saved us!$B$BThese jungles are filled with menaces of all types, but none had the cruel intellect of Kurzen. We may all breathe easier now that he is gone.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Doren at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Doren at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: The Second Rebellion
text.objectives: Kill 15 Kurzen Jungle Fighters.$B$BReturn to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
text.description: We're fighting a losing battle with Colonel Kurzen.  Not only is he a brilliant tactician, he outnumbers us at least 10 to 1!  To survive, we need to use his own, covert tactics against him.$B$BEnter his camp to the east and kill his men.  Lots of them.  And get out before reinforcements can close on you.
text.progress: I hope you've been successful in your hunting, $N. We won't last long against him without your help.
text.completion: Well done. The loss of those Jungle Fighters will relieve some of the pressure on our camp.$b$bBut now that you've had a taste of the forces we're up against, do you still want to throw your lot in with us??
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Yohwa at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: Bad Medicine
text.objectives: Bring 7 Jungle Remedies and 1 Venom Fern Extract to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
text.description: To have a chance against Kurzen, we need his healing support neutralized.  He has gathered a large number of medicine men who heal his forces with jungle remedies and poison our fighters with venom fern extracts.$B$BWe need those remedies and extracts for our own.  Search the Kurzen Compound - his medicine men and jungle fighters will have the remedies, and the extracts are probably stowed in some of the camp's supply boxes.
text.progress: I'm waiting on those remedies and that extract, $N.
text.completion: Well done, $N. These remedies will keep more of us alive and in fighting shape. And the extracts will help us create our own remedies.
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Yohwa at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: Troll Witchery
text.objectives: Bring 4 Skullsplitter Fetishes to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
text.description: While I study those legends you acquired, gather for me implements of evil troll magic.  Enter the territory of the Skullsplitter trolls, a second tribe to the distant south, and acquire Skullsplitter Fetishes from their Witchdoctors and Mystics.
text.progress: Do you have those fetishes, $N? They might hold the secret to Kurzen's degradation...I must know!
text.completion: Thank you.  I will study these fetishes and see if they hold the secret of Kurzen's fall into evil.
text.completed: Return to Brother Nimetz at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: Mai'Zoth
text.objectives: Bring the Mind's Eye to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
text.description: Kurzen may be dead, but...that which drove him to evil still lives!  Through my studies I have discovered this: An Ogre Mage - Mai'Zoth - dwells in an Ogre Mound within the eastern mountains of Stranglethorn.  He is rumored to employ mind-controlling magic, and I am positive that he corrupted Kurzen.$B$BIf Mai'Zoth is allowed to live, then his evil may influence others, and may even cause another Kurzen to surface.$B$BKill him, and bring me his Mind's Eye, the artifact he uses to corrupt others.
text.progress: I give you my blessing. Mai'Zoth's strength is matched only by his evil.
text.completion: Aha! You've done it! You are a great force for good, $N, and may your strength never fade!$B$BI will study this Mind's Eye and determine if it may be used for good. If not... then it must be destroyed.
text.completed: Return to Brother Nimetz at Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: Kurzen's Mystery
text.objectives: Find the 4 tablets and bring their legends back to Brother Nimetz.
text.description: Colonel Kurzen was once a great, noble man - I must find what caused his fall into depravity!  He may be under the sway of troll magic.  To confirm this, I must study some of their legends.$B$BThere are 4 tablets hidden within the troll ruins of Stranglethorn.  I must see what is written on these tablets!  Transcribe their markings and bring the transcriptions back to me.$B$BThe first tablet is in the Bal'lal Ruins, the second is in the Vile Reef, and the third and fourth are in the Ruins of Zul'Kunda.
text.progress: $N! Do you have the troll legends? I must know their secrets!
text.completion: Thank you, $N. I will study these legends to see if there is some link between the trolls and the evil that has possessed Colonel Kurzen.
text.completed: Return to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 王牌猎人
text.objectives: 猎杀白色的虎王邦加拉什，获得它的头颅。
text.description: $n，你现在已经成为了一位够格进入我们狩猎队的猎手了。无论是洛丹伦的战场还是危机四伏的丛林，我在哪里都没有见过有谁能像你这样拥有如此强大的战斗能力。$b$b你成功地杀死了凶残的辛达尔，狡猾的巴尔瑟拉和奸诈的泰希斯。但对于这片丛林中的猎人们来说，虎王邦加拉什的头才代表着至高无上的荣耀。这只白虎正是我来这里的原因……但是，它仍在南边的巢穴中嘲笑着我。如果你能杀死虎王邦加拉什，那么你无疑是这里最优秀的猎人。
text.progress: I see you're back, $g old bloke : lass;.  King Bangalash has caused me to come crawling back to camp many times.  Hang in there.
text.completion: Bloody well done!  Right-o!  Congratulations, $N, for succeeding where others have failed.$b$bI am honored to count you as a comrade of our great hunting party here.  No one will ever doubt your expertise in hunting and tracking!$b$bCheers to you, I say!  Cheers!
text.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: 它是这片丛林中最致命的猎手……除了你。

english.title: Big Game Hunter
english.objectives: Hunt for the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
english.description: $n, you are a hunter worthy of our company.  From the battlefields of Lordaeron to the deepest jungle, I have rarely witnessed such prowess with weaponry as you have demonstrated.$b$bYou have killed the ferocious Sin'Dall, the elusive Bhag'thera, and the treacherous Tethis.  But the true prize is the head of King Bangalash.  That white tiger is the reason I am here... yet still, he taunts me from his roost to the south.  Kill King Bangalash and your hunting prowess is proven to be second to none.
english.progress: I see you're back, $g old bloke : lass;.  King Bangalash has caused me to come crawling back to camp many times.  Hang in there.
english.completion: Bloody well done!  Right-o!  Congratulations, $N, for succeeding where others have failed.$b$bI am honored to count you as a comrade of our great hunting party here.  No one will ever doubt your expertise in hunting and tracking!$b$bCheers to you, I say!  Cheers!
english.completed: Return to Hemet Nesingwary Jr. at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: He is the deadliest thing in this jungle... other than you.

text.title: Skullsplitter Tusks
text.objectives: Acquire 18 Skullsplitter Tusks and return them to Kebok.
text.description: It's expensive and hard to kill enough tigers to support the export of tiger fangs to the islands in the South Seas. Luckily, we've developed a technique that allows us to take mundane horn-like objects and turn them into undetectable forgeries.$b$bThe closest match we've found, amazingly, are the tusks of the Skullsplitter trolls.$b$bHey, before you say anything, what the buyer doesn't know doesn't hurt them, am I right? Bring me a large number of them so we can get to work on the monthly shipment!
text.progress: Tough buggers, aren't they? Well, have you had any luck? Sorry to seem impatient, but this has been a huge thorn in my side! Well?
text.completion: Ah, good work, good work! Ugh, though you could have done a better job cleaning off the-- Well, no matter, no matter! My thanks to you, $N, our operation will no doubt see increased output and productivity thanks to your help! Good good, now, onto other matters...
text.completed: Return to Kebok at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: Krazek's Cookery
text.objectives: Bring Krazek's Crock Pot to Krazek the goblin.
text.description: I do most of the cooking at the camp.  And it used to be a lot of work, until I bought a mechanical cooking pot from a goblin merchant in Booty Bay.  The pot is a wonder!  It saved me countless hours...until it broke!$B$BCan you take the pot back to the goblin for me so he can fix it?  His name is Krazek.
text.progress: Hello! You brought me something?
text.completion: Oh I see, it's a Krazek's Crock Pot! An ingenious piece of work, but it can break a spring or throw a gear now and then. Let me see what's wrong with this one...$b$bAha! Its steam charger is rusted out, it has a cracked knuckle-gasket and its fobulator is missing teeth. I'm surprised the pot could even boil a turnip in this state!$b$bCan I fix it? Of course I can fix it!$b$bBut there's a price. Oh yes, there is always a price...
text.completed: Report to Krazek at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: Alas, Andorhal
text.objectives: Bring Araj's Phylactery Shard to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
text.description: Alas, the time to attack Andorhal and drive out the lich that controls it is upon us!$B$BInside the ruins of the city is where the lich - Araj the Summoner - holds dominion.  He is guarded by numerous Scourge surrounding the remains of city's center, and his personal retinue of guardians attached to him directly is formidable.  You will need numerous allies to even stand a chance of facing him successfully.$B$BDestroy Araj, $n, and bring me a shard from his phylactery as proof!
text.progress: Your task has been given to you, $N.  Do you have a shard from the lich's phylactery as proof of the task being accomplished?
text.completion: You've done it!  Araj... the lich is finally defeated!$B$BYou've done a tremendous service to the Alliance on this day, $N.  Your bravery and perseverance are a testament to what it means to be a true hero.  Please - accept this as a token for all to see and know that you have delivered the Alliance a victory for the ages!
text.completed: Return to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

enders.name: 指挥官阿什拉姆·瓦罗菲斯特

text.title: A Meal Served Cold
text.objectives: Kill a Cold Eye Basilisk, get a Chilled Basilisk Haunch, and return it to Angus Stern in the Blue Recluse.
text.description: One of my most famous dishes is Chilled Basilisk in Lime Vinaigrette.  But the problem is... the meat is impossible to keep fresh, and I must serve the dish tonight for a noble's birthday!$B$BSo if you can bring me a Chilled Basilisk Haunch from a freshly-killed Cold Eye Basilisk, quickly, then I will owe you a king's feast!$B$BCold Eye Basilisks are known to roam along the beach dunes of northwestern Stranglethorn, so you have much traveling to do.  And be swift!
text.progress: $N! Do you have that haunch? I must begin preparing it soon, or the banquet will be ruined!
text.completion: Ah, this will do nicely! Many, many thanks!$b$bNow if you'll excuse me, I must get the haunch chopped, marinated and garnished for the banquet.
text.completed: Return to Angus Stern at the Blue Reclue in Stormwind City.

text.title: Hostile Takeover
text.objectives: Retrieve 8 Tumbled Crystals and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.
text.description: He's done it this time! Bad enough that Gelriz's muscling out the moguls who were appointed by the trade princes, now he tries to cut in on the most notorious pirate!$b$bRevilgaz won't have it, and he's told me to take care of the problem in my own way.$b$bMy way? Theft. The Venture Co. geologists near Lake Nazferiti are deeply interested in those strange blue crystals they have been finding in the mines. Bring me samples of the stone from their geologists, I don't care what you have to do to get them.
text.progress: I need those stones, $n. By whatever means necessary! Just do it, don't give me the details!$b$bIt's about results, $n, nothing more, nothing less.
text.completion: Fascinating. That the crystals have been tumbled using this process can only indicate that they are planning to use them as some sort of fuel or other catalyst. I don't know much more than that. Samples will have to be dispatched to Head Chemist Gigglefont.
text.completed: Return to Kebok at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: Red Silk Bandanas
text.objectives: Scout Riell at the Sentinel Hill Tower wants you to bring her 10 Red Silk Bandanas.
text.description: It's no secret that the trademark of the Defias Gang is their Red Bandanas.  But we've learned that the material from which these bandanas are made signifies the member's rank.$b$bThat being said, I want you to eliminate as many high ranking Defias members as you can.  The highest ranking members will undoubtedly be found in VanCleef's secret hideout.  When you're done bring me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof of their deaths and I will reward you.  Good luck, $n.
text.progress: Have you been reclaiming our land from the Defias gang? If so show me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof.
text.completion: Well done, $N! On behalf of The People's Militia I salute you for your efforts. Soon we will return this land to the people with help from brave souls like you.
text.completed: Return to Scout Riell in Westfall.

text.title: Jungle Secrets
text.objectives: Speak with Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.
text.description: Thank you for saving me, $n.  I know how this looks, but...allow me to explain.$B$BI was charged by Lieutenant Doren to re-enlist with Kurzen's men, so that I might spy on them and bring sorely needed intelligence to the rebels.  You saw here what I had thought would be my chance to infiltrate Kurzen's Compound.  I was wrong, and again, thanks for saving me.$B$BThis was a top secret mission, so you must tell no one.  But if you speak with Doren he will explain.
text.completion: Yes, what Thorsen told you is true. You must be discrete with this. At one time, we rebels were fiercely loyal to Colonel Kurzen. But such was Kurzen's corruption, our passion twisted into rage.  If it was made known that Private Thorsen has had recent dealings with Kurzen's men, then one night he would find himself with a slit throat.$b$bTo my knowledge, only Sergeant Yohwa, Thorsen and I were privy to Thorsen's mission. But there must be another. A traitor.
text.completed: Speak with Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 蓟皮熊怪的麻烦
text.objectives: 地狱咆哮岗哨的卡拉恩·阿玛卡希望你消灭15个蓟皮村的蓟皮熊怪。
text.description: 蓟皮熊怪已经对我们的扩张造成了威胁！我们西面的蓟皮村挡住了从这里通往碎木哨岗的道路，这条道路本应环绕阿斯特兰纳的村庄而建，没有它，我们就会让联盟得到一条额外的扩张途径。$B$B$n，我们决不允许有这样的缺口存在！$B$B进入蓟皮村，尽量减少那些熊怪的数量。我会给你任务报酬的，但更重要的是，你将为部落尽一份力！
text.progress: Have you taken the fight to the Thistlefur?  With a clear path between our bases, our chances of claiming the whole of Ashenvale increase dramatically.
text.completion: Well done $C, well done! I will continue to send forces to thin out the furbolg, but I can at least count on a different path that will be free of Alliance entanglements. The Horde conquest of Ashenvale is now in full swing!$b$bYou've earned your pay this day, hero. I salute you!
text.completed: Return to Karang Amakkar at Hellscream's Watch in Ashenvale.

english.title: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur
english.objectives: Karang Amakkar at Hellscream's Watch wants you to take down any 15 Thistlefur furbolg in Thistlefur Village.
english.description: The Thistlefur furbolgs are threatening our expansion!  Thistlefur Village to our west blocks the way between us here and the Splintertree Post.  It's a path that would circumvent the village of Astranaar; without it, we give the Alliance an extra expansion path.$B$B$n, we must not allow... an expansion path gap!$B$BProceed to Thistlefur Village and thin out the furbolgs.  You will be given compensation for this task, but more importantly you will be doing your duty for the Horde!
english.progress: Have you taken the fight to the Thistlefur?  With a clear path between our bases, our chances of claiming the whole of Ashenvale increase dramatically.

The Horde conquest of Ashenvale is now in full swing!$b$bYou've earned your pay this day, hero. I salute you!
english.completed: Return to Karang Amakkar at Hellscream's Watch in Ashenvale.

text.title: A Decisive Strike
text.objectives: Kill the trogg leader, Grawmug, and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler, and then report back to Captain Rugelfuss in Thelsamar.
text.description: My ploy worked. It appears that these beasts in Loch Modan are following the lead of a chieftain named Grawmug. Grawmug is heavily guarded, however. Two of his most elite guards, Gnasher and Brawler, never leave his side.$b$bIf you feel yourself worthy, $n, I want you to lead the assassination mission on Grawmug and his two thugs inside this cave. Go! I'll free myself from these bindings and meet you shortly.
text.progress: Grawmug and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler, are still alive. Your mission is not complete until all 3 have been brought to death. The Dwarven empire is counting on you, $N.
text.completion: Most excellent, $N! You have brought hope to Loch Modan. With Grawmug dead, we stand a better chance of seeing the Troggs eliminated from the land.

text.title: 冰与火
text.objectives: 杀死冷酷的格瑞克尼尔、6个霜鬃剑士，3个霜鬃巨魔新兵以及游荡的火元素。
text.description: 索林派你出去巡查是个正确的选择。你弄到了一些很有价值的情报。$B$B问题是，这样一来我们就有更多事情要做了。那些晕头转向的巨魔仍然想要把矮人赶出寒脊山谷，而我绝对不会允许某些浑身冒火的恶魔把我们白雪皑皑的山谷变成湖泊。$B$B巨魔的头领，他的仆从，以及那个冒火的怪物，他们都在东南方的洞穴中。去把他们一网打尽。
text.progress: $N! Any luck?
text.completion: I'm glad you've returned safely, $n.  While it may not look like it now, you've proven to be a tremendous asset in the protection of Anvilmar.$b$bHere, take this as a symbol of my gratitude.
text.completed: Return to Grelin Whitebeard in Dun Morogh.

english.title: Ice and Fire
english.objectives: Kill Grik'nir the Cold, 6 Frostmane Blades, 3 Frostmane Novices, and the Wayward Fire Elemental.
english.description: Soren did well to send you out on recon.  That's some good information you have right there.$b$bTrouble is, this just adds more work for us to do.  The trolls, confused as they are right now, still would like to kick the dwarves right out of Coldridge.  And I'm certainly not going to let some fiery demon turn our snowy valley into a mountain lake.$b$bThe troll leader, his servants, and the fire creature should all be in the cave to the southeast.  Take 'em all out.
english.progress: $N! Any luck?
english.completion: I'm glad you've returned safely, $n.  While it may not look like it now, you've proven to be a tremendous asset in the protection of Anvilmar.$b$bHere, take this as a symbol of my gratitude.
english.completed: Return to Grelin Whitebeard in Dun Morogh.

text.title: Missing In Action
text.objectives: Protect Corporal Keeshan on the journey back to Redridge.
text.description: At last, friends of the Alliance!$b$bHelp... please... $b$bThe last thing I remember these foul Orcs overpowered our regiment.  Most the men were killed. I took a strong blow to the head and everything went black. Now I am held captive in this cave.  Help me, I am hurt badly.$b$bI'll need help getting back to town... please... you're my last hope...
text.progress: Yes?
text.completion: You have served the Kingdom well, $C. Thank you for assisting Corporal Keeshan with his escape from those dreaded Blackrock Orcs. You shall be rewarded for your brave acts this day.
text.end: Escort Corporal Keeshan back to Redridge
text.completed: Return to Marshal Marris at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

text.title: Call of Water
text.objectives: Bring the Vial of Purest Water to Islen Waterseer at the Tidus Stair in the Barrens.
text.description: Islen will have one more task for you before rewarding you with your next totem. The vial of water I've given you is necessary for whatever that task is.$B$BGo now and find her. We shall meet again some day.
text.progress: Hello again, $N. You're looking well.$B$BWhat brings you back to me so soon?
text.completion: Ah, a vial of water created and blessed by Brine, and gathered by you, no less.$B$BThe liquid in this vial will be key in creating a sapta for you, but also used in one other task.$B$BThe sapta I create for you should be used to see the water spirits at the shrine in Silverpine Forest, south of the Undercity. The remaining drops, well, the remaining drops I will tell you about if you feel you are ready.$B$BAre you prepared for one more journey, $N?

text.title: Worgen in the Woods
text.objectives: Kill 12 Nightbane Dark Runner worgen for Calor in Darkshire.
text.description: You might have noticed some larger worgen wandering around with the Shadow Weavers in the woods? From what we can tell, these Dark Runners make up the bulk of the worgen numbers.$b$bOn my rangings, I've also noticed that they have overrun the Rotting Orchard southwest of town. These worgen are a bit tougher than the last you faced.$b$bBe on your guard.
text.progress: Back so soon, $N? I hope you haven't come to tell me you've given up.
text.completion: You performed well against the Dark Runners, $N. But it seems as though their numbers are inexhaustible. Every time we make progress, more spring up to refill their ranks.$b$bWhat is the evil power that draws them here? Why have they come to disturb our unhappy realm...$b$bI will put my faith in Master Carevin. No doubt he will get to the bottom of the problem.
text.completed: Return to Calor at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: Worgen in the Woods
text.objectives: Kill 8 Nightbane Vile Fang and 8 Nightbane Tainted One worgen for Calor in Darkshire.
text.description: Your previous accomplishments have convinced me that you are ready to take on the toughest worgen infesting the woods.$b$bOf the worgen that have made their new home here, the Vile Fangs and the Tainted Ones have proven the most dangerous. They've settled down near some of the caves and in the mine to the south.$b$bFrom far away you can even see the light from their bonfires...
text.progress: Intimidating beasts aren't they? But have no fear, $N, those who stand for the Light will never fall!
text.completion: $N, to be honest with you, I did not believe that you would get this far, but you are clearly a $C to be reckoned with. In fact, if you wish to formally join Master Carevin's struggle, I will gladly write for you a letter of recommendation.
text.completed: Return to Calor at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: Worgen in the Woods
text.objectives: Bring Calor's note to Jonathan Carevin.
text.description: Here you go, $n. Bring this message to Master Carevin.$b$b<He quickly removes a piece of faded parchment and offers it to you.>$b$bA few more like you, and we will outnumber the Night Watch! Perhaps then we could complete the work that we few carry on today.
text.progress: Yes, what is it? Make it quick, I've pressing matters to attend to.
text.completion: Excuse me for my cold reception, $N, but as I'm sure you can tell, I am an extremely busy man. I see that you have impressed Calor--and I assure you, that is no small feat--and that he has given his recommendation.$b$bThere are unsavory types afoot, $N, and we can use the help of all who have proven themselves. We battle against demons, the undead, and those who would provide them aid. Be vigilant, be wary, and trust none who would not give aid to our cause.$b$bGlory under the Light.

text.title: In Defense of the King's Lands
text.objectives: Mountaineer Cobbleflint at Thelsamar wants you to kill 6 Stonesplinter Troggs and 6 Stonesplinter Scouts.
text.description: We need to protect the Loch, $n! With so many of the King's soldiers fighting valiantly on remote battlefields, we've become overwhelmed on the home front. Troggs are tunneling up from every crevice! The Trogg infestation poses the largest threat to Ironforge.$b$bWe need you, brave adventurer, to venture forth and lay waste to the Trogg threat. Slay 6 Stonesplinter Troggs and 6 Stonesplinter Scouts and report back. You will find most of the vermin through the passes into the mountains to the south.
text.progress: Loch Modan is under siege, $N!  We need every able-bodied member of the Alliance to aid our cause.  Have you killed 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts yet?
text.completion: Well done, $N!  You demonstrated uncanny courage on the battlefield.  Our war against the Troggs will be won with efforts such as yours.  You have served King Magni well.$b$bIf you fancy yourself well-suited for this kind of adventuring, I suggest you speak with Mountaineer Gravelgaw.  The Captain has him assigned to a rough patrol that I am sure he can use some help with.  Check with Gravelgaw just inside the tower.

text.title: The Weathered Grave
text.objectives: Speak with Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.
text.description: The weathered grave marker reads simply:$b$bMORGAN LADIMORE$b$b<Upon further examination, you notice that dirt over the grave has been recently disturbed, and that a good amount of the dirt seems to have been displaced...>
text.completion: Morgan Ladimore?$b$bAhh, yes, of course. His was a long and sorrowful tale. I knew him, well, before he left for the war, but that was the last time I saw him. A noble and good man, he was, but he suffered a bad end.$b$bHere, I should have something here that can tell the tale better than my own recollections...

text.title: Wolves at Our Heels
text.objectives: Kill 12 Starving Dire Wolves and 8 Rabid Dire Wolves, then return to Lars at Sven's Camp on the western border of Duskwood.
text.description: Sven and I have dangerous days ahead of us, what with the Necromancer to the east and all.  And out here alone as we are, we have to hunt for our own food.  It seems every time I'm heading back to camp with some meat on me, starving or rabid dire wolves come out of the forest wanting a bite.  It goes without saying, living out here is dangerous work!$B$BBut if you can rid us of some of those wolves, we'd have an easier time of it.  They mostly prowl north and east of here, near the river.
text.progress: You still hunting wolves...?
text.completion: Oh good. You thinned out that pack quite a bit, and without those wolves nipping out our heels, we can bind our minds to dealing with Morbent Fel.$B$BHere, take some of these Flash Bundles. They make them in town, and a lot have been donated to Sven to help with his cause.
text.completed: Return to Lars at The Hushed Bank in Duskwood.

text.title: Morgan Ladimore
text.objectives: Speak with Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
text.description: <He searches through the shelves and comes up with a leatherbound book.>$b$bIf you would like to know more, you might ask Althea, she's been the one to handle the... trouble... with him of late.
text.completion: Morgan Ladimore? Never heard of...$b$bOh, you mean Mor'Ladim! I guess you haven't heard the story?$b$bWell, I'll give you the short version. A wandering undead calling itself Mor'Ladim has been wandering Duskwood. From what we've gathered, it appears to be the undead body of Morgan Ladimore, of whom you apparently know. He's been causing us all sorts of problems, attacking Watchmen on patrol and killing people.$b$b<She sizes you up.>$b$bYou seem to be capable enough, maybe you could lay him to rest.

text.title: Mor'Ladim
text.objectives: Kill Mor'Ladim, then return his skull to Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
text.description: From what my scouts tell me, Mor'Ladim wanders throughout Duskwood, following a strange and meandering path through the cemetery. We buried him out past the house on the hill, you know where that is?$b$bThere isn't anything I can do to help you, but I wish you good luck.
text.progress: I don't blame you if you're having trouble with him, $N. Some of our strongest Watchers have been lost to Mor'Ladim.
text.completion: You killed him? That's no small accomplishment, $N! On behalf of the people of Darkshire and the Night Watch, I thank you.$B$BAh... there is one small matter, however...
text.completed: Return to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: The Daughter Who Lived
text.objectives: Speak with Watcher Sarah Ladimore in Darkshire.
text.description: I should have told you this earlier...$b$bHow do I put this...$b$bMorgan may have believed that his family was all dead, but, in fact, his daughter Sarah Ladimore is now a Watcher. She's always been troubled by the... circumstances... surrounding her father's death. Perhaps you could go to bring the news to her.
text.completion: Yes? My father...$B$B<Her eyes become downcast.>$B$BI wish... there was something I could have done for him... If only I had talked to him before he...

text.title: Sven's Camp
text.objectives: Bring the Book from Sven's Farm to Sven.
text.description: Digging through the mound, you find a small, dirt-stained book.$B$BThe book has no title, but...it has information Sven would like to know.
text.progress: You found what?? Please, let me see it...
text.completion: <Sven reads the book's pages, then slams it shut.>$B$BThat shadowy figure I saw was a witness to my family's death! There are questions I'd like to ask that man...if only I knew who he was!

text.title: A Daughter's Love
text.objectives: Take Sarah Ladimore's ring to Morgan Ladimore's grave.
text.description: Here, take this and lay it on his grave. Maybe... somehow, he'll know that I'm okay, and that none of us hold him responsible for what happened.$b$b<There are tears in her eyes now, as she slides a ring from her right hand, and presses it into your hands.>$b$bAnd... thank you, $n.
text.progress: Leave me be...
text.completion: <A ghostly voice sounds on the wind...>$B$BThis is...? Sarah? Could it be she's still alive? The weight is removed from my shoulders...$B$B$N. Take my sword, Archeus. As my soul is put to rest, I have no more need for it. It was forged to do good, and though I have proved myself unworthy to hold it, perhaps you will carry on the Light through it.$B$BLys, my love...

text.title: Errand for Apothecary Zinge
text.objectives: Take the purchase order to Alessandro Luca in the Undercity.
text.description: The Royal Apothecary Society needs your assistance.  Listen closely, and both of us may profit from my plan.$B$BApothecary Keever in the next room may be... touched... but his research does potentially bear fruit if it were pursued by a clever researcher.  Fortunately, I am such a researcher.  I want you to take this purchase order to Alessandro Luca, the proprietor of Blue Moon Odds and Ends; he'll give you a testing kit.  When you have it, bring it back to me and I'll outline your task in detail.
text.progress: Yes, and what may I assist you with?  Are you here on business for the Royal Apothecary Society, or have you arrived here merely to brighten my day?
text.completion: Ah, Zinge needs a kit, does she?  It saddens me that Zinge does not choose to grace myself with her sweet presence.$B$BVery well, let me procure a kit for you.

text.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery
text.objectives: Deliver the stack of letters to Talin Keeneye in Coldridge Valley.
text.description: Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, $g lad : lass;? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.$b$bThey're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.$b$bWhat do you say?
text.progress: Yes? Do you have something for me?
text.completion: Thank you, I've been waiting for these letters for quite some time...$b$bUnfortunately, these letters aren't all for me. This one is addressed to Grelin Whitebeard. He's not too far away if you'd like to deliver it to him.

text.objectives: Deliver the letter to Grelin Whitebeard in Coldridge Valley.
text.description: If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.
text.progress: Is there something I can help you with?
text.completion: Ahh, excellent. It's been a while since I received word from Ironforge.

text.title: The Ashenvale Hunt
text.objectives: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
text.description: Attention, young adventurers!  The wilds of Ashenvale await you!$B$BThe Horde has established a strong presence in the lands north of the Barrens.  Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the Horde!  Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there.  Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the Barrens, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of Ashenvale!
text.completion: Welcome to the new frontier, $N. Ashenvale is a land of opportunity, one where a young $C like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle. Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the Horde has another outpost there as well.$B$BYour presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt. Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.

text.title: 战车的燃料
text.objectives: 冬拥堡垒的攻城大师斯托汉德要你前往烈焰之坑，收集10份永恒灰烬。
text.description: $n！你总算来了。虽然上一场战斗已经告一段落了，但我们还是应该为下一场战斗做好准备！到冬拥湖东南方的烈焰之坑去，弄一些永恒灰烬回来。$B$B这种灰烬里含有煤炭，可以充当攻城车辆的燃料。$B$B哦，对了，如果你在烈焰之坑遇到部落的渣滓，尽管杀了他们，把他们手里的灰烬抢过来。绝对不能让他们在下一次战斗中有丝毫的优势。
text.progress: Well? Did you manage to find the embers or did the Horde beat you to it and leave you crying?
text.completion: Excellent! This will help fuel the flames of war for days to come.
text.completed: Return to Siege Master Stouthandle in Wintergrasp.

english.title: Fueling the Demolishers
english.objectives: Siege Master Stouthandle at Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to retrieve 10 Eternal Embers from Horde players at the Cauldron of Flames.
english.description: $n! About time you showed up. While the battle may be over, we still need to prepare for the next battle. Travel to the Cauldron of Flames in south eastern Wintergrasp and retrieve several eternal embers.$B$BThe embers are mixed in with coal to fuel the Demolisher and Siege Engines. $B$BOh, and if you happen to see some of the Horde in the Cauldron, don't hesitate to slay them and take their embers. We can't let them have the advantage in the next battle.
english.progress: Well? Did you manage to find the embers or did the Horde beat you to it and leave you crying?
english.completion: Excellent! This will help fuel the flames of war for days to come.
english.completed: Return to Siege Master Stouthandle in Wintergrasp.

text.title: In Defense of the King's Lands
text.objectives: Mountaineer Gravelgaw in the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers and report back to him.
text.description: Mountaineer Cobbleflint had nothing but good things to say about you, $r.  For that reason I am going to entrust upon you a mission of utmost importance.  We need to keep pressure on the invading Trogg forces until our Dwarven brethren return from the Alliance front.$b$bSet forth into the southern hills and kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers.  Your attacks will buy us some time.  Report back when your mission is complete.
text.progress: We need more time, $r. Your orders are to kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers. Keep the enemy under pressure until we are granted reinforcements. This is no time for idle behavior.
text.completion: You accomplished your mission well, $r.  The King himself would be proud.$b$bThe reinforcements promised to us never showed, however.  Apparently the Alliance front is a sea of crimson from the blood of our fallen brethren.  The news of the losses leaves a bitter taste in one's mouth.  But we must not let their deaths go for naught.  We must rally in these grim times and bring glory back to the Alliance.$b$bSpeak with Mountaineer Wallbang for reassignment.  You're needed now more than ever.
text.completed: Return to Mountaineer Gravelgaw at Valley of Kings in Loch Modan.

text.title: Errand for Apothecary Zinge
text.objectives: Bring the Field Sampling Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
text.description: The kit is ready, $n.  No doubt that Apothecary Zinge will want this as soon as possible.  Take it to her without delay, and let her know that I will add the cost of the kit to the Society's tab.  Also, please extend to her my warmest salutations.$B$BWell, don't just stand there.  Such is the life of a simple courier, yes?

text.title: 西泉要塞
text.objectives: 到西泉要塞去和瑞尼尔副队长谈一谈。
text.description: 我们位于西部边界的要塞报告说，那里的豺狼人和迪菲亚盗贼最近越来越猖獗了。他们要求我从暴风城派更多士兵过去……但是我们已经没有多余的人可派了！$B$B如果你愿意帮忙的话，就去和西泉要塞的瑞尼尔副队长谈一谈，看看他需要你做些什么。$B$B沿着这条路往西走，过了桥之后向右转就是要塞。
text.completion: Marshall Dughan sent you, eh? Well you're not from the army, but if Dughan sent you then that's good enough for me!$b$bOur situation is, to say the least, a stressed one. I hope you can give us a hand.

english.title: Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!
english.objectives: Go to the Westbrook Garrison and speak with Deputy Rainer.
english.description: The Garrison on our western border sends word of increasing gnoll and thief activity.  They're requesting we send more Stormwind soldiers... but we just don't have any to spare!$B$BIf you can help, we could use it.  Go and speak with Deputy Rainer at the Westbrook Garrison and see what he needs done.$B$BThe Garrison is down the road to the west.  After you cross the bridge over the small brook it will be to the right.

text.title: Into the Field
text.objectives: Speak to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan about getting a power source for the testing kit.
text.description: You will be headed to the Tanaris desert, testing the tissue consistency of the basilisks, scorpids, and hyena native there.  Obtain tissue samples and use them with the testing kit in tow; expect a chunk of the samples to fail.  I need eight acceptable samples of each creature type.$B$BIn addition, the goblins of Gadgetzan have a power source that must be used with this kind of modified kit.  Speak to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle and acquire one for the kit.$B$BReturn to me only when you are successful.
text.completion: Ah, our model 4711-FTZ power sources! We normally use them to power the water wells, but THANKS TO THE VILE NOMADS, we have an over abundance of power sources right now.$b$bSure, I can get you a power source for whatever nefarious science experiment you think you're trying to hide from me. It ain't gonna be free though, $R. Nothing's free in Gadgetzan.

text.title: Encroaching Gnolls
text.objectives: Report to Deputy Feldon at the bridge south of Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.
text.description: Hail, $c.  I am charged to patrol this stretch of road.  Although the road is safe for now, I've seen gnoll encampments to the north and east of here.$B$BLakeshire must know of the gathering gnoll force!  Report to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire and tell him of the gnolls.  Do this, and I'm sure Feldon will offer you a scout's wage.$B$BFeldon's usually inspecting the area south of the bridge to Lakeshire.
text.completion: There are Redridge gnolls that close to Elwynn?? They may be poised to advance into our homeland. Soon the people of Lakeshire may not be the only humans under siege!$b$bHere is your pay, though you bring us dire news. And it comes at a bad time, for we are ill equipped to deal with it.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Eight-Legged Menaces
text.objectives: Kill 15 Pygmy Venom Web Spiders, and then report back to Watcher Dodds in Duskwood.
text.description: Hail, $c. Perhaps you've seen those spiders that have taken over the western border? The eight-legged menaces are too much for us to handle, and the Commander hasn't enough manpower to spare so far from Darkshire.$b$bI hate to ask this of you, but you seem like you might be able to handle them. I can't promise you anything of great value, but I can reward you if you can help root out the filthy bugs.$b$bOh, and a word of advice, you'll want to avoid their venom if you can.
text.progress: You'd best be careful when dealing with the spiders, I've lost a few of my men to them, and trust me, it isn't a pleasant sight to see a man hanging upside down in their webs after the venom has started to soften them up.$B$BI wouldn't want to see one of the bugs having you for lunch.
text.completion: Ah! You're back. And not too much worse for wear, it'd seem. Of course, $N, the Night Watch is grateful for your work, and I did promise you a reward, so here.
text.completed: Return to Watcher Dodds in Duskwood.

text.title: Assessing the Threat
text.objectives: Kill 10 Redridge Mongrels and 6 Redridge Poachers, then report back to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire.
text.description: We don't have men to spare, but something must be done about those gnolls you reported to me.$B$BScout southern Redridge for gnolls.  Harry them, kill those you can and report back to me with a count of their numbers and an assessment of the threat they present.  You may find those gnolls camped all along the southern road of Redridge.$B$BDo this for the Stormwind Army, $n, and you will be rewarded.
text.progress: Excuse me, $N, but we have a lot to keep our hands tied here. If you have nothing to report, then I must put my mind to other matters.
text.completion: <Deputy Feldon listens to your report...>$b$bThere's a sizable force of gnolls encamped there, and from what you tell me they are tough ones. It must not have been easy for you to gather this intelligence.$b$bHere you are, $N. We are grateful for your aid.$b$bAnd if you haven't already done so, speak with Marshal Marris and Magistrate Solomon within Lakeshire. Our situation grows ever more desperate - those two will have need of you I'm sure.
text.completed: Return to Deputy Feldon at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

The blood of a hunter streaks through your veins, and you should be commended!$B$BPlease, accept this bauble as a sign of congratulations on your mighty deeds done in Ashenvale for the Horde today. text.title: Looking Further
text.objectives: Climb the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep in Redridge Mountains.$B$BFind a suitable container to place the Glyph of Azora.
text.description: I have been watching the Tower of Ilgalar, and can detect that Morganth is in conflict with the Orcs in Stonewatch Keep.  I do not know the reason behind their contention, but you may aid me in unraveling this mystery.$B$BTake another Glyph of Azora, then go to the top of the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep.$B$BFind a suitable object on which to place the Glyph.  A chest or a jar -- some place where the glyph will not be noticed -- will suit my purpose.
text.progress: This jar once held a foul-smelling liquor, but now lies empty and forgotten on a pair of barrels.
text.completion: It is a suitable vessel for the Glyph of Azora, allowing Theocritus to delve into the minds within Stonewatch Keep.

text.title: Morganth
text.objectives: Defeat Morganth.$B$BBring his Pendant of Shadow to Theocritus at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.
text.description: After much observation, I have discovered Morganth's plans.$B$BHe searches for the Scythe of Elune...and he may have found it!  If he has, then the Redridge Mountains, and the kingdom of Stormwind, will soon feel his dark might.$B$BI am not prepared to pit myself against Morganth, but I fear he must be dealt with now.  So you must enter the Tower of Ilgalar and face Morganth.$B$BDefeat him, and bring me his Pendant of Shadow.  Do this, and the kingdom will owe you much.
text.progress: Hurry, $N, before my fears of Morganth spreading his power are made real!
text.completion: You have done well, $N. In defeating the warlock Morganth, Stormwind is saved from a grave peril.$B$BI offer you this reward most humbly. And I would bid you peace, if these were peaceful times.$B$BBut instead, I will bid you luck with your trials, and victory in the conflicts ahead.
text.completed: Return to Theocritus at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: A Dark Threat Looms
text.objectives: Investigate the area near the eastern ramp of the Dam and bring Chief Engineer Hinderweir a clue that might reveal what the Dark Iron Dwarves are up to.
text.description: Thank the stars someone is concerned about the well-being of the Dam.  First the destruction of the Thandol Span and then the pillaging of Dun Modr!  I have no doubt that the Dam will be the target of the next Dark Iron threat.  Most of the security detail here was reassigned to the Alliance Front, including my top inspector.$b$bThat's why I need you, $n.  I spotted some Dark Iron Sappers milling about the eastern ramp of the Dam.   Investigate the area and bring back a clue.
text.completion: The suspicious looking barrel contains a strange smelling powder.

text.objectives: Bring the Translated Letter to Lord Ello Ebonlocke
text.description: Oh my!  If what is written on this note is true, then Abercrombie's done something...unspeakable.$B$BYou better bring the translated note back to Ello.$B$BAnd do so quickly, for I fear a doom already lumbers toward our town...
text.progress: Ah, is the note translated? Please, let me see it...

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Bride of the Embalmer
text.objectives: Find Eliza's grave.  Retrieve the Embalmer's Heart from her, then return to Ello Ebonlocke.
text.description: The Embalmer is a name told in one of our children's stories.  He was a kindly alchemist, driven mad by the death of his wife, Eliza.  To restore her, he used dark magic to place his own heart within the bosom of his dead spouse.$B$BThis revived Eliza...but it cursed her with a hunger for human flesh, forcing the Embalmer to keep her buried.$B$BHis heart is his power.  Find his wife's grave, retrieve his heart, and bring it to me while it still beats.  Do this and his power will be broken.
text.progress: Have you yet found Eliza's grave? Do you have the Embalmer's heart?
text.completion: You've done it! The magic within his heart will be proof against the Embalmer's evil, and a powerful aegis over the town of Darkshire.$B$BYou have done a great thing for our people, $N. Your name will remain in our annals forever.
text.completed: Return to Lord Ello Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]Mercenaries
text.objectives: Kelt Thomasin of the Mo'grosh camp has hired you to kill 4 Mo'grosh Ogres, 4 Mo'grosh Brutes and 4 Mo'grosh Enforcers.
text.description: Hunting wildlife gets old after a while. I'm into bigger game... much bigger actually. Ogres to be precise.$B$BThe dwarves here are quite concerned with the Mo'grosh Stronghold to the northeast, but they don't have the manpower to do much about it. text.progress: Have you had any luck?
text.completion: Ah, this is excellent news! Your efforts are greatly appreciated by myself and the people of Thelsamar. Better yet, if we can solve the ogre problem, we'll be able to shift our focus to those Light-burning troggs.

text.title: WANTED: Chok'sul
text.objectives: Kill Chok'sul and bring his head to Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar.
text.description: By order of the Magistrate of Thelsamar:$b$bChok'sul, the ogre presumed to be the leader and coordinator of attacks against the town of Thelsamar, Stonewrought Dam, and the excavation site, is wanted dead through any means necessary.$b$bMonetary compensation will be provided when proof is brought to the Magistrate of Chok'sul's death.$b$bChok'sul was last seen at the ogre encampment in the northeastern part of Loch Modan.
text.progress: Yes? Is there something I can do for you?
text.completion: Yech! What is that thing? And why would you bring it...$b$bBloody--! Is it? Well, Light burn me, is that the head of that bloody ogre? This certainly is a catch then! Here, your reward and the thanks of myself and the people of Thelsamar.
text.completed: Return to Magistrate Bluntnose in Loch Modan.

english.title: WANTED: Chok'sul
english.objectives: Kill Chok'sul and bring his head to Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar.
english.description: By order of the Magistrate of Thelsamar:$b$bChok'sul, the ogre presumed to be the leader and coordinator of attacks against the town of Thelsamar, Stonewrought Dam, and the excavation site, is wanted dead through any means necessary.$b$bMonetary compensation will be provided when proof is brought to the Magistrate of Chok'sul's death.$b$bChok'sul was last seen at the ogre encampment in the northeastern part of Loch Modan.
english.progress: Yes? Is there something I can do for you?
english.completion: Yech! What is that thing? And why would you bring it...$b$bBloody--! Is it? Well, Light burn me, is that the head of that bloody ogre? This certainly is a catch then! Here, your reward and the thanks of myself and the people of Thelsamar.
english.completed: Return to Magistrate Bluntnose in Loch Modan.

text.title: A Hunter's Boast
text.objectives: Kill 8 Mountain Buzzards and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge.
text.description: Think you can match wits with Daryl the Bold, huh? I should think not! Of course, you're more than welcome to try. Here's a challenge that should prove to be above your abilities, so don't feel too bad if you can't face up to it.$b$bA flock of buzzards has nested here in Loch Modan. Why don't you try to take down some of the beasts? Tell you what, if you meet my challenge, I'll give you my bow or gun.$b$b<He looks you over dismissively.>$b$bIt seems you haven't much to lose, anyways.
text.progress: No luck? Don't feel too bad, $N...$B$BNot everyone can be me.
text.completion: What? Success?$B$BTake it from me, $Nama, you don't let it get to your head. I mean, any unshaven boy with a bow could have killed such... small specimens. And I hope you don't enjoy killing the buzzards so much, yes? We wouldn't want them to become extinct.$B$BWell, err... Never let it be said that Daryl the Bold would not hold to his word.

text.title: A Hunter's Challenge
text.objectives: Kill 10 Elder Mountain Boars and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge.
text.description: $nath, is it? I can tell you're bursting with pride over your hunting prowesst, hm? It's no large feat.$b$bYou should try your hand at boar hunting. Trust me, this is no Coldridge Valley boar hunt, so you'd best have a care with them.$b$bDon't feel bad if you fail. I'd give you the shirt off my back if you succeeded!$b$bHave I ever related to you the story of how I received my famous scar? No? It was two years ago...
text.progress: It's only natural to feel sorry for yourself when shown up by someone so new to this world. You shouldn't feel bad, $N.$B$BHm? Did I get your name wrong?
text.completion: You seem a bit worse for wear. No doubt the boars gave you some trouble, hm? No worries, I will be discreet about your struggle, I can imagine how hard it must be for you without the accusations of wagging tongues.$B$BOh! You managed to kill the boars? I... well, that is... that is to say, I'm not surprised! Any child could have--bet?$B$BWhat bet?
