text.title: 平原陆行鸟的威胁
text.objectives: 收集7个陆行鸟的喙。
text.description: 你对平原陆行鸟了解吗？没用的动物。不能飞，满地乱跑，脑子跟我的指头一样大，还经常撞上我们的货车。我已经被它们的硬脑壳撞坏好几根车轴了……有时候我都觉得是野猪人故意把它们派来挡我们的道，然后发动袭击。$B$B让我以你为荣吧，$c。清理道路，杀掉那些讨厌的平原陆行鸟，把它们的鸟喙给我带回来。
text.progress: Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
text.completion: Very good, $N. That's one less thing to worry about on the road.
text.completed: Deliver the Beaks to Halga Bloodeye at Far Watch Post in North Barrens.

english.title: Plainstrider Menace
english.objectives: Collect 7 Plainstrider Beaks.
english.description: Are you familiar with plainstriders? Useless animals. Can't fly. Gamey. Brain the size of my knuckle. Too dim to get out of the way of a moving cart. I've broken more axles thanks to their thick skulls... Sometimes I think the quilboar intentionally frighten flocks of them into the path of our caravans just prior to an ambush.$B$BMake me proud, $c. Cut a swath through those filthy birds to keep the roads free, and bring me their beaks as proof.
english.progress: Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
english.completion: Very good, $N. That's one less thing to worry about on the road.
english.completed: Deliver the Beaks to Halga Bloodeye at Far Watch Post in North Barrens.

text.title: 斑马的威胁
text.objectives: 杀死快步斑马并收集4只斑马蹄。
text.description: 如果你想为挚爱的部落效力，你需要去证明你的力量，孩子。猎杀斑马是个好方法。它们也许不是贫瘠之地最强大的野兽，但也能把你踢个口鼻窜血。$B$B去猎杀北边和南边的斑马，并且收集它们的蹄子。完成这个任务之后，也许你就可以去见识见识真正的猛兽了。
text.progress: How many zhevra have you slain?
text.completion: Not bad, $N. Those zhevra hold a lot of strength in their legs. A sharp kick from them can knock even a tauren on its haunches!$B$BIt looks like you have some strength in you too. Are you ready for a real challenge?
text.completed: Take the Hooves to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads in North Barrens.

english.title: The Zhevra
english.objectives: Slay Zhevra Runners to collect 4 Zhevra Hooves.
english.description: If you wish to serve my beloved horde, you'll have to prove your strength to me, pup. You can cut your teeth by hunting zhevra. They may not be the strongest of beasts in the Barrens, but stay clear of their kick or you'll regret it.$B$BHunt the zhevra to the north and south, and collect their hooves.  Bring them to me and perhaps we'll next send you against something tougher.
english.progress: How many zhevra have you slain?
english.completion: Not bad, $N. Those zhevra hold a lot of strength in their legs. A sharp kick from them can knock even a tauren on its haunches!$B$BIt looks like you have some strength in you too. Are you ready for a real challenge?
english.completed: Take the Hooves to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads in North Barrens.

text.title: Revenge of Gann
text.objectives: Gann Stonespire wants you to bring him 6 vials of Nitroglycerin, 6 bundles of Wood Pulp, and 6 samples of Sodium Nitrate.
text.description: It is clear the prospector depended on explosives and those noisy vehicles to rip the ground apart. We can expect a new foreman to take over soon.$b$bI want to give the dwarves a taste of their own medicine. According to these plans if we combine nitroglycerin with wood pulp and sodium nitrate we can create an explosive charge. The rifleman, soldiers and officers in the Keep are known to have the supplies.$b$bCollect these items and bring them to me. I will fashion a charge that the dwarves won't forget!
text.progress: I see you are back, $N.$B$BWhile Khazgorm's death might delay the digging in my ancestral lands some, it will by no means bring a total end to the destruction.$B$BThe Keep at Bael Modan is an increasing military threat. Built to defend the dig site, it is now poised for offensive force as well.$B$BIf you have the ingredients I requested, I can fashion a charge that will make the hasty dwarves reconsider their actions here in the Barrens.
text.completion: I see you are quite industrious, $C.$B$BNo doubt we shall soon have a fitting surprise for those dwarves.
text.completed: Return to Gann Stonespire at the Southern Gold Road in the Barrens.

text.title: Guile of the Raptor
text.objectives: Speak with Tor'gan at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.
text.description: This... this power.... Is this the power of the shamans that Tor'gan tried to show me? I must say, it is interesting. Tell Tor'gan that he has convinced me... for the time being. I will listen to what he has to say.
text.completion: When the enchantment wears off, I will speak with Gor'mul. My thanks to you for your help in returning Gor'mul to the land of the living. I have no doubt he thanks you greatly as well.

text.title: 菌类孢子
text.objectives: 在遗忘之池收集5个菌类孢子。
text.description: 贫瘠之地的绿洲里隐藏着一个谜。生命的能量从绿洲之水中涌出，给那些汲取水分的动植物带来了勃勃生机。$B$B与此同时，这种能量也在慢慢地改变这些动植物。$B$B在西北的遗忘之池附近生长着一种蘑菇，我们这些洛丹伦的药剂师都认为这种蘑菇的孢子中包含有一些特殊的物质，它对我们非常有用。$B$B帮我带一些孢子回来，我们会非常感谢你的。
text.progress: Do you have the spores, $N? There is a concoction I must send to my associate in Thunder Bluff, which requires the spores...
text.completion: Ah, yes. These are good specimens. Potent.$B$BI am Forsaken, and we honor our contracts. Here is your reward, $N.
text.completed: Take the Spores to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Fungal Spores
english.objectives: Collect 5 Fungal Spores from mushrooms at the Forgotten Pools.
english.description: The oases of the Barrens hide a mystery. Life energy flows from their waters, invigorating the plants and beasts that drink it.$B$BInvigorating, and altering.$B$BThere is a mushroom that grows near the Forgotten Pools to the northwest. Its spores hold properties that we, the apothecaries of Lordaeron, find useful.$B$BBring me these spores and you will earn our gratitude.
english.progress: Do you have the spores, $N? There is a concoction I must send to my associate in Thunder Bluff, which requires the spores...
english.completion: Ah, yes. These are good specimens. Potent.$B$BI am Forsaken, and we honor our contracts. Here is your reward, $N.
english.completed: Take the Spores to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

text.title: Revenge of Gann
text.objectives: Destroy the flying machine at Bael Modan and return to Gann Stonespire.
text.description: Following Khazgorm's plans it should be no problem to fashion an explosive charge$b$bAh, there we go.$b$bNow, $n, I am going to entrust you with a special task. Take this explosive stick and use it to blow up the flying machine at Bael Modan.$b$bNot only is the flying machine a key part of the site's infrastructure it also serves as a weapon of war. More importantly it is an icon of power and an insult to the memory of my tribe.$b$bMake me proud by completing this heroic task and you shall be rewarded.
text.progress: Once the dwarven flying machine has been destroyed I will feel the sweet satisfaction of revenge.
text.completion: You have done well, $N! May you be revered in Thunder Bluff as a defender of sacred tauren lands and a champion of the lost tribe.
text.completed: Return to Gann Stonespire at the Southern Gold Road in the Barrens.

text.title: 科卡尔首领
text.objectives: 击败巴拉克，获得他的战利品。
text.description: 半人马的问题困扰着牛头人已经很多年了，最近，贫瘠之地的科卡尔半人马开始形成真正的威胁。通常他们散居在这片土地上，不过他们当中已经产生了新的首领，他把一盘散沙的半人马集合在一起。$B$B为了保护我们的家园，这些半人马领袖就必须要除掉。$B$B帮我带回巴拉克·科多班恩的战利品，他在西方的遗忘之池附近驻营。$B$B除掉他，然后再回到我这里。
text.progress: Hello, $N. Do you have Barak's Head for me?
text.completion: Well done, $N. The centaur are low, brutish creatures, but a few have the wit and vision to lead. And those are the most dangerous.$B$BBarak was such a centaur. It is good that he is dead.
text.completed: Bring Kodobane's Head to Telar Highstrider at the Forgotten Pools in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Kolkar Leaders
english.objectives: Slay Barak Kodobane and collect his head.
english.description: The centaurs have plagued the tauren for years. And recently, the Kolkar centaurs of the Barrens have grown into a real threat. Normally they were disorganized in these lands, but new leaders have risen among them. Rallying them.$B$BTo preserve our holdings here, these centaur leaders must be destroyed.$B$BBring me the head of Barak Kodobane. He camps west of these Forgotten Pools.$B$BDefeat him, then return to me.
english.progress: Hello, $N. Do you have Barak's Head for me?
english.completion: Well done, $N. The centaur are low, brutish creatures, but a few have the wit and vision to lead. And those are the most dangerous.$B$BBarak was such a centaur. It is good that he is dead.
english.completed: Bring Kodobane's Head to Telar Highstrider at the Forgotten Pools in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 狂热的维罗戈
text.objectives: 杀死维内斯，将维罗戈引出来。然后杀死他，获取他的徽记。
text.description: 要找到维罗戈也许很困难，但是根据你收集到的情报，他的配偶维内斯总是待在他的指挥帐篷里，就在这里的西边。如果我们杀掉她，维罗戈一定会冲出来的。$B$B雷戈萨派我们来执行侦察任务，但他也说了，我们要抓住一切可能的机会，破坏半人马的指挥系统。把维罗戈引出来干掉！
text.progress: Did you find Verog, $N?
text.completion: Very good. You must have really stirred up those centaur -- our guards spotted activity down near the Stagnant Oasis, which was probably you.$B$BYou should be proud of your deed, $N. There is much bravery in you.
text.completed: Bring Verog's Head to Shoe at the Stagnant Oasis.

english.title: Verog the Dervish
english.objectives: Kill Wyneth in order to lure out Verog the Dervish, then slay him and grab his head.
english.description: Verog may be hard to find, but judging by the info you gathered, his mate Wyneth is always in his command tent just west of here. If we kill her, Verog will come running.$B$BRegthar sent us here to scout, but he also said we should seize any opportunity to upset the centaur chain of command if we can. Lure out Verog and kill him!
english.progress: Did you find Verog, $N?
english.completion: Very good. You must have really stirred up those centaur -- our guards spotted activity down near the Stagnant Oasis, which was probably you.$B$BYou should be proud of your deed, $N. There is much bravery in you.
english.completed: Bring Verog's Head to Shoe at the Stagnant Oasis.

text.title: 赫兹鲁尔·血印
text.objectives: 击败赫兹鲁尔，获得他的战利品。
text.description: 赫兹鲁尔·血印是贫瘠之地的科卡尔半人马的首领。他凶猛、残忍，诡计多端。消灭他就可以瓦解半人马部落，从而极大地削弱他们对我们的威胁。$B$B去杀了他。带回赫兹鲁尔的战利品。我会带着战利品示众，让他们知道我们的厉害。$B$B他和他的手下驻扎就在南方的甜水绿洲一带。
text.progress: Is Hezrul defeated, $N?
text.completion: I commend you, $N. These centaur are undisciplined and cannot focus their rage as the orcs can, but they are fierce nonetheless. In defeating them, your valor is proven.
text.completed: Bring Hezrul's Head to Regthar Deathgate at his outpost in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Hezrul Bloodmark
english.objectives: Slay Hezrul Bloodmark and collect his head.
english.description: Hezrul Bloodmark is the leader of the Kolkar centaurs in the Barrens. He is fierce, brutal and cunning. Defeating him would disrupt and fracture the Kolkars, greatly reducing their threat to us.$B$BSo kill him. Bring me Hezrul's Head, and I will mount it from this outpost, so that they may know fear.$B$BHezrul leads his people from the Lushwater Oasis, to the south.
english.progress: Is Hezrul defeated, $N?
english.completion: I commend you, $N. These centaur are undisciplined and cannot focus their rage as the orcs can, but they are fierce nonetheless. In defeating them, your valor is proven.
english.completed: Bring Hezrul's Head to Regthar Deathgate at his outpost in Northern Barrens.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] Apothecary Zamah
text.objectives: Bring the Rendered Spores to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff, before the time limit is up.
text.description: I have rendered the spores you gave me into an emulsion.  I must now send it to my associate, Apothecary Zamah.  If you were to carry this to her, she can offer you something from our stores of alchemical goods.$B$BShe is in the Pools of Vision, a cave beneath the shamans of Thunder Bluff.  The path to this cave is well hidden, but you may find it on the Spirit Rise bluff.$B$BDo hurry.  This emulsion will maintain its potency for only a short time, and must be resealed and processed before then.
text.progress: You have something from Apothecary Helbrim?
text.completion: Ah, the spores from the Barrens that Helbrim was gathering. He garnered your aid in delivering them? Good.$B$BAnd the emulsion is still potent, so you must have wasted no time in the delivery. Well done, $C.

english.completion: Ah, the spores from the Barrens that Helbrim was gathering. He garnered your aid in delivering them? Good.$B$BAnd the emulsion is still potent, so you must have wasted no time in the delivery. Well done, $C.

text.title: Journey to the Crossroads
text.objectives: Speak with Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
text.description: I have foreseen your arrival, young $c. Though perhaps you are not so young anymore.$B$BI think that it is time for you to move deeper into this land. I can sense that you are destined for great things.$B$BIt is the Crossroads that you must seek out, for our lives with the orcs have become intertwined and they need assistance. Continue down this road towards the east and follow it north to the Crossroads. Find Thork within its walls, he has the Earthmother's blessing.
text.completion: It is good to see that more of our $R allies have come to assist us from as far away as Thunder Bluff. Again, I welcome you.

text.title: 半人马护腕
text.objectives: 从科卡尔掠夺者和科卡尔风暴先知身上收集10个半人马护腕。
text.description: 半人马的领导依赖一群忠诚而又纪律严明的战士来压制其他人。如果我们削弱他们的数量，科卡尔半人马就无力兴风作浪了。为此，我会交给你一项赏金任务。$B$B到南边的甜水绿洲去，干掉科卡尔掠夺者和科卡尔风暴先知，收集他们的护腕。当你能带回足够多的护腕的时候，部落会奖赏你的。
text.progress: How goes your hunting, $N?
text.completion: Nicely done. I'm sure you've struck fear into the surviving centaurs, $N. If they have sense, they'll now calm themselves and stop their advances.$B$BBut I don't think they will, and that is unfortunate.$B$BUnfortunate...for them.
text.completed: Take the Bracers to Regthar Deathgate at his post in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Centaur Bracers
english.objectives: Collect 10 Centaur Bracers from Kolkar Marauders and Stormseers.
english.description: The centaur leadership relies on a core of trusted, disciplined warriors to keep the others in line. If we reduce their numbers, the Kolkar will have no might with which to support their rage. And so, I have a bounty task for you.$B$BAround the Lushwater Oasis to the south, slay Kolkar Marauders and Stormseers to collect their bracers. Return when you have a heap of these trophies and the Horde will reward you well.
english.progress: How goes your hunting, $N?
english.completion: Nicely done. I'm sure you've struck fear into the surviving centaurs, $N. If they have sense, they'll now calm themselves and stop their advances.$B$BBut I don't think they will, and that is unfortunate.$B$BUnfortunate...for them.
english.completed: Take the Bracers to Regthar Deathgate at his post in Northern Barrens.

text.title: <UNUSED>
text.objectives: Continue down the road from Camp Taurajo.$B$BTurn left at the T intersection and continue North.$B$BFollow the path to the Ancestral Sage outside the Crossroads.
text.description: Though you have reached the Barrens, your journey is not complete. You must continue on to the Crossroads, where you are needed most.$B$BFollow the road as you were, and turn left where the path gives you the choice. Follow it North until you see the walls of the Crossroads.$B$BJust before you enter, you should see the Ancestral Sage, he will have words of wisdom for you.

text.title: The Tear of the Moons
text.objectives: Feegly the Exiled wants you to retrieve for him the Tear of the Moons.
text.description: The power was mine! In my very hands! And I want it back! Back I say!$b$bThose dirty excavators uncovered it... so beautiful it was. Deemed the Tear of the Moons, it was the first great discovery we made at Bael Modan.$b$bIt should have been mine! Mine I say!$b$bGeneral Twinbraid grew jealous of the power it gave me. He locked it away in the Keep. Called it cursed, he did! The fool!$b$bOthers wanted it and they had to be stopped! That fiend Twinbraid drove me off.$b$bNow I want it back. Back I say!
text.progress: Where is the Tear of the Moons? I need it now! Need I say!
text.completion: At last, the power is mine again! Mine I say!
text.completed: Return to Feegly the Exiled at Bael Modan in The Barrens.

text.title: 打火钥匙
text.objectives: 从鲁格维兹主管那里取得打火钥匙。
text.description: 你该不会是斯布特瓦夫派来的吧？我被困在这儿了。我在不知道需要钥匙才能启动伐木机的情况下就贸然跳了进来。更蠢的是，当另一台伐木机的操作员问我是否一切正常的时候，我居然慌了神！我没有告诉他我手里没钥匙，而只是说机器有些问题。$b$b我们要赶紧离开这里！到起重机上的控制室去，那里的鲁格维兹主管应该有这台伐木机的钥匙。$b$b帮我离开这儿！
text.progress: Quick, we need to get out of here before someone gets suspicious!
text.completion: Yep, this looks like the right key. Let me just make sure I know how to work this thing...$B$BHmm... rotation control... This regulates speed and stability... fine arm movement control. Just look at this! I can't believe the Venture Company could design something this much better than ours. I've got to get this back to Ratchet!
text.completed: Bring the key to Wizzlecrank's Shredder at the Sludge Fen in North Barrens.

english.title: Ignition
english.objectives: Get the Ignition Key from Supervisor Lugwizzle.
english.description: I don't suppose Sputtervalve sent you? I'm in a bind here. I hopped in without realizing that I need a key to unlock the shredder's movement column. One of the other shredder operators asked me if everything was okay, and I panicked! Instead of telling him that I was missing my key, I told him there was some sort of mechanical problem.$b$bWe need to get out of here on the double! Search the upper level of the derrick, Supervisor Lugwizzle should have a key for this shredder.$b$bHelp me out here!
english.progress: Quick, we need to get out of here before someone gets suspicious!
english.completion: Yep, this looks like the right key. Let me just make sure I know how to work this thing...$B$BHmm... rotation control... This regulates speed and stability... fine arm movement control. Just look at this! I can't believe the Venture Company could design something this much better than ours. I've got to get this back to Ratchet!
english.completed: Bring the key to Wizzlecrank's Shredder at the Sludge Fen in North Barrens.

text.title: Sergra Darkthorn
text.objectives: Speak with Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.
text.description: If you wish to walk the hunter's path, then your journey leads to the Barrens.  Its beasts are strong-willed and fierce.  You will learn much by hunting there, and your spirit will grow.$B$BSpeak with Sergra Darkthorn.  She will be your first guide in the Barrens.$B$BSergra is at the Crossroads.  To reach her, travel east from Bloodhoof Village into the Barrens, then north as the road forks.  And have care as you travel--the Barrens holds great danger for the unprepared and unwary.
text.completion: You want to hunt in the Barrens?$b$bYour eyes are eager, and young. They're not yet squinted from tracking your prey across this land's dry plains.$b$bBut worry not. We'll toughen your body and your mind. And we'll teach you that there is more to hunting than finding and killing your quarry.$b$bPrepare yourself. Your journey begins. Now.

text.title: 猎人之道
text.objectives: 收集4只平原徘徊者的爪子。
text.description: 我看得出来，你非常渴望探索。我也渴望到处漫游，至少曾经是这样……$B$B漫游，狩猎。狩猎是牛头人最高的荣誉。$B$B如果你真想走猎人这条路的话，就向我证明一下你的能力和决心。把莫高雷的平原徘徊者的爪子拿来给我看。平原徘徊者非常凶猛、狡猾——对于一个想要成为猎手的年轻$c来说再合适不过了。
text.progress: How goes the hunt, $N?
text.completion: Well done, young one.
text.completed: Return to Skorn Whitecloud at Camp Sungraze in Mulgore.

english.title: The Hunter's Way
english.objectives: Collect 4 Flatland Prowler Claws.
english.description: You are eager to explore, I can tell.  I too had the lust to wander, once...$B$BWander, and hunt.  For hunting is a tauren's greatest honor.$B$BIf you truly wish to follow the ways of the hunter, show me your skill and resolve. Bring me the claws of the flatland prowlers of Mulgore.  They are tough and cunning -- fitting prey for a young $c on the path of the hunt.
english.progress: How goes the hunt, $N?
english.completion: Well done, young one.
english.completed: Return to Skorn Whitecloud at Camp Sungraze in Mulgore.

text.title: Dig Rat Stew
text.objectives: Bring 8 Dig Rats to Grub east of the Crossroads.
text.description: A $c like you must get pretty hungry out here in The Barrens. Me, I'm starving all day long.$b$bTell you what, I'll fix you up a nice stew. Just need a few dig rats.$b$bSeems those filthy dwarves at Bael Modan are overrun with everyone's favorite feast. Now head on down south to Bael Modan and bring me back some dig rats.$b$bYou can't call yourself a seasoned adventurer until you've spent some time killing rats! Haw!
text.progress: Whack enough dig rats yet, $n?
text.completion: Normally I don't like to eat these rodents when they're so.... so... ripe. Like to let them rot for a few weeks to really bring out the flavor. But you look so hungry.$B$BLet me fix you some Dig Rat Stew. Ah, there we go.$B$BHere you go!
text.completed: Return to Grub in The Barrens.

english.completed: Return to Grub in The Barrens.

text.title: 逃跑
text.objectives: 保护维兹克兰克以及他搞到的地精伐木机离开淤泥沼泽。
text.description: 我想我要好好学学才行……应该不会很难。就这些按钮，一个操纵杆和两个……对了，你准备好要出发了吗？
text.progress: Can I help you?
text.completion: Hopefully we'll be able to get something of value from the wrecked shredder prototype... my time's running out! I'll dispatch a salvage team to Wizzlecrank's location on the double.$B$BOh, let me give you something for your trouble, too.
text.end: 护送维兹克兰克离开风险投资公司钻井工地
text.completed: 与北贫瘠之地诺兹波特的哨站的斯布特瓦夫交谈。

english.title: The Escape
english.objectives: Protect Wizzlecrank and the stolen goblin shredder on the way out of the Sludge Fens.
english.description: I suppose I'll learn as we go... Couldn't be too hard. Just some buttons here, and a lever or two... Well, are you ready to go?
english.progress: Can I help you?
english.completion: Hopefully we'll be able to get something of value from the wrecked shredder prototype... my time's running out! I'll dispatch a salvage team to Wizzlecrank's location on the double.$B$BOh, let me give you something for your trouble, too.
english.end: Escort Wizzlecrank out of the Venture Co. drill site
english.completed: Talk to Sputtervalve at Nozzlepot's Outpost in Northern Barrens.

text.title: Return to Apothecary Zinge
text.objectives: Bring the Sealed Field Testing Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
text.description: "Here you go, the power source is safely removed and the data is preserved.  Well, safe journeys and all that.  Hope the nefarious science experiment worked out for you and all."$B$BThe goblin turns away from you to attend to the demands of the Gadgetzan Water Company.  You secure the sealed testing kit for the journey back to the Undercity.  Apothecary Zinge waits for you and the sealed field testing kit there.
text.progress: Welcome back. At least, welcome back if you have returned with a sealed testing kit. Otherwise, I will pretend not to notice your utter incompetence and spare my wrath from you until you do as you have been tasked and accomplish my task.
text.completion: I will analyze this data immediately. Perhaps Keever's insanity will prove to be my genius after all.$B$BAs for you... you are useful to me, and I reward quite well those who remain useful. Take this item, this coin, and most importantly my thanks along with them.$B$BCheck back with me from time to time - I wager that our working together on this project is not at an end.

text.title: 一定是因为角
text.objectives: 获得镰爪之王的角。
text.description: 贫瘠之地的迅猛龙比其它地方的都要聪明。我想这份聪明劲就藏在它们的角里！要是这样的话，那我把它们的角磨成粉，做成“聪明剂”，我就发财了！$B$B你要干的事情是这样的：我要这附近最聪明的迅猛龙的角。“镰爪之王”是棘齿城北边悬崖上那些智能迅猛龙的头领。把他的角给我带来！别像我派去的其他人那样给扯成一条条的！
text.progress: Did you get the horns, $N? Those things are going to make me a fortune!
text.completion: Great, you got them! Now I just need to ground them down and mix them with some wine, and...
text.completed: Take Reaperclaw's Horn to Mebok Mizzyrix at Ratchet in North Barrens.

english.title: It's Gotta be the Horn
english.objectives: Acquire King Reaperclaw's Horn.
english.description: The raptors of the Barrens are smarter than raptors in other lands. I think all those smarts are hiding in their horns! If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks." I'll make a fortune!$B$BHere's where you come in: I want the horn from the smartest raptor around. "King Reaperclaw" leads a whole pack of intelligent raptors up on the bluffs north of Ratchet. Bring me his horn! And don't get ripped to ribbons like everyone else I've sent!
english.progress: Did you get the horns, $N? Those things are going to make me a fortune!
english.completion: Great, you got them! Now I just need to ground them down and mix them with some wine, and...
english.completed: Take Reaperclaw's Horn to Mebok Mizzyrix at Ratchet in North Barrens.

text.title: 根须样本
text.objectives: 在北贫瘠之地一带的草药上收集8份根须样本。
text.description: 贫瘠之地的草药似乎和其它地方的不大一样。它们的属性几乎相同，不过这里的绿洲之水却令它们发生了一些改变，使它们变得有那么一点点特别了。$B$B我想找出这些草药到底有什么特别之处……然后看看它们有没有利用价值！$B$B如果你精通草药的话，就帮我在贫瘠之地收集一些这种草药的根须样本吧。把这些样本交给我，这样一来，我就能比较一下它们与其它地区的草药之间的差异了。
text.progress: Hello, $N. Did you get those root samples?
text.completion: Yes yes, these are very nice! I will grow specimens from these roots and study them. I hope to find new properties from them. Hidden, valuable properties...!$B$BAnd don't worry -- if I do then you'll be the first to know. Because I'll need someone to gather more!
text.completed: Bring the Samples to Mebok Mizzyrix at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Root Samples
english.objectives: Collect 8 Root Samples from herbs around North Barrens.
english.description: The herbs of the Barrens are not quite like herbs in other lands.  Their properties are mostly the same, but the oasis water here alters the plants; they are just slightly different.$B$BI want to study those differences... to see if they're exploitable!$B$BIf you are skilled in herbalism, then gather root samples off the herbs you find in the Barrens.  Bring back these samples so that I may compare them with herbs from other regions.
english.progress: Hello, $N. Did you get those root samples?
english.completion: Yes yes, these are very nice! I will grow specimens from these roots and study them. I hope to find new properties from them. Hidden, valuable properties...!$B$BAnd don't worry -- if I do then you'll be the first to know. Because I'll need someone to gather more!
english.completed: Bring the Samples to Mebok Mizzyrix at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 鹰身强盗
text.objectives: 从巫翼鹰身人身上收集6只巫翼鹰身人的爪子。
text.description: $c，既然你在这里，就帮我们解决一个小问题吧。这些该死的鹰身人长期以来不停地攻击和掠夺我们的补给商队。现在我们要割断她们的喉咙，削减她们的数量。$B$B对付她们最有效的战术是首先破坏她们的底层指挥系统，然后再对她们的高层成员发动进攻。$B$B先去干掉那些在西北方出没的巫翼鹰身人，给我带6只巫翼鹰身人的爪子回来。这应该是一个不错的开始……
text.progress: Cut up enough of them yet? Keep slicing and taking trophies. I want 8 Witchwing talons.
text.completion: Oh, these are nice. Real nice... Good job, $N. I look forward to seeing more of your work in the future.
text.completed: Bring the talons to Darsok Swiftdagger at his outpost in North Barrens.
text.turninWindow: 让这些肮脏的怪物少一点，我也能轻松一点。

english.title: Harpy Raiders
english.objectives: Collect 6 Witchwing Talons from Witchwing harpies.
english.description: Since you're here, $c, perhaps you can help me with a small problem. The blasted harpies have been ravaging our caravan supplies for too long. It's time we slit a few of their throats and diminished their numbers.$B$BThe most devastating attack will destroy a good section of their lower chain of command and then we can work our way to the top.$B$BTake out Witchwing harpies of any kind in the Northwest and bring me 6 Witchwing Talons. That should be a good start...
english.progress: Cut up enough of them yet? Keep slicing and taking trophies. I want 8 Witchwing talons.
english.completion: Oh, these are nice. Real nice... Good job, $N. I look forward to seeing more of your work in the future.
english.completed: Bring the talons to Darsok Swiftdagger at his outpost in North Barrens.
english.turninWindow: Give me a few less of those filthy creatures to worry about.

text.title: 蝎卵
text.objectives: 把12枚异种蝎卵和掘地爪交给十字路口的科兰。
text.description: 嘿，$n，奥格瑞玛城里的主人派我到十字路口来观察这片土地并记录这里所发生的一切。$B$B我的目标之一是在巨人旷野南方出现的昆虫状生物。我们对这种生物知之甚少，所以我把它作为我的主要研究课题，希望能发现点什么。它们似乎有超出一般生物的智能。$B$B拿着这个掘地铲，从土丘里收集一些它们的卵。不过你要当心，这些生物一旦收到同伴的警报，就会立刻蜂拥而至。
text.progress: Be careful with the eggs you find, $N. If they break, they be no good to me.
text.completion: You please me, $N. The eggs and the tool. Well done.$B$BAnd for your reward...
text.completed: Return to Korran in The Barrens.

english.title: Egg Hunt
english.objectives: Bring 12 Silithid Eggs and the Digging Claw to Korran at the Crossroads.
english.description: Hey, $n. I been sent to the Crossroads to watch over the land and take note of its happenings for my masters in Orgrimmar.$B$BOne object of my studies are the insect-like creatures found to the south in the Field of Giants. We know little of the creatures, so I be makin' it a point to discover more. They seem to have intelligence to them, more so than any normal animal.$B$BTake this digging claw and collect some of the creatures' eggs from their mounds, but be careful: if alerted, they will attack you.
english.progress: Be careful with the eggs you find, $N. If they break, they be no good to me.
english.completion: You please me, $N. The eggs and the tool. Well done.$B$BAnd for your reward...
english.completed: Return to Korran in The Barrens.

text.title: 追踪窃贼
text.objectives: 脚印一路延伸到了荆棘岭的东侧。跟着这串脚印，看看你能找到些什么。
text.description: 一片狼藉的现场到处都是动物的脚印，而且是某种巨大而尖锐的爪子留下的，看样子是迅猛龙的脚印。$B$B你的直觉告诉你，可能是某些骑着迅猛龙的劫匪扫荡了这辆货车，但感觉不是很笃定，而且现场也没有其他人的脚印。$B$B脚印一路延伸到东北面的荆棘岭东侧。这个谜团的答案一定就在那里。
text.progress: Do you have those heads, $N?
text.completion: You got rid of the raptors!$B$BThank you, $N. You are a $C of worth.
text.completed: The tracks lead to the east side of Thorn Hill. Follow them and see what you find.

english.title: To Track a Thief
english.objectives: The tracks lead to the east side of Thorn Hill. Follow them and see what you find.
english.description: Animal tracks surround the wreckage, tracks made by enormous curved claws. They appear to be raptor tracks.$B$BYour first instinct is that raptor-riders assaulted the caravan, but the impressions aren't deep and there are no non-animal tracks to be seen.$B$BThe tracks head northeast of here toward the east side of Thorn Hill. The answer to this mystery must lie in its shadow.
english.progress: Do you have those heads, $N?
english.completion: You got rid of the raptors!$B$BThank you, $N. You are a $C of worth.
english.completed: The tracks lead to the east side of Thorn Hill. Follow them and see what you find.

text.title: 遗忘之池
text.objectives: 搜索十字路口西北的遗忘之池的底部。
text.description: 你能感受到大地的震颤吗？某种力量将这块大地劈成了两半。但是我们德鲁伊却能感受到另一种震颤。$B$B生命正在这片曾经干涸死寂的土地下发芽。十字路口周围的绿洲突然繁茂起来了。我感觉到一股神秘的力量正在逐渐渗透出地表。可它是从哪儿来的呢？它是否和撕裂贫瘠之地的那场灾难有关呢？$B$B我们必须找到这股力量的源头，请到十字路口西北边的遗忘之池去一趟，在那里的湖水中搜寻力量的源泉，然后回到这里来。
text.completion: You found a fissure in the earth, with gases bubbling from it? Strange. This may be an answer to our questions, but we cannot yet be sure.$B$BBut it is a clue. And I am grateful that you found it.
text.completed: Report your findings back to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

english.title: The Forgotten Pools
english.objectives: Search the bottom of the Forgotten Pools northwest of the Crossroads.
english.description: Have you felt the tremors, $c? Something has cleaved this land in two. But we druids can sense other tremors, as well.$B$BLife is stirring in lands once dry and lifeless. The oases around the Crossroads are suddenly blooming. I can sense a power leaking its way to the surface, but from where? Is it related to the disaster that shattered the Barrens?$B$BWe must find the source. Travel to the Forgotten Pools, northwest of the Crossroads. Search its waters for a source of power, then return here.
english.completion: You found a fissure in the earth, with gases bubbling from it? Strange. This may be an answer to our questions, but we cannot yet be sure.$B$BBut it is a clue. And I am grateful that you found it.
english.end: Explore the waters of the Forgotten Pools
english.completed: Report your findings back to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 保卫前沿哨所
text.objectives: 杀死8名钢鬃掠夺者和3名钢鬃猎手。
text.description: 所有的野猪人都是我们的敌人，$n。只不过其中有些比别的更讨厌。$B$B钢鬃部落一直在攻击从这里到奥格瑞玛的补给商队。我已经派斥候去寻找他们首领的位置，但在此之前，你能给这些肮脏的猪人造成多少打击，对我们来说都是好的。$B$B不妨从南部开始，他们经常侵袭我们在河边的营地。把它们找出来，杀掉它们。
text.progress: The longer it takes to stop these attacks, the harder it will be to provide supplies for the people of the Crossroads.
text.completion: You have done well, $N. Those insolent quilboars will finally learn that the might of the Horde is not to be ignored.
text.completed: Return to Kargal at Far Watch Post in Northern Barrens.

english.title: In Defense of Far Watch
english.objectives: Kill 8 Razormane Plunderers and 3 Razormane Hunters.
english.description: All the quilboars are our enemies, $n. Some just prove to be more of a nuisance than others.$B$BThe Razormane tribe has been attacking our supply caravans that roll through here from Orgrimmar. I have scouts seeking the leader of these raids, but until then, any losses you can inflict on the filthy pig men would aid us.$B$BStart just south of here, where they've been raiding our camps near the river. Seek them out, and slay them.
english.progress: The longer it takes to stop these attacks, the harder it will be to provide supplies for the people of the Crossroads.
english.completion: You have done well, $N. Those insolent quilboars will finally learn that the might of the Horde is not to be ignored.
english.completed: Return to Kargal at Far Watch Post in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 前沿哨所的进攻
text.objectives: 杀掉5名钢鬃防御者、5名钢鬃织棘者，以及克里尼格·糟鼻。拿到糟鼻的獠牙。
text.description: 那些猪头人杀进杜隆塔尔边境了？有我在就不行！就像他们说得那样，$n：最好的防御就是把对手统统碾死。$B$B我的斥候跟踪上次袭击商队的一个野猪人，得知了它们的所在。克里尼格·糟鼻指挥着它们沿着河边进行袭击。去除掉他，$c。打败他，消灭他的部队，就能阻止他们对营地发动攻击。$B$B到我们的兽栏南边，沿着河水找一个野猪人聚居的洞穴，那里就是你的目标。
text.progress: Cut off the head of their leader, and chaos ensues, $N. Learn this lesson well. It will aid you in the future.$B$BThe boars will flounder without direction, and we will be able to take back the Barrens.
text.completion: Well done, $N. With Kreenig's death, there will be a definite decline in the attacks on our caravans.$B$BYour people should be proud to count you among them.
text.completed: Bring Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk to Kargal Battlescar at Far Watch Post in Northern Barrens.

english.title: The Far Watch Offensive
english.objectives: Kill 5 Razormane Defenders, 5 Razormane Thornweavers, and Kreenig Snarlsnout. Take Snarlsnout's Tusk.
english.description: Pigmen running amok right on the border of Durotar? Not on my watch! It is as they say, $n: The best defense is crushing all who oppose you.$B$BOne of my scouts followed the quilboar after the last caravan raid, so we know where to strike. Kreenig Snarlsnout is the mastermind behind the attacks along the river. Crush him, $c. Defeat him and disembowel his forces so that the attacks on this camp cease.$B$BSearch for a quilboar-infested cavern along the river, just south of our stables.
english.progress: Cut off the head of their leader, and chaos ensues, $N. Learn this lesson well. It will aid you in the future.$B$BThe boars will flounder without direction, and we will be able to take back the Barrens.
english.completion: Well done, $N. With Kreenig's death, there will be a definite decline in the attacks on our caravans.$B$BYour people should be proud to count you among them.
english.completed: Bring Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk to Kargal Battlescar at Far Watch Post in Northern Barrens.

text.title: Isha Awak
text.objectives: Bring the Heart of Isha Awak to Mahren Skyseer.
text.description: The grand Isha Awak is lord of these waters.  Great is his strength, and solemn his pride.  The humans on the coast fear him, for he has consumed many of their number.$B$BBut I do not fear him.  I am grateful he is here.  He is a worthy challenge, and honorable prey.$B$BIf you are ready, then swim out and search for Isha Awak, the Deep Doom.$B$BHis spirit dwells in his heart, and to hear its beat is to know your fate.
text.progress: Fear not the waters, $R.
text.completion: You now are one with Isha Awak, $N. His spirit is with you. He lurks in your eyes...$B$BEyes that, one day, will learn to see.
text.completed: Return to Mahren Skyseer at The Tidus Stair in The Barrens.

english.title: Isha Awak
english.objectives: Bring the Heart of Isha Awak to Mahren Skyseer.
english.description: The grand Isha Awak is lord of these waters.  Great is his strength, and solemn his pride.  The humans on the coast fear him, for he has consumed many of their number.$B$BBut I do not fear him.  I am grateful he is here.  He is a worthy challenge, and honorable prey.$B$BIf you are ready, then swim out and search for Isha Awak, the Deep Doom.$B$BHis spirit dwells in his heart, and to hear its beat is to know your fate.

english.completion: You now are one with Isha Awak, $N. His spirit is with you. He lurks in your eyes...$B$BEyes that, one day, will learn to see.
english.completed: Return to Mahren Skyseer at The Tidus Stair in The Barrens.

text.title: Mahren Skyseer
text.objectives: Speak with Mahren Skyseer.
text.description: You have hunted the beasts of the Barrens.  Your spirit is strong.  But a hunter must always be prepared.  A true hunter can stalk prey down any path.  Mountains and swamps will not sway $ghim:her;.$B$BNot even the sea.$B$BFind my sister, Mahren.  She hunts the great water beasts along the coast.  She will be your teacher in their ways.$B$BBut be wary in your search for her, for the Barrens' coast is held by humans.
text.completion: My brother sent you, did he? Then you must have proven yourself to him. If you have earned the respect of Jorn, then you have my respect as well.$B$BAre you ready to tread farther down the hunter's path?

english.title: Mahren Skyseer
english.objectives: Speak with Mahren Skyseer.

Mountains and swamps will not sway $ghim:her;.$B$BNot even the sea.$B$BFind my sister, Mahren.  She hunts the great water beasts along the coast.  She will be your teacher in their ways.$B$BBut be wary in your search for her, for the Barrens' coast is held by humans.
english.completion: My brother sent you, did he? Then you must have proven yourself to him. If you have earned the respect of Jorn, then you have my respect as well.$B$BAre you ready to tread farther down the hunter's path?

text.title: 鹰身人首领
text.objectives: 在北贫瘠之地的无水岭消灭6只巫翼杀戮者。
text.description: 阻止鹰身人袭击的唯一办法只能是摧毁她们的指挥锁链。这些鹰身人的首领是不知畏惧的巫翼杀戮者。如果干掉她们，其余的鹰身人就不足为惧了。$B$B到无水岭去，消灭那里的巫翼杀戮者。让她们尝尝失败的痛苦，$n。我们要让那些下贱的鹰身人知道，与部落为敌是多么愚蠢的行为。
text.progress: Do you have 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings yet? Justice must be dealt to them for their vicious attacks on the Horde.
text.completion: Excellent work my friend. I think you'll go far within the Horde.
text.completed: Return to Darsok Swiftdagger at his outpost in Northern Barrens.
text.giverWindow: 让那些肮脏的怪物明白，部落不是好惹的。
text.turninWindow: 你是部落所倚仗的力量！

english.title: Harpy Lieutenants
english.objectives: Kill 6 Witchwing Slayers in the Dry Hills of the Northern Barrens.
english.description: The only way to stop the harpy raiders is to destroy their chain of command. The harpies are led by fearless lieutenants, Witchwing Slayers. If the Slayers fall, the rest will follow.$B$BGo to the Dry Hills and cut down the Witchwing Slayers. Make sure they die painfully, $n. We want those harpy wenches to know the idiocy of picking fights with the Horde.
english.progress: Do you have 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings yet? Justice must be dealt to them for their vicious attacks on the Horde.
english.completion: Excellent work my friend. I think you'll go far within the Horde.
english.completed: Return to Darsok Swiftdagger at his outpost in Northern Barrens.
english.giverWindow: Show those foul creatures that the Horde are not to be trifled with.
english.turninWindow: You are a worthy member of the Horde!

text.title: 塞瑞娜·血羽
text.objectives: 杀掉塞瑞娜·血羽，获得她的徽记。
text.description: 你杀死的那些鹰身人提到了她们的主母——塞瑞娜·血羽。从她们对部落的恶毒憎恨来看，塞瑞娜·血羽一定对部落抱着某种深仇大恨。你决定消灭塞瑞娜·血羽，彻底为部落结束这一威胁。
text.progress: You're not getting anything until I see Serena's head.
text.completion: HA! Well done, $N! Very well done... I wasn't sure you were up to the task, but you've proved yourself quite the cut-throat. Thank you again for helping us suppress the Harpy epidemic. Here is your reward, use it well.
text.completed: Return to Darsok Swiftdagger in Northern Barrens.
text.giverWindow: 杀了她。别忘了她的脑袋。

english.title: Serena Bloodfeather
english.objectives: Slay Serena Bloodfeather and collect her head.
english.description: The harpies you've killed mentioned their matron, Serena Bloodfeather. Judging from their vile hatred toward the Horde, she must hold some kind of deep-seated grudge. You decide to hunt down Serena Bloodfeather and end matters once and for all.
english.progress: You're not getting anything until I see Serena's head.
english.completion: HA! Well done, $N! Very well done... I wasn't sure you were up to the task, but you've proved yourself quite the cut-throat. Thank you again for helping us suppress the Harpy epidemic. Here is your reward, use it well.
english.completed: Return to Darsok Swiftdagger in Northern Barrens.
english.giverWindow: Kill her. Don't forget her head.

text.title: 死水绿洲
text.objectives: 使用干枯的种子调查死水绿洲底部的裂隙。
text.description: 南边到底发生了些什么呢？根据你在遗忘之池的发现，那些绿洲可能是发现问题的关键。$B$B带上这些种子，它们已经失去生命的活力。把它们带到东南方的死水绿洲去，如果那里有地缝的话，就把这些种子放在里面……然后仔细地观察一下。把你的发现告诉十字路口的图加。
text.progress: Have you been to the Stagnant Oasis? Was there a fissure beneath its waters?
text.completion: Your findings are amazing! The seeds I gave you were dried, and dead. Whatever rests under these oases can create life from nothing!$B$BWe must study this more...
text.completed: Report your findings to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

english.title: The Stagnant Oasis
english.objectives: Use the dried seeds to investigate the fissures in the Stagnant Oasis.
english.description: Can what's happening to the south happen here? Judging by what you found at the Forgotten Pools, these oases may be the key. Let's perform an experiment.$B$BHere, take these seeds I've collected from the summit here. They are dead and infertile, but carry them down to the Stagnant Oasis just below us. If there is a fissure there, then place the seeds within it... and observe. Report your findings back to Tonga at the Crossroads.
english.progress: Have you been to the Stagnant Oasis? Was there a fissure beneath its waters?
english.completion: Your findings are amazing! The seeds I gave you were dried, and dead. Whatever rests under these oases can create life from nothing!$B$BWe must study this more...
english.completed: Report your findings to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

text.title: Tribes at War
text.objectives: Kill 6 Bristleback Water Seekers, 12 Bristleback Thornweavers and 12 Bristleback Geomancers and return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
text.description: You must strike my enemies. <snort> You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. <snort> It gives us strength in all things... especially war.$B$BIf you want to find out who really causes Thork <snort> and the Horde such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the Barrens.
text.progress: More information <snort> for the Horde when you've killed the Bristleback's wise ones, $R. <snort> Not a moment earlier! Mangletooth is no fool.
text.completion: Yes, yes... filled with joy because finally <snort> the Bristleback know my tribe's pain, $R. That is how I should feel, but that <snort> is not the case.$B$BYou aid your people and they honor you. Mangletooth aids his people, and what do they do? They turn their backs on him. They forget him and leave him to rot in cage!$B$BI aid them even from locked behind bars and they send no one to save me!
text.completed: Return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

english.completed: Return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

text.title: Betrayal from Within
text.objectives: Kill Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane and bring their skulls to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
text.description: Three of my tribe came out of the Kraul to lead the raids against the Horde, $r. <snort> They are ruthless and cunning, and if you defeat them, then your Crossroads and even most of the Barrens will learn peace... <snort> at least from the Razormane tribe. <snort>$B$BNak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are the ones you seek. They are far to the south  of the Barrens. One is a spell caster, another a tracker, and their leader, the one called Orcbane, <snort> a warrior. Kill them, $r, like they have killed me.
text.progress: How goes your hunt, $R? <snort>$B$BThork thinks he knows the truth about who leads the raids against his people, <snort> but he shall learn how wrong he is if you are successful.$B$BMy death is inescapable, but you have caused great pain to my enemies, so Mangletooth regrets nothing. <snort>
text.completion: It is done then. Better it ends this way, says Mangletooth. <snort> They should have <snort> made sure I was dead when they turned their backs on me instead of leaving <snort> me here in this forsaken cage.$B$BThere is but one task left for you to finish, $R.
text.completed: Return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

text.title: 变异的生物
text.objectives: 从死水绿洲的钳嘴龟那里收集6块变异的钳嘴龟壳。
text.description: 研究那些被绿洲和你发现的异常能量所影响的植物和动物是件很重要的事。死水绿洲是一种钳嘴龟的家园。最近它们的数量激增。更严重的是，那些平素温和的动物却变得狂躁起来，看。$B$B<杰瑞克举起一根包着绷带的手指。>$B$B我怀疑它们被绿洲影响了。收集它们的甲壳然后带给十字路口的图加来进行进一步研究。
text.progress: How goes your collection? Did you get the shells?
text.completion: Thank you, $N. Studying the beasts of an area can tell much about the area itself. We shall see what tale these shells tell.$B$BPlease accept my gratitude for your aid ... and perhaps you can use these coins. I find that I do not need them.
text.completed: Bring the Shells to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Altered Beings
english.objectives: Collect 6 Altered Snapjaw Shells from Snapjaws in the Stagnant Oasis.
english.description: It will be important to study both plant and animal life impacted by the oases and the unusual energies you've discovered. The Stagnant Oasis below us is home to a species of snapjaw turtles. Recently their population has exploded. Moreover, the once peaceful animals are growing aggressive, as I learned the hard way before trekking up here.$B$B<Jerrik holds up a bandaged finger.>$B$BI suspect they've been altered by the oases. Collect their shells and take them to Tonga at Crossroads for further study.
english.progress: How goes your collection? Did you get the shells?
english.completion: Thank you, $N. Studying the beasts of an area can tell much about the area itself. We shall see what tale these shells tell.$B$BPlease accept my gratitude for your aid ... and perhaps you can use these coins. I find that I do not need them.
english.completed: Bring the Shells to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 埃其亚基
text.objectives: 在埃其亚基的巢穴外吹响号角，然后杀死或制服它。
text.description: 白雾，也就是我们牛头人所说的埃其亚基，是草原狮的首领。它在捕食猎物时悄无声息地行动，就像大地上浮起的一层薄薄的白雾。它每次出击都是一击毙命，它的猎物甚至来不及恐惧和痛苦就已魂飞魄散。$B$B牛头人说，它是慈悲与死亡的混合体。$B$B$n，现在我派你去猎杀埃其亚基。它的巢穴就在这里的西北方，一座小山丘的北面，在那些巨大的科多兽骨附近。$B$B去吧，当你走到它的巢穴附近时，就吹响这个号角，它会出现的。
text.progress: The great cat calls to you, $N.
text.completion: You've beaten Echeyakee, and though his days of hunting are over... his spirit is with you. He will show you the strength found in subtlety, and the honor in mercy.$B$BYour path is still long, $C. Let's hope you stride it well.
text.completed: Return to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Echeyakee
english.objectives: Blow your horn at Echeyakee's lair to summon him. Slay or subdue him.
english.description: Whitemist, or 'Echeyakee' in the tauren tongue, is the king of the savannah cats. He hunts with such stealth, they say he's like a thin, white mist on the earth. He kills so fast his prey have no time for fear or pain.$B$BThe tauren say he is both mercy and death.$B$B$n, I now set you on the path to hunt Echeyakee. His lair is just northwest of here, on the north side of a small mountain, among the bones of giant Kodo.$B$BGo. Blow this horn when you reach his lair. Blow the horn, and he will come.
english.progress: The great cat calls to you, $N.
english.completion: You've beaten Echeyakee, and though his days of hunting are over... his spirit is with you. He will show you the strength found in subtlety, and the honor in mercy.$B$BYour path is still long, $C. Let's hope you stride it well.
english.completed: Return to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

text.title: Ishamuhale
text.objectives: Bring Ishamuhale's Fang to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
text.description: Ishamuhale, Speartooth, is the fiercest sunscale raptor of the Barrens.  He does not hunt for sport, nor for food.  He hunts because hunting is his passion.  He kills because it is his nature to kill.$B$BAnd you will learn of his nature, $n, for your path now follows the taloned tracks of Ishamuhale.$B$BBegin the hunt.  Slay his favorite prey, a zhevra, then bring its carcass to the dead tree northwest of Ratchet.  Ishamuhale will smell the carcass and be drawn to it.$B$BBe ready when he comes.
text.progress: $N, have you bested Ishamuhale?
text.completion: This fang is merely a token, but what it represents is profound.$B$BIshamuhale's strength is in you, $N. May you use it with temperance. That is your burden.$B$BThat is your honor.
text.completed: Return to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

text.title: Lakota'mani
text.objectives: Bring the Hoof of Lakota'mani to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
text.description: The Hoof of Lakota'mani is a symbol of the strength of the great kodo.
text.progress: $N, when you approached I saw a new power in your stride. Tell me -- has your spirit met with the great Lakota'mani?
text.completion: Lakota'mani is called Earthshaker in our language, and his steps are like gathered thunder. He is with you now, and his courage mingles with yours. Together there is no conflict you cannot face.$B$BWalk tall, $N. Walk tall, Earthshaker.

text.title: Owatanka
text.objectives: Bring Owatanka's Tailspike to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
text.description: When touched, sparks fly from the tailspike of Owatanka.
text.progress: $N, there is a new power behind your eyes! You have met with the mighty Owatanka, have you not?
text.completion: The thunder lizard Owatanka is called Bluebolt by the tauren, for within him resides a speed that belies his size. It is said that lightning struck Bluebolt long ago and, fed from the sky's rage, the great beast's energy is without limit.$B$BMay his energy flow through you, $N. For you now keep pace with Owatanka.

text.title: Washte Pawne
text.objectives: Bring Washte Pawne's Feather to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
text.description: The feather of Washte Pawne is painful to the touch.
text.progress: There is new resolve within you, $N. A resolve born from pain...$B$BAre you burdened with the death of Washte Pawne?
text.completion: The thunderhawk is a rare beast of the Barrens, and its death can portend great fortune, or great doom.$B$BBut Washte Pawne, called Spirit Biter in Taurahe, can bring neither... or both.$B$BThe pain you felt from hunting Spirit Biter is the pang all feel who make great gains at great costs. The sting you felt is the pain of regret.$B$BBut I can see you have conquered this. You have learned that regret turns to wisdom, and that through pain one gains strength.$B$BYou have learned much, $N.

text.title: The Barrens Oases
text.objectives: Speak with Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.
text.description: The druids of Thunder Bluff sense a strange power leaking into the Barrens, east of Mulgore.$B$BTonga Runetotem was sent to discover the source of this power, but we fear he will need aid.$B$BTravel to the Barrens and speak with Tonga.  He will be at the Crossroads.  To reach there, take the road east out of Bloodhoof village.  Enter the Barrens, then turn north when the road forks.  Continue north and  you will find the Crossroads.$B$BAnd do not leave the road, $n, for the Barrens is a harsh land.
text.completion: My brethren in Thunder Bluff were wise to send you, young $C. For the mystery of the Barrens is one that I alone cannot unravel.$B$BWith your aid, let us hope we can find answers to our questions.

text.title: 南海海盗
text.objectives: 在勇士岛上杀死8个南海杀手或南海私掠者。
text.description: 加兹鲁维承诺我如果我能帮他解决棘齿城的海盗问题就升我的职。当下那些海盗已经占领了南部的勇士岛，他们不仅是想打我货物的主意，他们就想找麻烦！前几天晚上他们居然还敢袭击我们的战船。$B$B怎么对付他们我已经有安排了，但是加兹鲁维想要立竿见影的结果。拜托你了，去勇士岛给我弄死几个海盗，好吗？
text.progress: I don't even want to think about the profits I've lost from pirate raiding, and now they set up camp on my doorstep? It's getting out of hand, Undermine's got to do something about it.
text.completion: You did good, kid. A little more work like that, and it'll be one less thing I'll have to worry about. Hopefully they'll be convinced that they should relocate their operation elsewhere.$B$BIn the meantime, there is the small matter of getting back the goods they stole from me!
text.completed: Return to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.

english.title: Southsea Freebooters
english.objectives: Kill 8 Southsea Cutthroats or Privateers on Fray Island.
english.description: Gazlowe promised me a promotion if I can help him with Ratchet's pirate issues. The problem is these new buccaneers that sailed in and took over Fray Island, south of here. They're not just after our goods - they've got grudges to settle! The other night they even went after one of our war galleons.$B$BI've got plans in the works to deal with the situation, but Gazlowe wants to see quick results. Head over to Fray Island and start lopping off some heads, will you?
english.progress: I don't even want to think about the profits I've lost from pirate raiding, and now they set up camp on my doorstep? It's getting out of hand, Undermine's got to do something about it.
english.completion: You did good, kid. A little more work like that, and it'll be one less thing I'll have to worry about. Hopefully they'll be convinced that they should relocate their operation elsewhere.$B$BIn the meantime, there is the small matter of getting back the goods they stole from me!
english.completed: Return to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.

text.title: [DEPRICATED]Stolen Booty
text.objectives: Retrieve the Shipment of Boots and Telescopic Lens for Gazlowe in Ratchet.
text.description: While I'd like to recover all my goods, I'm sure that's not possible. Still, there's a few things that I absolutely must have!$b$bAs you see, my observatory is ready to go, but it needs the smaller of the two lenses. The first arrived by caravan from Durotar, but the second was bound by ship, and never arrived. Also, I never got my boot shipment from Drizzlik in Booty Bay!$b$bHead down to the pirate camp and see if you can find them.
text.progress: Did you find my things, $N?
text.completion: It's a relief to get all this stuff back, so thanks for your help, $N. You know, I could use a $R like you to help out with my operation here. If you're ever looking for work, don't forget about how well Gazlowe pays for service!

text.title: Spirit of the Wind
text.progress: Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.$B$BIt will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
text.completion: Good. Go with Agamaggan's spirit as your guide, $R. Return to me if you desire more of Agamaggan's magics.
text.completed: Return to Mangletooth in Mulgore.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]The Missing Shipment
text.objectives: Bring Gazlowe's Ledger to Wharfmaster Dizzywig.
text.description: I've been waiting forever for my last shipment of goods from Booty Bay! I'm pretty sure that it must have been stolen by the Freebooters, but just to make sure, will you go down to the dockside and ask Dizzywig if my goods were already put into my warehouse without my knowledge?$b$bHere, take my ledger down to Dizzywig and have him double check my inventory records against his logs.
text.progress: Wares to send on the next ship, $N?
text.completion: Ah, Gazlowe sent you, did he? Just a moment, let me take a look here and check my own logs and make sure I didn't have Gazlowe's shipment sent to the wrong place.$B$BBet he's waiting for those boots from Drizzlek...

text.title: 船长的复仇
text.objectives: 从塞拉摩水兵和码头守卫那里收集10枚塞拉摩徽章。杀掉培里中尉和布克兰德中尉。
text.description: 那些狂热过头的塞拉摩人类，又让我的舰队损失一条船！$b$b他们新任的海军上将就停靠在海岸这儿，过往船只一旦不听他命令停靠，他要么把它们轰沉，要么就强行登船。$b$b沿着商旅海岸往南就是他的营地，到那里去把他们的水兵和摩码头守卫的徽章抢来给我。除掉他的左膀右臂——培里和布克兰德。把他们干掉，就像他们干掉我的舰队一样！
text.progress: My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. I want her soldiers to pay as well. Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.
text.completion: Alas, the righteous Alliance guns have been silenced. You shall be rewarded for your aid, $N.$B$BNow to tend to the grim task of recovering the bodies of the dead....
text.completed: Return to Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun at Ratchet in North Barrens.

english.title: A Captain's Vengeance
english.objectives: Collect 10 Theramore Medals from Theramore Marines and Deck Hands. Kill Lieutenants Pyre and Buckland.
english.description: Yet another ship from my fleet has been lost to those overzealous humans from Theramore!$b$bTheir new Rear Admiral has parked himself right off the coast here. He's boarding or sinking any vessel that doesn't heave-to at his whim.$b$bTravel south along the Merchant Coast to his camp. Bring me the medals of the marines and deck hands. Execute his top Lieutenants, Pyre and Buckland. Lay waste to them as they have laid waste to my fleet!
english.progress: My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. I want her soldiers to pay as well. Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.
english.completion: Alas, the righteous Alliance guns have been silenced. You shall be rewarded for your aid, $N.$B$BNow to tend to the grim task of recovering the bodies of the dead....
english.completed: Return to Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun at Ratchet in North Barrens.

text.title: [DEPRECATED]The Missing Shipment
text.objectives: Return Gazlowe's Ledger to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
text.description: Everything looks square from my records, $n. Go on back and tell Gazlowe he's out of luck. I wouldn't be surprised if it was the pirates that nabbed his goodies.$b$bNothing else I can do for him. Oh... though you could tell him that I've got some things from Undermine for him, when he has the time to come pick them up.
text.progress: So, what did Dizzywig have to say?
text.completion: No dice, eh? I guess it must have been the Freebooters then... Dizzywig's on the level, I'm sure he wouldn't cheat me like that. After all, he is on the payroll.$B$BLooks like I've got some goods to get back, $N. What do you say?

text.title: Weapons of Choice
text.objectives: Bring a Razormane Backstabber, a Charred Razormane Wand and a Razormane War Shield to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
text.description: The Razormane quilboars to the south, beyond the Field of Giants, have no skilled blacksmiths from what I am told, but they've apparently started to develop sturdier weapons. I'd like to get my hands on a few different types to learn their techniques if possible.$B$BIf you wish to help bring honor to the Horde, then bring me examples of their weapons. Find me a dagger from their stalkers, a wand from their seers, and a shield from their warfrenzy. That should do nicely!
text.progress: I, too, have doubts that the pathetic quilboars could attain any level of skill in the area of smithing, but I do as the Warchief commands, and I shall learn what I can about the Razormane tribe.$B$BI have had more menial tasks, and I do so willingly if it aids the orc people.
text.completion: Excellent, excellent specimens indeed.$B$BThe quilboar are further along than I had expected.$B$BHere, $C, take this and get out of my way. I'd better take a closer look at these weapons. We may have underestimated our enemy, and that's the kind of mistake we can't afford to make.
text.completed: Return to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

text.title: Samophlange
text.objectives: Access the control console at the Venture Company research site.
text.description: The Venture Company have a small research facility west of here, just past the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".$b$bNow what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.$b$bI obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.
text.completion: A variety of buttons, levers and blinking lights are somewhat erratically arrayed on the face of the control console. A small gauge indicates that the apparatus is currently operating within optimal levels, and indicates that control valves one through three are currently open. There is a small keyhole set into the lower right side of the control panel.
text.completed: Access the control console at the Venture Company research site in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 通缉：嘉维伊船长
text.objectives: 把嘉维伊船长的徽记带给棘齿城的加兹鲁维。
text.description: 通缉！$b$b女武士之匕号的$b“船长”J·嘉维伊$b$b他犯有在公海进行海盗活动、绑架、勒索、纵火、非法奴役等罪行。近日有目击称，嘉维伊来到这片海域，带领一伙南海海盗袭击了勇士岛。把他的可辨识的死亡证明带来！$b$b- 加兹鲁维
text.progress: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
text.completion: Ahhhh! That sort of business. You know, I saw the Heedless once on the open seas. Fearsome ship, or was that boat... those sailors are so particular!$B$BAnyways, watching her glide across the water was quite a sight to see. I'm glad her infamous captain will trouble my ships no longer.
text.completed: Bring Garvey's head to Gazlowe at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.

english.title: WANTED: Cap'n Garvey
english.objectives: Bring the head of Cap'n Garvey to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
english.description: WANTED!$b$b    "Cap'n" J. Garvey of$b     the Maiden's Dagger$b$bCharged with piracy on the open seas, kidnapping, extortion, arson, slavery, et al. Garvey recently arrived in these waters leading a crew of Southsea Freebooters and was last seen assaulting Fray Island. Bring proof of death in an identifiable condition!$b$b-- Gazlowe
english.progress: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
english.completion: Ahhhh! That sort of business. You know, I saw the Heedless once on the open seas. Fearsome ship, or was that boat... those sailors are so particular!$B$BAnyways, watching her glide across the water was quite a sight to see. I'm glad her infamous captain will trouble my ships no longer.
english.completed: Bring Garvey's head to Gazlowe at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.

text.title: Miner's Fortune
text.objectives: Retrieve the Cats Eye Emerald from one of the Venture Co. Overseers or Enforcers.
text.description: Hey $r, you interested in treasure? I knew that would get your attention.$b$bWord from the river dock here is that one of the miners in the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine just northeast of here discovered an emerald the size of your fist.$B$BI know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale. You in?
text.progress: If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...
text.completion: Look at the size of that thing, $N! We're going to be rich! Let's see, according to the rates I've seen on gems going into Undermine, I should be able to figure out your cut--fifty percent, don't worry!$B$BNow let's see... I think this should do about right. Pleasure doing business with you, $N.
text.completed: Bring the Emerald to Brak Blusterpipe in Nozzlepot's Outpost in Northern Barrens.

text.title: The Harvester
text.objectives: Bring the Harvester's Head to Jorn Skyseer.
text.description: This strange, insect-like creature looks outside of the natural order, as though it does not belong in the Barrens.
text.progress: You seemed troubled, $N. How go your lessons in the Barrens? Did you find something that disturbs you?
text.completion: I can tell nothing of the nature of this beast, for its spirit has fled. But as you guessed, it does not belong in the Barrens. I fear it may herald a grim future for our people...$B$BBut for now, prepare yourself, and let us hope that time unravels the mystery of this creature.

I fear it may herald a grim future for our people...$B$BBut for now, prepare yourself, and let us hope that time unravels the mystery of this creature.

text.title: Free From the Hold
text.objectives: Safely escort Gilthares Firebough back to Captain Brightsun in Ratchet.
text.description: Finally! Someone to rescue me!$b$bI can't believe you got past the guards. These zealots from Theramore are out of their minds. They sank our ship and imprisoned me, the only survivor. I was called an enemy and threat to the Alliance.$b$bMe! A threat to their great sham of an Alliance? I was a deckhand on a moonshine transport between Ratchet and Booty Bay.$b$bEnough talk. Help me get back to Ratchet will you? Let me know when you're ready and we'll make our break.
text.progress: Yes?
text.completion: And to think, we thought Firebough was long dead!$B$BYour heroics have earned you a place of honor with the Thalo'dan Privateers, $N.
text.end: Escort Gilthares Firebough back to Ratchet
text.completed: Return to Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun in The Barrens.

text.title: 复仇的怒火
text.objectives: 收集30根刺背野猪人的獠牙。
text.description: 他们杀了我的妻子，烧毁了我的家园。自从那个可怕的夜晚之后，我在这片土地上游荡，从日出到日落，寻找这些罪无可赦的恶魔。我见一个野猪人就杀一个。但这依然远远无法平息我复仇的欲望。$B$B我想你这个$c能够帮助我。$B$B去杀掉那些野猪人，能杀多少就杀多少。带回它们的獠牙，让我们一起为它们的死亡而庆贺吧。
text.progress: The quilboar will pay for this, $N. I swear it.
text.completion: $C, you take my task seriously, and for that I thank you.$B$BAlthough my desire for revenge remains, I can at least smile seeing that the quilboars have felt pain themselves.
text.completed: Bring the Tusks to Mankrik at the Grol'dom Farm in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Consumed by Hatred
english.objectives: Collect 30 Quilboar Tusks.
english.description: They murdered my wife. They burned my homestead. Since that awful night I have traveled these lands, from the sun's rising till its decline, scouring the horizon for more of those monsters. I've killed every pig man I've come across since, but my thirst for their blood is far from quenched.$B$BYou, $c - you could help me.$B$BKill them. Kill as many as you can. Bring me their tusks, and we will celebrate their deaths together.
english.progress: The quilboar will pay for this, $N. I swear it.
english.completion: $C, you take my task seriously, and for that I thank you.$B$BAlthough my desire for revenge remains, I can at least smile seeing that the quilboars have felt pain themselves.
english.completed: Bring the Tusks to Mankrik at the Grol'dom Farm in Northern Barrens.

text.title: Samophlange
text.objectives: Close off the Fuel Control Valve, the Regulator Valve and the Main Control Valve then use the control console again.
text.description: The three control valves are currently opened. The various readings on the control panel lead you to presume that they must be shut off before the apparatus can be shut off.
text.progress: Blinking lights on the control console indicate that the main control valves have not been closed off.
text.completion: The lights indicating the three control valves dim as they are shut off. Green lights slowly fade into yellow, and the switch controlling the apparatus is now moveable, with the valves closed, it can be turned off.
text.completed: Return to the Control Console at the Venture Company Research Outpost in Northern Barrens.

text.title: Samophlange
text.objectives: Get the Console Key from Tinkerer Sniggles.
text.description: With the apparatus deactivated, the control panel can be opened up and the samophlange removed from the console. With everything else in place, all that is left is to acquire the key to unlock the console.
text.progress: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.
text.completion: Turning the key in the lock, the control console unlocks. A red light at the top of the console turns off and all power drains from the terminal.
text.completed: Return to the Control Console at the Venture Company Research Post in Northern Barrens.

text.title: Samophlange
text.objectives: Return the Samophlange to Sputtervalve at Nozzlepot's Outpost in Northern Barrens.
text.description: Pulling open the face of the control console reveals a dense jumble of wires, tubing and other strange mechanical objects--most of which seem to serve no practical purpose. Pushing them aside and digging deeper into the console, you find the samophlange. A tug removes it from its housing.
text.progress: Oh, you're back, $N! Do you have the samophlange?
text.completion: This is... er... interesting... yes. I'll have it sent along to the Tinkers' Union headquarters in Undermine. I'm sure after some careful dissection and research, they'll be able to make some sense of it.$B$BBut, perhaps I'll have a little look myself first...
text.completed: Return the Samophlange to Sputtervalve at Nozzlepot's Outpost in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 猎杀雌狮
text.objectives: 从雌性草原狮身上收集5只猎手之爪。
text.description: 如果你真的想要向我证明你的勇气，就去挑战一下真正凶猛的猎物吧。贫瘠之地的雌性草原狮是极其狡诈的猛兽。它们非常坚强，机智，敏捷……而且致命。最近，它们在镇子外的荒郊野地里袭击我们的斥候，尤其是在东北方。$B$B狩猎的时候要多加小心，$n。不然你就会发现自己不再是猎手，而是猎物。
text.progress: How goes your hunt, $N? Have you found the prowlers?
text.completion: Ah, I see you've been busy, lurking in the grasses and hunting prowlers. Do you think, then, it is time to face a champion among them?
text.completed: Deliver the Claws to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Hunting the Huntress
english.objectives: Collect 5 Huntress Claws from Savannah Huntresses.
english.description: If you want to really demonstrate your bravery to me, let me send you after something that really bites. The savannah huntresses of the Barrens are as sly as they come. Tough, resourceful, quick... and deadly. They've been hassling our scouts recently around the outskirts of the town, especially to the northeast.$B$BBe wary as you hunt them, $n, or you may find yourself no longer the predator, but instead the prey.
english.progress: How goes your hunt, $N? Have you found the prowlers?
english.completion: Ah, I see you've been busy, lurking in the grasses and hunting prowlers. Do you think, then, it is time to face a champion among them?
english.completed: Deliver the Claws to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 在迅猛龙的巢穴里
text.objectives: 杀死赤鳞迅猛龙，收集它们的羽毛。在3处赤鳞之巢上使用羽毛。
text.description: 狩猎要更进一步了，$n。现在你必须到猎物的老巢里击败它们。$B$B赤鳞迅猛龙在南面路边的山中筑巢，捕杀它们，把它们戴着的羽毛拿走。将羽毛放在赤鳞迅猛龙的巢穴里，让它们的弟兄知道你不怕它们！$B$B要当心，$c。迅猛龙都是成群出击的，你稍不留神就会被它们包围。
text.progress: Have you been to the nests, $N?
text.completion: Is your task finished? Ponder the life of the Scytheclaw as you do it. There are important lessons within every creature's lifespawn. $B$BSome of the others believe I have been too heavy handed in my lesson. I know that you are simply following my orders, but I want you to consider the life of the creatures you are slaughtering. $B$BThough they are at times a nuisance, they only become threatening when we seek their slaughter. This days defilement will cause us more trouble than it will solve problems...
text.completed: Return to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads in North Barrens.

english.title: Into the Raptor's Den
english.objectives: Kill Sunscale raptors and collect their feathers. Use the feathers on the 3 Sunscale Nests.
english.description: The hunt deepens, $n. Now you must find and defeat your prey within its lair.$B$BHunt the Sunscale raptors to the south, where they have built a warren amongst the hills just off of the road. Slay them and remove the feathers they wear. Place the feathers on the sunscale raptor nests to show their brethren you do not fear them!$B$BBe cautious, $c. Raptors hunt in packs and will swarm you if you are not cautious.
english.progress: Have you been to the nests, $N?
english.completion: Is your task finished? Ponder the life of the Scytheclaw as you do it. english.completed: Return to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads in North Barrens.

text.title: Betrayal from Within
text.objectives: Bring Lok's Skull to Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
text.description: Take Lok's head to Thork in the Crossroads, $r. <snort> He should know what has happened to my tribe without any words--ha, not that he would believe Mangletooth helped in <snort> such things. But I am sure he'll reward you for carrying out such a great deed. <snort>$B$BI will continue to bless you with Agamaggan's power for as long as I remain in this cage, $r. Until then, farewell.
text.progress: Yes, what is it?
text.completion: You found the Razormane leader and killed him yourself, $N? Amazing.$B$BI am without words, but that does not mean I am without thanks. The people of the Crossroads would do well to respect your strength.$B$BI must admit, I thought the leader of these raids on our supply lines was another quilboar. Thank you again, $N.

text.title: Enraged Thunder Lizards
text.objectives: Bring 3 Thunder Lizard Blood to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
text.description: Now, $n, you must face the great thunder lizards.  So large are the beasts, the ground rumbles as they stomp across the plains.  Take care as you fight them, for one false step and you may find yourself beneath their feet.$B$BYou will find the thunder lizards in the southern Barrens.  They are known as Stormsnouts, Stormhides and Thunderheads.  Return to me after you have bested them.
text.progress: Are the thunder lizards defeated, $N?
text.completion: It is good to see you return with proof of victory. And it is good to know you have done so with your bones unbroken.
text.completed: Return to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo in The Barrens.

text.title: Amongst the Ruins
text.objectives: Bring the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
text.description: The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.  Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us.  If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.$B$B$n, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water.  In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity.  If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!
text.progress: Have you been successful in locating the fathom core? Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.
text.completion: This is exactly what I need! A fathom core is an incredible well of information that we will be able to draw much good from. Whatever the Twilight's Hammer is up to in there - and believe me when I say it is no good - my comrades and I will now uncover.$b$bYou've done well here today; the Earthen Ring looks upon you warmly for assisting us. You've also helped the Horde as a whole, and for that you should be proud.
text.completed: Return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

text.title: Baron Aquanis
text.objectives: Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
text.description: The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe.  You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy.  Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about.  The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.$B$BIf anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring.  He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
text.progress: Ah, hello again $N. I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do. What brings you to the outpost?
text.completion: This... this is quite the find, $N.$b$bYou acquired this from Baron Aquanis in Blackfathom, you say? Baron Aquanis has long been thought of as a corrupted elemental power; this globe will prove what exactly had corrupted him. While it would be no surprise if it turned out to be the Twilight's Hammer, our studies will also show how they did it as well.$b$bYou did well in bringing this to me. Please - take this, along with the Earthen Ring's warmest regards.

text.title: Down at the Docks
text.objectives: Take your ward to the docks of Ratchet in the Barrens.
text.description: I have heard tales of the mighty ships that sail between Ratchet and Booty Bay!  That would be so cool to sail on the ocean and fight in many great sea battles.  Maybe I will be a mighty Horde sailor when I grow up!  Yeah!$B$BWould you take me to see the Ratchet docks, please?  I promise I won't get into the water or cause any trouble - I just want to see the big boats and smell the salty sea water!  Yeah!
text.progress: Are we there yet?
text.completion: Wow, the ocean is HUGE! There were a lot of sea gulls and stuff too - It's just as noisy and as bustling as I thought it would be. There are pirates near by too - so cool!$B$BThank you for taking me to Ratchet, $N. That was so awesome!
text.end: Go to the docks of Ratchet in the Barrens.
text.completed: Speak to your Orcish Orphan.

text.title: Gateway to the Frontier
text.objectives: Take your ward to the Mor'shan Rampart in the northern part of the Barrens, just before entering Ashenvale.
text.description: They say that Ashenvale is the new frontier, and that the Mor'shan Rampart in the Barrens is the gateway to it.  That would be so cool to be a pioneer, carving everything you need out of the untamed wilds!  They say that this is where the Horde and Alliance will clash the most in the future, and I want to be there $n!$B$BWould you take me to the Mor'shan Rampart so I can see what the frontier looks like, please?  I wanna see where the Horde is driving out those smelly night elves!
text.progress: Are we there yet?
text.completion: Wow, Ashenvale is where real adventure happens! Have you ever fought in Ashenvale, $N? When I become a hero when I grow up, I wanna come to Ashenvale and fight for the glory Horde!$B$BThank you for taking me to the frontier, $N. You're the best!
text.end: Go to the Mor'shan Rampart in the Barrens.
text.completed: Speak to your Orcish Orphan.
